description: The 14th International Thessaloniki Night Half Marathon is a unique sporting event that combines athletics with the city’s nighttime party. Participants can enjoy a half-marathon route, as well as 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1-mile races, with full support and amenities. The event offers commemorative T-shirts, medals, electronic timing and energy support, creating a welcoming and lively atmosphere for all runners. It also promotes social responsibility and culture, strengthening the Thessaloniki community.
course_highlights: A night route through the city of Thessaloniki
Half-marathon, 10,000 m, 5,000 m and 1-mile routes
Full support with water, isotonic drinks, energy drinks and medical cover
additional: Participation amenities include a commemorative technical T-shirt, race bib, electronic timing, commemorative medal, water, isotonic drink, juice, energy drink, non-alcoholic beer, savoury snack, cereal bar, banana, medical services and a certificate of participation through the official website. Group registration is available, with a €5 discount per person for groups of 10 or more. The team captain is responsible for collecting the equipment and representing the team. The event features parallel routes and activities, registration online and at offices, and age restrictions for certain races.

name: One Step Together Run 2026 – 5 χλμ. Αγώνας Δρόμου
One Step Together Run 2026 – 1.500 μ. Διαδρομή Συμπερίληψης
Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haiduk Paths Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Balkan Mountains. The route passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine terrain, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses used by haiduks as refuges. It follows ancient paths used by the haiduks and offers the chance to enjoy the area’s nature and history. The race takes place in the last week of October, bringing varied weather conditions and a different level of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The route passes 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine terrain with bare rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient haiduk paths and hiking trails
additional: The route passes historic fortresses and natural landmarks. The race takes place in the last week of October, with variations in weather conditions and difficulty.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αρτας
organizer: Δήμος Αρταίων, ΕΑΣ ΣΕΓΑΣ Ηπείρου, Σύλλογος Δρομέων Άρτας
price_range: 21,1 χλμ.: 13 ευρώ, 10 χλμ.: 8 ευρώ, 5 χλμ.: 6 ευρώ, παιδικοί αγώνες δωρεάν, μπλουζάκι 7 ευρώ
description: The 10th Arta Half Marathon, “The Bridge Run,” is a running race held in the city of Arta, known for its rich history and important historical monuments. The half-marathon course passes by the city’s most iconic landmarks, including the famous Bridge of Arta, offering runners a unique experience. The race is certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS) and also includes city races and children’s races. The start and finish are at central locations in the city, enhancing the local character and festival atmosphere.
course_highlights: AIMS-certified course
Passes by the historic Bridge of Arta
Runs through important historical sites in the city
additional: The races on Sunday 18/10 start at the Gate of the Medieval Castle of Arta. The walking and children’s races take place on Saturday 17/10, starting from Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. All races finish at Ethnikis Antistaseos Square. Races are available for all ages, from children’s races to the half marathon and city races. Courses are certified by the Association of International Marathons, with a time limit of 2 hours and 45 minutes. The event includes full medical coverage and electronic timing.

name: 12οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Καβουσίου
description: The 12th Kavousi Mountain Races, taking place on Sunday, October 18, 2026, in Kavousi, Ierapetra, Crete, are an important mountain-running event. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to enjoy the area’s natural beauty and distinctive landscape, combining the challenge of a mountain course with the traditions and hospitality of Crete. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere for participants. It attracts runners of all levels who love mountain running and adventure in nature.
course_highlights: Mountain course in Kavousi, Ierapetra, with beautiful natural scenery
Challenging terrain with trails and natural landscapes
Traditional Cretan setting and hospitality
additional: The race features 22.3 km and 8.7 km courses, starting at 9:00 a.m., with technical support throughout the route.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Τιμής και Μνήμης Ανδρών Ηρωικού Τάγματος Εθελοντών Κρητών
Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the Varna region of Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of varying levels. The routes offer a variety of terrain and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging climbs and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature lovers and trail runners to enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: 38 km with 1,100 m of elevation gain
26 km with 700 m of elevation gain
11 km with 330 m of elevation gain
additional: The event is associated with mountain running and hiking, and is expected to take place in October 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain race that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Elenite area. The race offers four distances—4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K—suitable for runners of different levels. The course follows scenic nature trails and offers a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event is part of the international Kom–Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.
course_highlights: Mountain and sea landscapes
Part of the international Kom–Emine route
A range of distances from 4 to 50 km
additional: The event is scheduled for October 18, 2026, and includes various distances suitable for runners with different levels of fitness. The routes pass through scenic natural areas in Elenite.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The “Dimitar Varbanov - Miteto” race in the town of Koynare is a traditional athletics event with a history spanning more than 30 years, featuring half-marathons, road races, and track meets. In recent years, a race-walking tournament has also been held, attracting athletes from various towns in Bulgaria. The organizers, SCA “Spartak - Koynare,” ensure professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for the participation of Bulgaria’s top runners and race walkers.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a history spanning more than 30 years
Includes half-marathons, road races, and track meets
A race-walking tournament on a 1 km loop
additional: The race-walking tournament takes place on a 1 km loop. Athletes of various ages from different towns compete. Among the judges is Lyubomir Ivanov, the national record holder in the 20 km race walk. Full results and photos have been published on the event’s Facebook page. A race-walking tournament with participants from across Bulgaria, a 1 km course, held for the first time in Koynare’s history.

name: Sfakia Sky Marathon
description: The Sfakia Sky Marathon is a unique 44.1-kilometer mountain-running race with approximately 3,050 meters of elevation gain, held in the southern part of the White Mountains on Crete. The route starts in the seaside village of Loutro and finishes in Anopoli, offering a challenging and impressive experience with sections along coastal trails, mountain deserts, and the highest peak of the White Mountains, Pachnes. The race has a time limit of 10 hours and 30 minutes and includes cutoff points to ensure athletes’ safety. It is intended for experienced mountain runners who have completed at least two mountain-running half marathons in the past three years.
course_highlights: 44.1 kilometers with +3,050 meters of elevation gain
Route from seaside Loutro to Pachnes peak at 2,454 meters
Sections through mountain desert and trails with loose rock
additional: The race has a time limit of 10 hours and 30 minutes, with three cutoff points. The start is in Loutro, after athletes disembark from a boat. To participate, runners must have completed two mountain-running half marathons in the past 3 years. Wearing a windbreaker is recommended because of strong winds in the mountain desert. Aid stations are located at specific points along the route. The event includes multiple routes, detailed information about registration and the schedule, as well as cultural events around the race.

name: 12ος Δρόμος Αθανάτων και 6ος Δρόμος Βασιλιάς Λεωνίδας
Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: The Eastern Rhodopes race is an ultrarunning event held in the Krumovgrad area, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The courses pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments, such as Sheytan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and climbs. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts who want to enjoy the wilderness and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. The organizers provide course marking, medals, timing and photographers, and participants can also run with pets. The use of reusable water bottles is encouraged.
course_highlights: Courses pass by megalithic monuments such as Kovil and natural phenomena such as Sheytan Dere
Technical descents and climbs with moderate elevation gain
Pets are welcome, with water and treats available at the aid stations
additional: Course marking, medals, timing and photographers are provided. Participants can run with pets, with water and treats available for them at the aid stations. Reusable water bottles or cups are recommended to reduce plastic use. Courses: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious competition that brings together athletes from across Bulgaria for challenging races in a natural and demanding setting. The event offers young and experienced runners the opportunity to compete on varied terrain suited to cross country. The organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accurate and transparent rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and varied terrain
Suitable for all age groups and fitness levels
Professional timing using RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and a real-time participant list. Certified timing equipment is used, with live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24. The race will take place in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG. The course is in the area around the town.

name: 1ος Συμμετοχικός Αγώνας Δρόμου στο Παραποτάμιο Πάρκο Άρτας
Imittos Epic
description: The Imittos Epic is a demanding mountain race for experienced trail runners, featuring technical, rocky terrain. The route starts in the area of Agios Georgios Koutalas and includes uphill and downhill trails, passes by historic sites such as Kaisariani Monastery, and has two strict time cutoffs at checkpoints. The race requires good race management and support, as the mountain is busy and some sections of the route are exposed. The organizers provide chip timing and commemorative medals for finishers.
course_highlights: Technical, rocky terrain with exposed sections where there is no margin for a fall
Passes by Kaisariani Monastery and trails with significant elevation gain (1,220 m)
Two strict cutoffs at checkpoints CP4 (13.5 km) and CP6 (17.5 km)
additional: Race bibs and timing chips can be collected from October 21 to 24 and on race morning. A commemorative T-shirt can be ordered until September 30. The race has cutoffs at two checkpoints (CP4 and CP6). Awards are presented immediately after the winners finish. Registration is canceled if payment is not made within 5 business days. Refunds are issued with deductions depending on the cancellation date. The race includes difficult technical routes, GPS and Garmin route files, and approaches the environment with respect and a commitment to sustainability.

name: South Olympus Forest Trail
description: The South Olympus Forest Trail 54 km race starts from the village square in Palios Panteleimonas, Pieria, and traverses trails with gentle slopes and impressive views. The route includes uphill and downhill sections, with a total ascent of approximately 2,000 metres, passing through natural landscapes such as Lake Kati and the village of Palia Pori. There are several aid stations and strict equipment requirements due to the season. The race offers a challenging yet enchanting experience on forest trails and in the mountainous landscapes of Olympus.
course_highlights: 930 m ascent in the first 8.5 km, with views of Lake Kati
Route with approximately +2,000 m of total elevation gain
Views of the Thessalian Plain, the peaks of Olympus, and the Aegean Sea
additional: Mandatory equipment due to the season. Aid stations at kilometres 9, 17, 28, 36, and 46. Cut-off points at 17 km (3:30 hours) and 36 km (8:30 hours). The event also includes 10-kilometre routes, and takes place in October 2026. Detailed information is available about registration and the required equipment.

name: 11ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Παναγία Μερέντα
location: Μαρκόπουλο Αττικής, Δήμος Μαρκοπούλου Μεσογαίας, Αττική, Ελλάδα
organizer: Ενορία του Ιερού Μητροπολιτικού Ναού Αγ. Ιωάννου Μαρκοπούλου
description: The 11th Panagia Merenta Popular Road Race is organized by the Parish of the Holy Metropolitan Church of St. John in Markopoulo. It is an annual sporting event that attracts runners from the Attica region. The race follows a beautiful route in Markopoulo, Attica, offering an enjoyable running experience for all participants. The event has a long tradition and aims to promote sports and community participation.
course_highlights: Route in Markopoulo, Attica
Organized start and finish in the central square
Friendly environment for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes a road race and activities for children and teenagers, aiming to promote sports and social cohesion in the area.

name: Τρέχω για τον Κορινό
price_range: δωρεάν για μαθητές, 10€ για 10 χλμ., 5€ για 5 χλμ.
description: The I Run for Korinos race is an established sporting event held in the Korinos area of Katerini. It promotes positive energy and smiles, inviting runners of all ages to take part in a celebration of sport and community. The race offers an opportunity for physical activity in a beautiful natural setting, while supporting the local community and sport. The organizers ensure accessibility and comfort for all participants.
course_highlights: Route in Korinos, Katerini
Natural surroundings with beautiful scenery
Established local race with a positive atmosphere
additional: Registration is available online or by email, and race numbers can be collected one hour before the race. The event is supported by the Central Macedonia Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS).

name: 43ος Αυθεντικός Μαραθώνιος
organizer: ΣΕΓΑΣ (Σύνδεσμος Γραμμάτων και Τεχνών) και Μαραθώνιος Αθήνας
description: The 43rd Athens Authentic Marathon, taking place on November 8, 2026, is a historic and iconic road-running event that honors the classic route from Marathon to Athens. The event includes the Marathon, as well as accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race for students, and a 1,200 m children’s race. It offers a unique experience for runners of all levels, with a rich program of events and support. The city of Marathon, with its natural beauty, is an important part of the route and the race’s history.
course_highlights: Historic route from Marathon to Athens
Accompanying 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km night race, and a 1,200 m children’s race
The natural and historic landscape of the city of Marathon
additional: The Marathon includes accompanying events such as Authentic Talks and the Allwyn Marathon Expo. A volunteer program and a runner service center are available at the Faliro Olympic Complex. Race bibs and materials can be collected at the Faliro Indoor Hall (Tae Kwon Do). The races begin with the children’s race at 16:00, the 5 km race at 17:00, the 5 km night race for students at 20:00, and the Marathon at 08:30 on November 8, 2026. The event includes races of 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1,200 m for children, as well as events, volunteer opportunities, and online registration. There is also an accompanying 5 km night race for school students.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
organizer: Балканска атлетика (АБАФ), атлетически клуб „Спартак“ – Койнаре, община Червен бряг
description: The 2026 Balkan Cross Country Championships will be held in Koynare, Bulgaria, on November 7. The event is organized by the local Spartak-Koynare Athletics Club in cooperation with the town hall, Cherven Bryag Municipality, and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The course is designed around the stadium and the athletics club buildings, near the town center, and will welcome more than 600 athletes and guests. Koynare is an established host of running competitions, with a long-standing tradition and experience in organizing sporting events.
course_highlights: The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings in the center of Koynare
Several luxury hotels are available within a 20 km radius
Koynare has actively organized running events for more than 30 years
additional: More than 600 athletes, team representatives, referees, organizers, and fans are expected to attend. The event is part of the sports calendar of Balkan Athletics and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. In late October 2026, Koynare will also host the national cross country championships as preparation for the Balkan Championships. The course is around the stadium and athletics club buildings, and hotels within a 20 km radius can accommodate more than 600 participants and guests.

name: Първа Пушка Trail 2026
description: First Rifle Trail is a mountain running event in Koprivshtitsa that brings together sport, nature, and history. The race offers three routes of varying distances and elevation gain, passing through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines, and reaching Mount Bogdan—the highest point in Sredna Gora. Participants can enjoy beautiful autumn views, historic sites, and the atmosphere of the old town. The 25 km and 35 km distances are part of the international UTMB Index network, offering the opportunity to take part in the World Series.
course_highlights: Routes through scenic forest trails and open ridgelines
Climb to Mount Bogdan (1604 m), the highest point in Sredna Gora
Cobblestone streets and the historic atmosphere of Koprivshtitsa
additional: The start is at 20th April Square in Koprivshtitsa. The entry includes a race pack with materials and gifts, chip timing, insurance, and medical assistance. Children under 13 may take part in the 10 km distance only with an accompanying adult. In poor weather conditions, the 10 km course may be run in the opposite direction. The cutoff time for 25 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes, and for 35 km it is 6 hours and 30 minutes.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the largest classic races in the RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The event offers a unique experience in nature, with varied courses suited to different levels of runners. The routes follow scenic trails and offer challenges that will appeal to both recreational and experienced runners. Organized by Trail Series, the race is part of a seasonal series that brings together runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of the village of German
Scenic trails and varied terrain
Suitable for different levels of runners
additional: The event takes place on 8 November 2026, from 11:00 to 15:00, in the village of German. The organizer is Trail Series. Google Maps directions to the location are available. No specific prices or registration categories have been published on the pages at this time. A trail race on varied terrain, including asphalt and trails; registration details are not specified.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emenski Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The race offers three courses of varying distance and elevation gain: 8 km with 360 m of positive elevation gain, 16 km with 720 m, and 24 km with 1,100 m. Participants can enjoy marked trails, aid stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three courses of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with 360 to 1,100 metres of positive elevation gain
Marked trails and aid stations along the route
additional: Registration and race-pack collection from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 11:45. A medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and a race bib for all participants. Race photography. Trail running across different distances, registration, medals, aid stations, and technical information for participants.

name: 2ος Δρόμος Υγείας «Αγιος Δημήτριος – Στα Μονοπάτια των Ορυζώνων»
4o Γίδι των Μεθάνων
description: The 4th Methana Goat is a mountain race organized under the auspices of the Municipality of Troizinia–Methana, with the participation of the Argolis Hellenic Rescue Team. It is a challenging course offering unique mountain-running experiences in a volcanic landscape of great natural beauty. The race is a celebration for lovers of the mountains and adventure, attracting runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The organizers emphasize the safety and support of participants throughout the race.
course_highlights: The volcanic landscape of Methana
Routes with steep climbs and natural beauty
Extensive views of the sea and mountains
additional: The race includes 28 km and 12 km routes, with elevation gains of up to +1720 m and +680 m, respectively, and offers cultural and entertainment events. The area is known for its thermal baths and unique natural landscape.

description: The 1st Nafpaktos Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new road race that combines sport with Greece’s cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event also includes a 1 km race for children and a 5 km race for amateur runners and people with disabilities, promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants receive full support, electronic timing, and commemorative gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participant amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic certificate, medical support, bag-drop and changing facilities, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1 km children’s race, with impressive routes through natural and historic landscapes. Participation promotes health and the area’s cultural identity.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Methana GOAT is an annual mountain running race held in autumn on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers courses of 28 km with 1,720 m of elevation gain, 12 km with 680 m, and 5 km with 120 m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge across rugged volcanic terrain. The race stands out for its constantly changing scenery, views of the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep climbs
Frequent views of the sea from high mountain passes
Beautiful landscapes with changing natural surroundings
additional: Courses: 28 km (+1,720 m), 12 km (+680 m), and 5 km (+120 m). The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registration via the official website; scheduled for November 22–23, 2025.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun – Bonsovi Polyani is a November race in the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the Lyulin Mountain area and the iconic Bonsovi Polyani locality on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances—short, medium, and long—allowing runners with different levels of preparation and ambitions to take part. The event is part of a series of races offering varied courses and running conditions in the natural surroundings of Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polyani locality
A choice of three distances—short, medium, and long
A natural, iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will take place in a natural setting with mountainous terrain; registration details and fees have not been specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

description: The International Olympia Marathon is a historic road race held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic “Sacred Way,” following a route rich in cultural memory and sporting ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children’s race, offering a unique sporting experience for everyone. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square in Ancient Olympia, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic “Sacred Way” of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometre markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Runner benefits: race bib with electronic timing chip, commemorative medal and T-shirt, and water, isotonic drink, energy drink, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drink, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory to participate. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall, as well as portable toilets along the course. Runners must keep to the right side of the road. The event welcomes participants from around the world and features celebrations and awards, with an emphasis on cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

name: 3ος Αγώνας Μηδενικών Διακρίσεων
location: Olympic Stadium (Olympic Athletic Center of Athens), Marousi, Greece

name: Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelikon Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race, organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Telmissos Nea Makri Marathon Runners’ Association in collaboration with the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association. The route follows forest trails, starting at Agia Marina in Nea Makri. The race aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Despite recent fire damage, Mount Pentelikon retains its remarkable beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to efforts to restore the mountains.
course_highlights: A 12 km mountain route on forest trails
Start at Agia Marina in Nea Makri
An area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 a.m. The event aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes by S.E.D.M. (Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association) and follows a trail through a forest that suffered a fire in August 2024. The event includes competitive and volunteer participation, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and promoting mountain running.

name: 6ο Κέρη Cross Country Race
description: The Keri Cross Country Race offers two routes through the Keri Forest in Heraklion, Crete: one 10.2 kilometers long and one 5 kilometers long. The 10.2 km route is fast in the first half but challenging, with uphill elevation in the second half, making it ideal for experienced runners. The 5 km route is shorter and faster, suitable for beginners or those who prefer an easier trail route. The race is held every December and offers a beautiful challenge for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Keri Forest, known for its natural beauty
Fast and challenging 10.2 km route with uphill elevation
Easy, fast 5 km route suitable for beginners
additional: There is an award for the fastest team, based on the average time of the 6 fastest athletes (3 men and 3 women), awarded separately for the 5 km and 10 km routes. The race includes 5 km and 10.2 km routes, with participants across various age categories and genders. The organizers also provide information about rules and registration, and the location is known for its natural surroundings and beauty.

name: SNF Run: First Run
location: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center, Kallithea, Athens, Greece
description: SNF FIRST RUN is an annual charity road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation every New Year’s Day at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center in Kallithea, Athens. The race offers a unique experience combining giving and sport, supporting social causes. The course is different each year, offering participants a distinctive route. The race starts in the first minutes of the new year, creating a lively and festive atmosphere for runners.
course_highlights: Route at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center
Starts in the first minutes of New Year’s Day
Charitable event supporting social causes
additional: The race takes place every year on January 1, starting at 00:04. It is an evening road race with a charitable purpose. No information about prices or registration was found, as places are full and registration has closed. The race is accompanied by events such as a party with live music and fireworks, and is part of the area’s holiday celebrations.

name: 27ος Αγώνας Αλσους Δαφνίου
description: The 27th Daphni Grove Race is a traditional 10-kilometer road race held in Daphni Grove. The course starts on Athens Avenue and passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite, offering a route away from the city noise with beautiful views of the Thriasian Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgats zonas and is a celebration for runners, with traditional hospitality and electronic timing. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their race numbers, and there is a place to store their belongings.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Daphni Grove
Passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite
Views of the Thriasian Gulf, away from the city noise
additional: The start is on Athens Avenue, near Daphni Hospital. Athletes must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their race numbers from the registration desk. Electronic timing and baggage storage are available. It is recommended that participants leave their cars at the end of Iera Odos, near Daphni Monastery, to avoid congestion. Electronic timing and baggage storage are provided. Race-number pickup takes place before the start; arriving at least one hour early is recommended.

name: 13ο Pilabox Trail Race
description: The Pilabox Trail Race is a mountain race held on Mount Penteli, offering a unique experience in a natural setting. There are two routes, a short 6-kilometer course and a long course of about 13 kilometers, with a shared start at the playground on Dionysou Avenue in Palia Penteli. The race is organized by the PILABOX-PILABAR venue, which combines fitness and healthy eating to create a complete athletic and social experience. The event has a long tradition and is an important occasion for trail-running enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain on Mount Penteli
Two routes: 6.0 km and 13.2 km
Shared start at the playground on Dionysou Avenue, Palia Penteli
additional: Start Pack pickup takes place on designated days before the race at PILABAR in Chalandri. The race is accompanied by social events such as a Pasta Party. The event emphasizes healthy eating and fitness, offering a complete experience. The race includes electronic timing, a medal, gifts, water stations, a recovery meal, photos and a DJ, with 6 km and 14 km routes.

name: 10ο Λέβαδος Mountain Trail
description: The 10th Levados Mountain Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Livadeia, Boeotia. It features two courses, 24.2 km and 10.7 km, with substantial elevation gain, offering runners unique moments amid the area’s natural beauty. The start and finish are at the Erkyna Springs, with routes that include trails, forest roads, and pedestrian paths. The race serves as a qualifying event for participation in the Olympus Marathon and is organized by the Livadeia Athletic Swimming Club (A.K.O.L.).
course_highlights: 24.2 km course with 1,530 m of positive elevation gain
10.7 km course with 650 m of positive elevation gain
Start and finish at the Erkyna Springs (elevation 179 m)
additional: The routes are marked with metal signs, signs bearing the letter Λ and yellow-blue markings, as well as course tape. A sweeper carrying fluids, food, and medical supplies follows the last runner. The race starts and finishes at the same location, at the Erkyna Springs area (KRYA). The race program includes courses with technical challenges and impressive views; announcements and participation details are expected soon. The event also includes traditional gifts for participants.

description: The 10th Veikou Trail is a mountain running race held around and through Veikou Grove in Galatsi, offering a unique running experience within the city. The courses include trails, forest roads and varied gradients, with views of the city and Mount Hymettus. The race is aimed primarily at experienced mountain runners and crosses the boundaries of three municipalities, showcasing an area of particular natural beauty and historical interest.
course_highlights: Routes through the old LATO quarries, with their lunar landscape
Trails, forest roads and steps with varied gradients
Views of the city and Mount Hymettus
additional: All routes start and finish at the Galatsi Municipal Stadium inside Veikou Grove. A 20 km relay race (2 x 10 km) is available. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Galatsi and co-organized by MYSPORTEVENT. It includes a technical T-shirt and a multifunctional neck gaiter, with the start and finish at Galatsi Municipal Stadium, and takes place on natural trails and the mountain of Galatsi.

name: 4ο Cretan Backyard Ultra
description: Cretan Backyard Ultra is a unique ultradistance race held in Voritsi, Heraklion, Crete. Runners complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour, continuing until only one participant remains. It is a demanding test of endurance and mental strength, ideal for fans of trail running and ultradistance racing in Greece.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop
An ultradistance race with continuous hourly running
Location in Voritsi, Heraklion, Crete
additional: Participants run 6,706 meters on a loop every hour, creating a demanding experience for ultradistance enthusiasts. The race tests both the physical endurance and mental strength of the runners.

name: 7ος Βυζαντινός Αγώνας
organizer: Δήμος Μεγαρέων και Αντιδημαρχία Αθλητισμού & Νέας Γενιάς, σε συνεργασία με τους Αθηναίους Δρομείς, τον Απόλλωνα Δυτικής Αττικής και τους Δρομείς Μεγάρων «Ο Όρσιππος»
description: The 7th Byzantine 50-Kilometer Road Race is an ultradistance race held in Megara, starting and finishing at Vasilissa Frederikis Square. The course is entirely paved and passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, wooded sections, and the Alepochori–Dourakou beach, offering a unique experience of the area’s natural surroundings. The race has a charitable purpose and is intended for runners with marathon experience. The event honors the memory of Georgios Panos and promotes running and ultradistance racing.
course_highlights: A 49,600-meter course that is entirely paved
Passes through pistachio groves, olive groves, vineyards, and forests
Approximately 5 kilometers along Alepochori–Dourakou beach

Refreshment stations are located every 5 km, and medical support is provided. Timing is done using an electronic RFID chip. Participants may donate non-perishable food for charity before the start. The announcement for the 7th event specifies refreshment stations every 5 km, medical support, electronic timing with an RFID chip, and a time limit of 7 hours and 30 minutes. The published details are for the event on January 18, 2026.

The course starts on the beach and heads toward the community of Nikolaeika, continuing through local communities and seaside villages along the old railway line as far as Stafidala, before finishing back on Aigio beach.

Routes suitable for runners of all ages and levels

description: The 15th “Ioannis Kapodistrias” Half Marathon in Aegina is a historic road race honoring the first governor of modern Greece. The event features races of 21.1 kilometers, 10,000 meters, 3,000 meters for walkers, and children’s races, offering a celebration for runners of all ages and abilities. The event takes place in central Aegina and combines sport with cultural heritage, attracting a large number of participants each year. The longer-distance races start in the morning, while the shorter races start earlier, creating a wonderful sporting atmosphere for the whole family.
course_highlights: 21.1-kilometer half marathon in central Aegina
Children’s races of 200m, 500m, and 1,000m for all ages
3,000m route for walkers and a 10,000m road race

Age categories are offered for the half marathon and the 10,000-meter race: 18–39, 40–59, and 60+ years. Middle and high school students may also participate in the 3,000m race, under their parents’ responsibility. All participants receive finisher medals, and the top three in each category receive trophies. For the 2026 event, water stations every 2,500 m and isotonic drinks along the half marathon route are listed. Prices and benefits for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering runners of all levels the chance to enjoy mountain running and nature. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, more technical course and a shorter one for beginners. The series has become an established fixture in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with support from Salomon, which invites runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses at each race: a long course (10–12 km) and a short course (4–7 km), both with significant elevation gain
Natural scenery and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Four pairs of Salomon shoes are drawn at each race. There are individual and team rankings for the long distance. Teams consist of 3 people, and the top three teams receive awards. In a recent edition, the race in Penteli started from Semelis Square. The event provided a race number with a timing chip, water stations, snacks at the finish, a commemorative certificate and medical coverage.

description: Retsakas Trail Run is a distinctive mountain-running event held within the Municipality of Kissamos, in the Plokamiana area of Inachorio, Chania. The event offers two routes: the longer Retsakas Challenge, 24.7 km with significant elevation gain, and the shorter Retsakas Entry, 6.8 km, ideal for those who want to enjoy the natural beauty and Retsakas Waterfall. The event stands out for its route through villages and natural landscapes, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The races start in the morning, with the Challenge beginning at 10:00 and the shorter route at 10:30.
course_highlights: Retsakas Challenge: 24.7 km with ±1,290 m elevation gain
Retsakas Entry: 6.8 km with ±420 m elevation gain
Routes that pass through 6 villages of Inachorio and Retsakas Waterfall
additional: The Retsakas Challenge has a time limit of 5 hours, while the Retsakas Entry has a time limit of 2 hours. The races start at two different times: 10:00 a.m. for the Challenge and 10:30 a.m. for the Entry. The routes are mountainous, with significant elevation gain, and refreshments are provided during the race. The event includes running and hiking races, with an emphasis on nature and local culture. Participants come from across Crete and Greece.

name: 5ο Sparta City Ultra
description: The running club “Spartans Runners” is organizing the 5th Sparta City Ultra in Sparta, Laconia, on Saturday, February 7 and Sunday, February 8, 2026. The event includes three races lasting 6, 12 and 24 hours, with an intermediate time point at 100 miles. The course is an 822-meter loop, starting and finishing near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium. The winners are those who cover the greatest distance within their race’s time limit.
course_highlights: An 822-meter loop along Konstantinou Palaiologou Avenue
Start and finish near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium
6-, 12- and 24-hour races, with an intermediate time point at 100 miles
additional: A central aid station provides water, electrolytes, coffee/tea, soft drinks, fruit, nuts and snacks. Hot food (pasta and soup) is provided depending on the race duration. Organized bus transportation is available from Athens (Karaiskaki Square, Metaxourgeio), with specific departure and return times for each race. Race-pack pickup takes place on Saturday and Sunday before the race. Awards are presented to the top 6 men and women in each race, and all finishers receive a medal and a T-shirt. The event includes multiple race categories, aid stations with food and drinks, transportation options from Athens, and registration through the Athletin platform.

This winter sports event attracts ski and snowboard enthusiasts, offering challenging courses in a mountain setting. Participants can enjoy Vitosha’s beautiful scenery and mountain air.

The event includes an 8-kilometre training route through the forest, suitable for runners of all levels. It coincides with the annual vasilopita-cutting gathering of Thrace’s runners, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere. The race is an alternative sporting get-together with a strong local character and tradition.

Recreation area and forest trail

The first 100 participants receive a free T-shirt, and prizes are awarded to top finishers in various categories. The event promotes participation in sport and social solidarity.

Water stations along the course and at the finish

name: 5ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Αγάπης
description: The 5th Love Half Marathon in Mytilene will take place over the weekend of February 14 and 15, 2026, offering a rich program of sporting and cultural events. On Saturday, races start in the Tsamakia area, with distances of 1,000 m, 2,500 m, Family Running 2,500 m, and 5,000 m for various age categories. On Sunday, athletes gather in the city center for the 10-kilometer race and the 21-kilometer half marathon. The event has become an important occasion for the city of Mytilene.
course_highlights: Races in the seaside Tsamakia area, in front of the EOT beach
A variety of distances from 1,000 m to 21 kilometers
Races in the city center, with traffic closures to ensure they run smoothly
additional: Saturday’s races start at 12:00 in the Tsamakia area, with traffic closed for approximately 4 hours. On Sunday, athletes arrive at 07:00, and the races start at 09:00 in the city center. There are categories for all ages and a family run. The event includes multiple courses, activities for all ages, and participation packages with special gifts and benefits.

name: 10ο MaskaRun
description: The sporting celebration in Orchomenos, Boeotia, on Sunday, February 15, 2026, brings together the 10th anniversary MaskaRun, the 1st «Asopichos» 5 km Road Race, and events for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day. The event is a major celebration of sport, remembrance, and humanity, with free participation for everyone. Orchomenos Central Square will be the hub of the festivities, which will also include a handball demonstration and prize draws for children. MaskaRun has become an established event with mass participation, and this year it is joined by the certified «Asopichos» 5 km race course, with official timing.
course_highlights: 10th anniversary MaskaRun route through Orchomenos
New certified «Asopichos» 5 km race course with timing
Events at Central Square featuring sporting and community activities
additional: Participation in MaskaRun and the Asopichos road race is free for everyone. The program includes a handball demonstration and activities, as well as prize draws for children. Commemorative medals will be awarded at the end of the event. The program includes the «Asopichos» 5 km race, celebrations for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day, and various sporting activities. Participation is free.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: The 11th Lycabettus Run is a distinctive road race held on the green Lycabettus Hill in Athens. The routes include paved and dirt roads, offering a unique running experience in nature with views of the city. The race includes individual and team categories, with morning starts and full support for runners. The event provides medals, cups, digital certificates, medical coverage, and water stations.
course_highlights: A paved circular route around Lycabettus Hill
A dirt route reaching the hilltop
Routes with multiple laps depending on the distance (5.5 km, 9 km, 11 km)
additional: The routes are circular, with the start and finish at the St George Lycabettus Hotel. There are two water stations with bottled water. Electronic timing is provided with a single-use chip. Medical coverage includes an ambulance and first aid provided by the Samaritans Volunteer Corps. Participants receive a finisher’s medal, cups for the top finishers in each category, and a digital participation certificate. A technical T-shirt is provided. Registration requires age verification and parental consent for minors. The race includes medals, trophies, digital certificates, and electronic timing.

name: 11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου “Η καρδιά του παιδιού”
description: The 11th “The Heart of the Child” Road Race takes place as part of World Congenital Heart Defect Awareness Day and offers two routes of 7 and 10.5 kilometers through the lush, beautiful natural landscape of Fodele, Heraklion, Crete. The race aims to raise awareness and support children with heart conditions, while also offering a rewarding sporting experience for runners of all levels. The event bears the name and support of the Association for the Protection, Information and Assistance of Children with Heart Conditions, “The Heart of the Child.”
course_highlights: Two routes of 7 and 10.5 kilometers
Lush, beautiful natural landscape
Held as part of World Congenital Heart Defect Awareness Day
additional: The event includes races for children and adults, with registration available online, and finishes in a square in the village. The route passes through the forest and the square of Fodele, promoting awareness of pediatric cardiology.

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
location: Δημοτικό Στάδιο Βύρωνα, Βύρωνας, Attica, Greece
description: The Niki Vyronas Training Meeting is organized by the Niki Vyronas Gymnastics Club, based at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. Founded in 2005, the club offers specialized guidance from experienced coaches with outstanding athletic achievements. The meeting aims to promote track and field and improve quality of life through exercise. It offers athletes and sports enthusiasts an opportunity to experience the joy of athletics in a friendly, well-organized environment.
course_highlights: Held at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium
Specialized guidance from physical education teachers and former high-performing athletes
Promotes track and field and exercise for all ages
additional: The club office is open in the afternoons from 17:00 to 20:00. The club offers groups for all ages, from preschool children to adults, with training sessions at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. There is an emphasis on training for road and mountain runners. The event includes training activities and the 6th Vyronas Municipality Road Race, offering a comprehensive experience for athletes and coaches.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 is a popular winter trail-running series in the mountains of Attica, offering new racing experiences for runners of all levels. It consists of three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, each with two routes: a longer, technical and demanding route, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The event aims to connect runners with nature and showcase the beauty of mountain running in Attica. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with Salomon as the title sponsor.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha
Two routes per race: Long (10–12 km) and Short (4–7 km)
Natural beauty and technical trails with significant elevation gain
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in the overall standings are awarded in both distances. Age categories are offered only in the Long Distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. A draw is held for four lucky participants to win Salomon shoes. There are individual and team standings in the Long Distance. The Long Distance starts at 10:00 and the Short Distance at 10:15. Trail races in Hymettus, categories for different distances and age groups, team competitions, medals, prizes, and race amenities.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: The Gentiki Trail is a mountain race held in the Gentiki area of Larissa. The 21-kilometer course follows marked trails and has a positive elevation gain of +1370 meters, offering a challenging and exciting experience for mountain runners. There is also a shorter 5.1-kilometer course with a positive elevation gain of +250 meters, ideal for those looking for a shorter challenge. The race is a qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon, attracting runners seeking a high level of competition and natural beauty.
course_highlights: 21 km course on marked trails with +1370 m elevation gain
Shorter 5.1 km course with +250 m elevation gain
The race is a qualifying race for the Olympus Marathon
additional: Participant limits: 200 for the 21 km course and 150 for the 5.1 km course. The 21 km race starts at 10:00 and the 5.1 km race at 10:30. Contact Apostolos Goulas at 6932752733. The race is organized by the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Association. The race includes online registration, water and light refreshments, with participant limits of 200 for the longer course and 150 for the shorter course.

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Run is a special sporting event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The race offers two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads, both fully marked. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, which is refunded on race day. The money collected from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. There is no electronic timing or awards, as all participants are considered winners and receive a mug as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Two routes, 14.5 km and 6.3 km, on forest trails and paved roads
Full course marking and water stations along the route
Held in the natural setting of the former Varympompi forest (Tatoi Estate)
additional: There is no electronic timing or awards. Every participant receives a mug, possibly featuring a personal photo. Participation is free with registration and a €10 deposit, refunded on race day. The money from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. Water stations are available along the route. Routes of 14.5 km and 6.3 km on forest trails and paved roads; no electronic timing; participation with a €10 deposit; a mug with a personal photo as a prize; charitable support for the orphanage.

name: 10ος Δρόμος Αξιών
location: Ιερός Ναός Ζωοδόχου Πηγής, Κεφαλάρι Αργολίδας, Αργολίδα, Greece
description: The 10th Road of Values, organized by the 1st Argos Scout Group, is a running race dedicated to the universal values of life. The race is held on February 22, on the occasion of Scout Thinking Day, and honors the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakides. The start and finish are at Kefalari, Argos, at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a special experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting and finishing at Kefalari, Argos
650-meter children's race at the same location
Special tribute to Stelios Kyriakides and universal values
additional: The event includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The event has a long tradition and is associated with Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural setting, starting and finishing at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes a 650-meter children's race.

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The 5th Koumaria Trail Series is organized by the Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” and offers a challenging off-road course through the mountainous natural surroundings of Petrotó, Achaia. The event includes 40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes, with many runners and volunteers, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The race is marked by strong competition, as well as support and assistance for runners at aid stations. The event honors tradition and the beauty of nature while promoting sport and well-being.
course_highlights: Challenging off-road mountain terrain
40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes
Aid stations in the mountain village of Petrotó
additional: The Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” operates aid stations and assists approximately 600 mountain runners with the help of volunteers. The race is a major organizational success and also honors athletes with personal records. Technical off-road terrain, participation and volunteer involvement, major organizational success, and support activities.

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The “MARATHON - I Run in Marathon” road race is a flat 6.8-kilometer race held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade. It is aimed at experienced runners and athletes over the age of 15, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central small harbor of Nea Makri, with the race starting at 16:30. The event provides hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat 6.8 km route by the sea
Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade
Start and finish at the central small harbor of Nea Makri
additional: The entry package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. Stations provide bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweet snacks, and savory snacks. Participation is open to people over the age of 15, with parental consent required for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes of approximately 8.2 km, participation open to all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snacks provided during and after the race.

name: ДЛШ КОЛОКРОС, КУПА ДОЛЧИНИ
description: Bulgarian Cyclocross Championship, Dolcini Cup is a cyclocross race held in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. The event is part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship and offers participation opportunities for various rider categories. The race starts at 09:30, and detailed information and regulations are available on the federation’s official website. Registration is online via a special link provided by the organizers.
course_highlights: Race in Borisova Gradina, Sofia
Part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation championship
Various participant categories

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
location: Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour, Alepochori, Attica, Greece
description: The 18th Clean Monday Road Race is a traditional 10,000-meter race held in Alepochori, Attica, starting and finishing at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior. The course is uneven, dirt, and marked, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all levels. There is also a 300-meter children’s race and a carnival costume and dance contest. After the race, a celebration follows with music, wine, and traditional Lenten dishes, creating a festive atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Uneven dirt course
Start and finish at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior
Marked course and water provided
additional: The 10,000-meter race is limited to 250 athletes. Registration is by telephone only. A bus is available for €10, departing from Metaxourgeio (Karaiskaki Square) at 8:00. After the race, participants receive a handmade commemorative medal; trophies and prizes are awarded for the children’s race and costume contest. The post-race celebration features a DJ, dancing, wine, and a picnic with traditional Lenten dishes. For the 18th edition, the limit is stated as 250 participants in the 10 km race, with telephone registration. A bus from Athens is available for a €10 fare. The announced date for the 18th edition is February 23, 2026, different from the date of March 1, 2027, provided in the metadata.

description: The 2nd Spetses Mountain Run “Sotirios Anargyros” is a mountain race held on Spetses, aiming to promote sport and fair play and showcase the trails of the pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea. The event includes 26 km and 10 km courses, as well as a children’s walk, offering a unique experience for athletes and visitors. The event is supported by the Municipality of Spetses and the AKSS Foundation, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and promoting local products.
course_highlights: Trails on a pine-covered mountain overlooking the sea
26 km and 10 km courses in a natural setting
Children’s walk on the grounds of the AKSS Foundation
additional: Race registration opens at 10:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. on the previous day at the TITANIA cinema, where the technical briefing and athletes’ meal also take place. On race day, registration is open from 08:30 to 09:45 a.m. After the race, awards are presented at 3:00 p.m., followed by a farewell celebration with local delicacies. The available information concerns the 2026 edition and does not yet confirm the date of March 20, 2027.

name: 2ο Ελάτεια Historic Trail
organizer: Ορειβατικός, Φυσιολατρικός Σύλλογος Ελάτειας και ο Σύλλογος Νεολαίας Ελάτειας
description: The 2nd Historic Trail Elateia is a mountain running event offering three routes of varying distances and difficulty, set in a beautiful natural and historical environment. The course starts from Elateia’s central square and runs along trails, forest roads, and archaeological sites, offering unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is also suitable for runners with little experience in mountain running, with full course marking and aid stations. The event is known for its excellent organization, volunteer support, and involvement of the local community.
course_highlights: Start from Elateia’s central square at an elevation of 180 m
Pass archaeological sites and the chapel of Agios Athanasios
Views of the Maliakos Gulf and the mountains of Kallidromo, Parnassos, Giona, Oiti, and Vardousia
additional: The race starts from Elateia’s central square. There are three routes: 21.2 km, 12.6 km, and 6.2 km. Electronic timing is provided by CHRONOLOG. There are three aid stations. All finishers receive a medal. Payments are accepted by card only. Refunds are available up to 10 days before the race, subject to a small fee. The middle-distance route has a cut-off time of 2 hours 30 minutes. The event also includes 1 km routes for children, aiming to raise awareness and encourage the participation of the whole family. The routes are specially marked and organized with respect for the environment and the local community.

name: 14ος Χορτιάτης Trail Run
description: The 14th Hortiatis Trail Run is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association and takes place on Mount Hortiatis in Thessaloniki. The race aims to introduce runners to Hortiatis’s mountain environment, help them become familiar with the challenges of trail running, and promote the protection of the natural environment. The event is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis and promotes exercise, sports education, and social responsibility. It is a mountain race that combines natural beauty with an athletic challenge, ideal for runners who love the mountains and nature.
course_highlights: Trail running on Mount Hortiatis
Protected forest area with abundant natural beauty
Routes showcasing the natural environment and local history
additional: Registration has been extended until Wednesday 25/2/2026. The race is supported by the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis. The Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association was founded in 1993 and promotes popular mass participation in sports, exercise, and the protection of the natural environment. The annual membership fee is 15 euros and can be paid either at the association’s office or by bank transfer. Routes of 24, 10, and 6 km; trail-running races and paths; start and finish in the Hortiatis area, Thessaloniki, with support from the Municipality of Pylaia–Hortiatis.

description: For the third consecutive year, the Oloi Mazi Boroume road races are taking place in Parnitha, Attica, with the aim of reforestation and environmental protection. Participants can choose from three routes, making it possible for everyone to take part regardless of age or fitness level. Entry costs 10 euros for adults and is free for children up to 12 years old. All runners receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event brings participants together to create a sustainable environment.
course_highlights: Three different routes for all ages and fitness levels
Held in Parnitha, an area of natural beauty and ecosystems
Symbolic reforestation through tree planting in the race areas
additional: All participants receive individual timing and a commemorative t-shirt. The event takes place at three separate locations in Attica. Donations can be made by calling the five-digit number 19817, with a 2-euro donation. The event takes place at three locations in Attica, with an emphasis on reforestation and environmental protection. It includes online registration, commemorative items, and individual timing.

The event features cross-country races and a 10 km race walk, and is open to masters and independent athletes. Supported by the Region of Western Greece and the Municipality of Pyrgos, it offers a high-level sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting. The races begin in the morning, with the first start at 08:30.
course_highlights: Cross-country races and a 10 km race walk
Location: Spiantza Grove, Ilia
Held under the auspices of OEBAS

Entries cover various age categories and include cross-country races and race walking, with detailed information about courses and registration varying by category.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering every runner the chance to enjoy mountain running and the area’s natural beauty. The event consists of three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, technical and demanding course, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The series has become an established fixture in the running community, offering incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. The event is organized by MyRace and supported by Salomon, inviting runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses per race: a longer course (10–12 km) with significant elevation gain, and a shorter course (4–7 km)
Natural beauty and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the longer distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Each race includes a draw for 4 pairs of Salomon shoes. Individual and team rankings, with awards, are offered for the longer distance. Teams consist of three people and may be men’s, women’s or mixed. Trail running in Parnitha with multiple distances, categories for individual and team runners, medals and awards, as well as full participant services.

description: The 14th Athens Half Marathon is one of Greece’s most popular road races, held in the historic center of Athens. The 21-kilometer course offers a unique experience through the city, with support stations and comprehensive organization. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over and is a celebration of sport and participation. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event prioritizes participants’ safety and comfort, providing support along the entire course and an expo area before the race.
course_highlights: A 21-kilometer course in the historic center of Athens
Support stations with water, energy gels, isotonic drinks, and sponges
Start at 08:00, with the finish open until 11:30
additional: Race materials can be collected from the Runners’ Service Center & ERGO Half Marathon Expo at the Palaio Faliro Indoor Stadium – Taekwondo Venue. Full hydration and energy support is available along the course. Participants compete at their own risk, and no medical certificates are required. A cancellation policy allows refunds until February 8, 2026. Also held are 5-kilometer races, a Family Run, and special categories for people with disabilities. The event includes the Family Run, the Special Olympics Hellas race, and activities such as the ERGO HALF MARATHON EXPO, with major courses and activities for everyone.

name: Στα Βήματα του Ζορμπά
description: The “In the Footsteps of Zorba” race is held in Kolindros, Pieria, and features 13 km and 4 km courses, as well as a 500-metre children’s race. The event highlights the area’s historical and cultural heritage, offering participants a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings, with panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains. The race is open to athletes aged 12 and over, with special requirements for minors. It is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which is responsible for organizing and supporting the event.
course_highlights: 13 km and 4 km courses in Kolindros, Pieria
Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains
500-metre children’s race for younger athletes
additional: Athletes aged 15 and over may enter the 13 km race, while athletes aged 12 and over may enter the 4 km race when accompanied by an adult. The event also includes a 500-metre children’s race. SMF SPORTS provides event organization, electronic timing, and sportswear sales services. Technical courses, online registration, medical support, commemorative medals and participant gifts, cultural events, and local traditions.

name: 6η Γύρα Μάνης
organizer: Ο Ελληνικός Σύνδεσμος Αγώνων Μεγάλων Αποστάσεων 'ΟΙ ΑΘΑΝΑΤΟΙ'
description: The 6th Mani Loop is an 80.5-kilometer ultradistance road race held in the Inner Mani region, starting and finishing in Areopoli. The course is a complete loop of Inner Mani and runs entirely on paved roads. The race has historical significance, as it takes place near March 17, the day the 1821 Revolution began in Mani, and this year is dedicated to the Battle of Diros and the Maniot woman. It is open to runners who have completed a marathon or ultradistance race in the past two years, and has a 12-hour time limit.
course_highlights: A complete loop of Inner Mani, starting and finishing in Areopoli
An 80.5 km course entirely on paved roads
Passes through historic villages and areas including the Diros Caves, Gerolimenas, and Mezapos Beach
additional: The race starts in front of the statue of Petrobey Mavromichalis in Areopoli’s central square. Runners sing the national anthem before the start. The time limit is 12 hours. To participate, runners must have completed a marathon or ultradistance race in the past two years. The race is an 80.5 km ultradistance event on paved roads, with a 12-hour time limit, and is a cultural and sporting celebration in Mani.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: DRC X URC Run is a friendly running event in central Athens, offering a chance to enjoy a light run and socialize with other runners. The route offers 5 km and 8 km options, with different paces to suit each participant. The run starts at the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion, creating a lovely atmosphere for a running morning. Participation is free and limited to 200 places, so runners are encouraged to sign up quickly.
course_highlights: 5 km and 8 km routes in central Athens
Starting point: the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion
A chance to enjoy a light run at different paces (5 km at 6:30 pace, 8 km at 6:00 pace)
additional: Participation is free and limited to 200 places. Participants can choose the pace that suits them and run with other runners in central Athens. The event also includes an open light run and activities in central Athens, and is part of a series of running events organized by DRC and URC.

name: 10ο Women’s Run
description: The 10th Women's Run is a non-competitive 5-kilometer road race organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Chios, with the aim of honoring women. The course is flat and runs through the center of Chios, starting and finishing at the Central Square (Chios Town Hall). The race offers an enjoyable experience for all participants, with benefits including a T-shirt, medal, and commemorative certificate. The race starts at 11:30 a.m. and is open to women over 18, with minors permitted to participate with parental consent.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course in the center of Chios
Start and finish at Central Square (Chios Town Hall)
Kilometer markers at every kilometer
additional: Registration includes a race bib bearing the participant’s full name, a T-shirt with logos, a commemorative certificate, and a medal. Medical coverage is provided, along with support stations offering bottled water at the start and finish. The time limit is one hour (race ends at 13:00). The race-pack collection point is Chios Town Hall, open Friday 6/03/2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 7/03/2026 from 10:00 to 13:00. Cancellations are accepted only until 28/2/2026, with refunds issued after deductions. The race takes place at Chios Central Square and promotes women’s sport and health, with participants from across the island and beyond.

name: 5ος Γύρος Περιβολίων
organizer: ΕΘΝΙΚΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΑΓΩΓΗ ΠΕΡΙΒΟΛΙΩΝ Ο ΘΗΣΕΥΣ
description: The Perivolia Loop is a road race held in the Perivolia area of Chania, offering 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes. The event is aimed at athletes, runners, and nature lovers, with the goal of promoting sportsmanship and showcasing the natural beauty of the area. The routes include running and power walking, while the 1 km race is specially designed for primary school children. The start and finish are in the Perivolia area, with electronic timing for the longer distances.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes in the Perivolia area
Running and power walking in a natural setting
Special 1 km route for primary school children, with group starts
additional: Registration is online only and entries are made in participants’ names. Pets are allowed under constant supervision and on a leash. The 10 km race follows a single trail route and is electronically timed. The 1 km race starts in groups of 50 participants. 1, 5, and 10 km routes, children's race, awards, participant benefits, natural landscape, routes with urban and natural features.

name: 7ο Via Egnatia Run
description: The VIA EGNATIA RUN is a sporting event organized by the Regional Unit of Evros and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace. It is an innovative initiative that connects the history and culture of the Ancient Via Egnatia with sport, offering runners a unique experience. The route follows the ancient Via Egnatia, which once linked Constantinople with Rome, and aims to bring people together through sport and culture. The race includes certified half-marathon and 5-kilometer routes, offering options for runners of different abilities.
course_highlights: 21.0975-meter route (half-marathon) certified by AIMS
5,000-meter route certified by AIMS
Route following the ancient Via Egnatia, a historic and cultural trail
additional: The race includes various categories, with participants of all abilities, and takes place in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli, with an emphasis on the community and cultural heritage of the area.

name: 17ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Καλαμπάκα – Τρίκαλα
description: The 17th Kalambaka–Trikala “Thanasis Stamopoulos” Half Marathon is one of the fastest half marathons in Greece and Europe, with a slightly downhill course that starts in historic Kalambaka and finishes in the heart of Trikala. The event honors the memory of Thanasis Stamopoulos, a founding member of the Trikala Runners’ Club, and attracts thousands of runners from across Greece and abroad. Alongside the classic half marathon, the event offers 5K, 5K for people with disabilities, and a 1K children’s race, making it a celebration for all ages and levels. The course features beautiful scenery and both historic and modern landmarks, while the atmosphere is full of excitement and support from spectators.
course_highlights: Slightly downhill course from Kalambaka to Trikala
Route through the Thessalian plain, with beautiful scenery
Passes historic and modern landmarks in the city of Trikala
additional: The race starts at Kalambaka Central Square and finishes at Trikala Central Square. There is one water station every 5 kilometers in the half marathon and every 2.5 kilometers in the 5K. All participants receive a technical commemorative T-shirt, and finishers receive a medal. There are parallel races for people with disabilities and a 1K children’s race. The event emphasizes safety and smooth organization in accordance with EOSLMA-Y regulations. It includes parallel events and volunteering opportunities, with registration through the official website.

name: Piraeus Port Run
description: The Piraeus Port Run is a landmark road race held in Piraeus in memory of Piraeus-born runner Christos Vartzaki. The event offers 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a 1 km race for children, with an emphasis on a safe, high-quality running experience and showcasing the city’s seafront. It is an established event in Piraeus’s sporting calendar and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Piraeus and the Piraeus Health Runners’ Club. The event places particular importance on supporting runners and providing medical care during the race.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km races, plus a 1 km race for children
Piraeus seafront
Medical support at the start, along the course and at the finish
additional: Medical support at the start, along the course and at the finish. Bottled water and a banana are provided at the finish. Participation is available by age category and for people with disabilities, with this indicated during registration. Minors participate under the responsibility of their guardians. The event takes place along the seafront and features 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races for children. Online registration.
