name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The 1st Igoumenitsa Road Race (Igoumenitsa City Run) is organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners’ Association in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The event features 10,000m and 5,000m races, as well as a 1,000m children’s race for primary school students. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center, offering a unique experience on a beautiful urban route. The race is dedicated to the memory of young Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: 10,000m and 5,000m routes through the city of Igoumenitsa
A 1,000m children’s race for primary school students
Start and finish at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:35 a.m. The race is dedicated to the memory of Maximos Lamprousis. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center. Organized in the coastal zone, with participation open to all ages and levels, plus a celebration and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kalligonios Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual road race offering events for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race combines an athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s scenery, attracting runners of all ages and abilities. The event is friendly and offers all participants an enjoyable experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km and 9 km routes featuring natural scenery and historical monuments
1,000 m race for Special Olympics participants and children
Discounts on accommodation and transport for participants
additional: An event focused on cultural and athletic experiences, with entries in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to be opening soon.

name: 5ο Coast To Coast Race
location: Παραλία Παχιάς Άμμου, Ιεράπετρα, Λασίθι, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: The Coast to Coast Race in Ierapetra, Crete, is a 21,100-meter half marathon that starts at Pachia Ammos Beach and finishes at Minos Square in Ierapetra. The route crosses the narrowest part of Crete, passing through picturesque villages and the Ha Gorge, while the final kilometers offer an introduction to the city’s most important sights. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race are also held, offering a complete sporting experience for everyone. The race has a cultural and tourism focus and is organized by the Ierapetra Runners’ Club.
course_highlights: Route from Pachia Ammos Beach to Minos Square in Ierapetra
Passes through Ha Gorge and the villages of Episkopi, Pano Chorio, Kato Chorio, and Kentri
Finish with views of the South Cretan Sea (Libyan Sea) and an introduction to Ierapetra’s sights
additional: Half-marathon participants are transported by buses organized by the event from Minos Square until 8:00 a.m. The 5,000-meter race and the 5,000-meter Health Run and Power Walking event start and finish at Minos Square in Ierapetra. There is also a 1,000-meter children’s race. The event includes running races and walking, with routes through a scenic area and preparatory events. Participants can enjoy Crete’s beautiful nature and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The “I Run for the Spring of Life” road race is held under the auspices of the Attica Region and with the support of the Friends’ Association of P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. It is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 4 km races, as well as a 500 m race for people with disabilities. The races start and finish on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The courses are looped and pass by notable landmarks in the Municipality of Dionysos, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The event is open to runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Looped 10 km course (2 × 5 km), starting and finishing on Drosias Avenue in Stamata
4 km course for middle-school boys and girls and adults
500 m race open to people with disabilities
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in the Municipality of Dionysos. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veterans’ categories. Runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes are eligible to participate. The start and finish are at the corner of Drosias–Stamata Avenue and Solomou Street, with designated turnarounds on the 2.5 km and 2 km courses. All participation supports charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The start and finish are on Neapoli’s pedestrian street, and the course runs along the old Tsotyli–Neapoli national road. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over, offering a pleasant experience on a public road with support from the local traffic police. The event uses wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a public road, starting from the Tsotyli Health Center
5 km course, starting from the junction in the village of Peristera
1 km children’s race, starting from the kiosk at the entrance to Neapoli
additional: Participants collect a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave starts, with runners assigned to start blocks based on their times. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own risk on the sidewalk. The event includes courses on public roads and pedestrian streets, with support from volunteers and awards for the winners. The event takes place on 28 March 2027.

name: 4ο Serres Circuit Run
description: The 4th Serres Circuit Run is a major running event returning to Serres, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The race takes place at the Serres Autodrome, a purpose-built venue combining safety with an exciting course. The event is supported by the Municipality of Serres, with the aim of promoting sport and the local community. It brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, dynamic setting.
course_highlights: Course at the Serres Autodrome, a purpose-built racing venue
A safe, well-organized environment for runners of all levels
Organized by the Municipality of Serres, with an emphasis on the local community and sport
additional: The event includes various categories and ultradistance races, with certified courses and international participation. It takes place at the Serres city autodrome on March 27, 2027.

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Road Race “The Park 10K” is being held for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritsis Park. This is a cross-country race with 5- and 10-kilometer courses, supported by the Metropolitan Park Management Agency and organized for charity, benefiting MDA Hellas. The race attracts runners of all ages and abilities who enjoy running in nature and supporting their community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Antonis Tritsis Environmental Awareness Park
5- and 10-kilometer courses through a natural setting
Access through five main entrances, with Entrance A recommended as it is near the start
additional: Tritsis Park can be accessed through five entrances; Entrance A, near the start, is recommended. The race is supported by the Park Management Agency and benefits MDA Hellas. It promotes social awareness, the protection of Tritsis Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while offering people of all ages the chance to enjoy sports in a natural setting.

name: OPENING SEASON-награден фонд 3 000 € Ultra Trail Run&XCM Cycling
location: Clearing above the Rakiya Kazan, Ayazmoto Park (Metropolitan Methodius Kusev Park), Stara Zagora, Bulgaria
organizer: Клуб по колоездене и туризъм „Сърнена гора“
description: OPENING SEASON 2027 is the fourth anniversary edition of the iconic race in Stara Zagora, opening the sports season with a record prize pool of €5,000. Organized by the Sarnena Gora Cycling and Tourism Club with the support of Stara Zagora Municipality, the event features Ultra Trail Run and XCM Cycling disciplines. The race offers a variety of distances with different difficulty levels and course markings, following scenic routes through Mitropolit Metodiy Kusev Park (Ayazmoto).
course_highlights: Dynamic 5 km course within the park, marked in white
Moderately challenging 11 km distance with yellow markings and moderate elevation gain
The royal 42 km distance, marked in orange and featuring the challenges of the Sarnena Gora
additional: Registration and collection of race packs and numbers with timing chips from 06:30 to 08:30. Technical briefing before the start. Cycling (XCM & E-Bike) starts at 09:00; running races at various distances (5, 11, 21, 34, 42 km) start at 09:30. Grand awards ceremony at 17:00. Routes are marked with different colors for each distance. The start and finish are on the meadow above the rakia still. According to the published schedule, registration is from 06:30 to 08:30, cycling starts at 09:00, and running starts at 09:30.

name: Danube 24h Run 2026
description: Danube 24h Run is an ultramarathon held in the city of Ruse at the City Stadium. Participants can choose between the 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour events, or a 3 x 2-hour relay. The event offers an endurance challenge and is suitable for runners with different levels of fitness.
course_highlights: Ruse City Stadium is the start and finish venue
Individual running and relay options
Events of different durations: 24 hours, 12 hours, 6 hours and a relay
additional: For the 2026 edition, the 24-hour and 6-hour runs are scheduled to start on March 28 at 11:00, the 12-hour run at 23:00, and the relay on March 29 at 06:00. The race date listed in the metadata differs from the dates on the edition pages.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: The 9th Spercheios Half Marathon “Athanasios Akridas” is held in Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the support of the Municipality of Makrakomi and the Spercheiada Municipal Community. This road race celebrates the area’s traditions and natural beauty, offering a unique experience for runners who love running and nature. The event is a celebration of sport and social responsibility, aiming to promote grassroots sport and encourage volunteering.
course_highlights: Route in Spercheiada, Phthiotis
Natural surroundings and local history
Support from local organizations and environmental awareness
additional: The race is supported by the Municipality of Makrakomi, the Spercheiada Municipal Community, and Goulinas Adventure. The Thessaloniki Runners’ Health Association (S.D.Y.TH.) organizes accompanying training sessions and night training sessions in the Seich Sou area. The race promotes sports education, social responsibility, and environmental protection, especially of the Seich Sou suburban forest. A technical course in Spercheiada’s central square, with road races, children’s races, and participation from local clubs. Rules and participation instructions are available.

name: 44ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Δήμου Φιλοθέης – Ψυχικού
description: The 44th Filothei-Psychiko Municipality Road Race is an annual sporting event held in the areas of Filothei and Psychiko in Athens. The race offers runners of all ages the chance to take part in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko and promotes physical activity and social solidarity in the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, race day.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer route in the Filothei-Psychiko area
Organized by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko
An opportunity for runners of all levels to participate
additional: The race will take place on Sunday, March 22, 2027, with an emphasis on the local community and promoting sports. Information about routes and registration has not been officially announced.

name: 2ο DUTH Campus Half Marathon
organizer: Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης και Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ροδόπης
description: The DUTH Campus Half Marathon is being held for the third consecutive year at the Democritus University of Thrace campus in Komotini. It features two distances, 7,000 meters and 21,000 meters, on a smooth, flat dirt course within the university campus. Entry is free, and electronic timing is provided, along with a commemorative medal for all finishers. In addition, the top three finishers in each race and age category receive trophies. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with the start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science.
course_highlights: Smooth, flat dirt course within the DUTH campus
Two distances: 7,000 m and 21,000 m
Start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science
additional: Entry is free. Electronic timing and overall and individual results are provided. All finishers receive a commemorative collectible medal. Trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in each race and age category. A medical examination is required for all athletes and for the parents or guardians of underage athletes. The event is held with the support of the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science, with commemorative medals, trophies, and family activities. The course is flat and suitable for all runners.

name: 2ο Vertical Challenge
description: The 2nd Vertical Challenge is an international “vertical kilometer” mountain running race held in Gerakas, Xanthi, organized by the Xanthi Mountaineering Club in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi. Athletes start in the village of Gerakas and follow a 3.5 km uphill route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m. The Gerakas Trail and Gerakas Path races are also held, featuring circular routes of varying difficulty and distance. The event welcomes runners aged 12 and over, with special requirements for younger participants. Registration is individual and takes place online through the club’s website.
course_highlights: Vertical Challenge: 3.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain on trails, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m
Gerakas Trail: circular 8.5 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Gerakas Path: easy circular 5 km route with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Maximum number of participants in the 2nd Vertical Challenge: 80. ITRA score must be provided if available. Individual registrations only. Open to participants aged 12 and over, with special requirements for ages 16–18. Organized in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi, with limited places and registration through the website.

name: 3ος Παράκτιος Ημιμαραθώνιος Θερμαϊκού Αντώνης Ματζάρης
description: The Thermaikos Coastal Half Marathon “Antonis Matzaris” is a distinctive running event in eastern Thessaloniki, offering unique routes along the coastline of the Municipality of Thermaikos. Held on a fixed date and attracting large numbers of runners, the race combines sport and social action, drawing families and runners of all levels. The event aims to establish itself as an important sporting occasion with a quality focus and a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A coastal route of unique beauty
Routes suitable for the whole family
Impressive performances and runner participation
additional: A limited number of new registrations are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the Registration Centre on Friday 27.3.2026 and Saturday 28.3.2026. The race includes parallel events and volunteering. The event follows the standards of major international races and is held on a fixed date. It is supported by local clubs and organizations, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and community participation, and includes starts and finishes from Wellness Santa Hotel.

name: 5ος Μυρμιδόνων Αθλος
description: The 5th Myrmidons Athlos is a challenging mountain running race organized by the Municipality of Farsala in collaboration with the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Clubs, the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Club, and Running Team Farsala. The race covers 21 kilometers, with approximately 1,000 meters of both elevation gain and loss, offering an exciting experience in a natural mountain setting. The 2nd Myrmidons Mini Trail is also organized alongside it, covering a shorter distance for runners seeking a shorter route. The event aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the Farsala area.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance with +1,000 m of elevation gain and loss
Mountain running in a natural setting around Farsala
A shorter mini-trail race is held alongside the main event
additional: The race features highly challenging routes, with an emphasis on showcasing the area's natural and cultural wealth, and welcomes participants from various age categories.

name: 5ο Pravi Trail Run
description: The EleftheroupoliRunners Sports and Cultural Association of the Municipality of Pangaio organizes the 5th Pravi Trail Run in Eleftheroupoli. The race offers three routes of 21.5 km, 12 km, and 5 km, all starting and finishing in Eleftheroupoli. The 21.5 km route is of moderate difficulty and includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt. The 12 km route is also of moderate difficulty. The 5 km route is easy and suitable for beginners, offering an introduction to trail running.
course_highlights: 21.5 km route with 16 km of trails, 2.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
12 km route with 8 km of trails, 1.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
Easy 5 km loop route for beginners to trail running
additional: Maximum participants: 300 for 21.5 km, 200 for 12 km, and 200 for 5 km. Time limit: 5 hours. Minimum age: 15; parental consent is required for participants aged 15–18. Start and finish at the Eleftheroupoli public market venue. Registration includes a commemorative gift. Registration deadline: 23/03/2026.

name: 5ο Run For Autism Half Marathon
description: The 5th consecutive Run for Autism in Ayia Napa offers a unique experience with the addition of the half-marathon distance. This charity event supports the Smile Project Day Centre for young people with autism, promoting awareness and inclusion. The courses are flat and fast, suitable for personal bests, and also include 10K and 5K races, as well as children’s races. The event attracts runners from across Cyprus and abroad, offering a festive atmosphere with music, support, and plenty of activities.
course_highlights: Half-marathon on a flat, fast two-lap course along the coastline
Passes through Ayia Napa Marina, with views of luxury yachts and crystal-clear waters
Finish at Nissi Beach, with the opportunity to cool off with a swim after the race
additional: Official pacers are available for all distances to help runners achieve their goals. The courses have aid stations with isotonic drinks, fruit, soft drinks, and medical support. Runners are encouraged to be at the start line at least half an hour before the start. Roads are closed to traffic, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort. The event includes a half-marathon, 10K, 5K, children’s races, and a 500-meter race, with the aim of raising awareness and supporting people with autism. Registration closes on 1 March 2026.

name: 8ος Δρόμος 21 Μαθητών
description: The Makrochori Cultural Association of Imathia “PSIFIDOTO,” in collaboration with the Sports Department of the Municipality of Veria and the Local Folklore Association of Makrochori and Surrounding Areas, is organizing the popular memorial race “8th Race of the 21 Students.” The event includes races for adults and children: a 10,700-meter main race, a 2,500-meter health walk, and races for primary and secondary school students. The course is on paved roads, with no significant elevation changes, and takes place in Makrochori, Imathia. The event has a charitable purpose and honors the memory of the 21 students.
course_highlights: 10,700-meter paved course with no significant elevation changes
2,500-meter health walk for adults
1,000-meter and 1,500-meter races for primary and secondary school students
additional: Online registration has closed for all categories. Late registrations are accepted only if race numbers are available, on Saturday or Sunday morning at the Makrochori Cultural Association office. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:15. Courses are on paved roads; participants take part at their own risk. Registration is through the website, with categories separated by age and race distance.

name: 8ος Κροκόδειλος Trail
description: The 8th Crocodile Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Paleochora, Chania, Crete. The 20.5-kilometer course, with 1,200 meters of elevation gain, starts on Sougia’s coastal road and follows technical trails, rocky terrain, and historic sites such as Ancient Lissos. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and respect for the environment, offering a unique running experience in southwestern Crete. The event includes athlete transfers, a pasta party, and a post-finish meal.
course_highlights: A technical, rocky trail with 4 sharp “teeth” on the elevation profile
Passes historic sites such as the Temple of Asclepius and the ancient theater of Lissos
Views of the bay of Ancient Lissos and the South Cretan Sea
additional: Athlete transfers from Paleochora to Sougia take place about 1 hour before the start. The pasta party and race-pack pickup take place on Saturday before the race. The last athlete must pass the Gialiskari station at 10 km before the cutoff time. After the finish, there is an awards ceremony and a meal. The course is 20.5 kilometers long with 1,200 meters of elevation gain, and the race emphasizes technical difficulty and the beauty of the natural surroundings. The event also includes the 6.5-kilometer Kolisaura Run.

name: 10ος Αραφήνειος Δρόμος
location: Δημοτικό Κολυμβητήριο Ραφήνας, Ραφήνα, Ανατολική Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 10th Araphineios Road Race is a major celebration of sport in the Municipality of Rafina-Pikermi, which has become an established event with strong community and athletic participation. The event brings people and organizations together, showcasing the city as a vibrant center of sport and culture. Rafina’s central square is transformed into a hub of activity and entertainment, with sports activities, music, and events for all ages.
course_highlights: Event held in Rafina’s central square
Sports activities and fitness activities by PROTYPO FITNESS CLUB
Cheerleading performance and music by the Rafina-Pikermi Municipal Philharmonic
additional: Race bibs and athlete kits can be collected from 09:00 to 19:00. Activities, refreshments, and event sponsors are present throughout the day. The event includes music and sports demonstrations. The event features races on certified courses, with participants aged 6 and over, and is held with the support of the police and volunteers. Participation is free or requires a small fee, and the event is accompanied by cultural and community activities.

description: The Nafplio Marathon is a special road race that combines sport, history, and natural beauty in the beautiful city of Nafplio. Runners of all levels have the opportunity to enjoy courses passing through historic and natural landscapes while taking part in a friendly, well-organized event. The event offers a range of benefits and gives participants the opportunity to visit archaeological sites in Argolis free of charge. The Marathon is a celebration for the city and its runners, with a strong cultural character and social dimension.
course_highlights: Courses combining sport, history, and natural beauty
Free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis for participants
Showcasing monuments and archaeological sites in Nafplio, Palamidi, Tiryns, Mycenae, and Epidaurus
additional: Participants receive a race number (BIB), electronic timing, a technical T-shirt, printed informational materials, a participation certificate, race photos, a finisher’s medal, and a bag. Registration fees can be paid only by card or IRIS. Unpaid registrations are automatically canceled. Volunteers are an important part of the event. Runners receive free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis on race day and the following day. The event includes accompanying cultural, educational, and social activities, races for the marathon, half marathon, 5 km, and a 1 km race for students, as well as cultural programs and trips.

name: 10ος Εύκλειος Αγώνας Βουνού & 6ο Υμηττός Marathon
description: The 10th Efkleios Mountain Race and the 6th Hymettus Marathon are organized by the South Athens Runners Association “EFKLIS” and offer a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Hymettus. The routes include a variety of distances and elevation profiles, with certified courses and water stations. The event is supported by volunteer groups and local organizations, and provides electronic timing, medals, and refreshments for participants. The start is in Argyroupoli, and the atmosphere is friendly and safe for all runners.
course_highlights: 18 km course with electronic timing and live location tracking
47 km Hymettus Marathon with +2,150 m elevation gain and 2 ITRA points
Water stations at key points along the course
additional: Electronic timing uses a chip, and runners’ locations are displayed in real time. The race office distributes race packs from 07:00, strictly for athletes from outside Attica. Payment is by card online only and must be made within five days of registration. Volunteers receive an event T-shirt, a backpack, snacks, water, juice, and a medal. Mountain races and marathons, routes on Mount Hymettus, road and mountain race entries, technical T-shirts and equipment, electronic timing.

name: 14ος Βαλλιάνειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 14th Vallianeios Popular Road Race in Argostoli is one of Kefalonia’s most important and beloved sporting events, with a continuous presence for 14 years. The main 10-kilometer race follows a beautiful, accessible route along the waterfront, combining sea views with the natural landscape. Children’s races and a dedicated route for people with disabilities are also organized, reinforcing the event’s inclusive character. The event is accompanied by music, dance, and sporting activities, offering a complete celebration of sport for everyone.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the waterfront promenade lined with palm trees
Turnaround near the “Oscar” restaurant and return to the Central Square
Dedicated route for people with disabilities and children’s races ranging from 50 to 100+ meters
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal, and winners in each category are honored with special awards. The event is co-organized with the Municipality of Argostoli and held under the auspices of the Vallianeios Bequest. Last-minute registration is available for a limited number of runners only, on a first-come, first-served basis. Various routes and age categories, volunteer participation, and events for the public. Includes 10 km and children’s routes.

name: 29ος Δρόμος Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudoumas Run is a challenging trail-running and hiking event held in the area of Sternes, Heraklion, Crete. The 22.5-kilometer route crosses mountainous, difficult terrain, with 9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road, starting in Sternes and finishing at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas. The event offers free transport for athletes from Heraklion, and a meal is served to participants after the race. The event is welcoming and emphasizes safety and a positive experience for runners.
course_highlights: A challenging 22.5-kilometer mountain route
9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road
Finish at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas, with a meal after the awards ceremony
additional: Free bus transport for athletes from Eleftherios Venizelos Square, Heraklion, at 07:30 a.m. on race day. Race time limit: 3 hours. Prizes for the top 3 in each category and commemorative gifts for all participants. Categories by age and gender, with a minimum of 4 participants per category. Categories are available for various age groups. Transport from Heraklion; a meal is provided after the race. Participants take part at their own responsibility. Three-hour time limit.

name: PepsiCo Gives Back – Kifissia
location: Πλατεία Ηρώων Πολυτεχνείου, Κάτω Κηφισιά, Greece
description: The PepsiCo Gives Back - Kifissia event is a charity road race held in Kato Kifisia, starting and finishing at Heroes of Polytechnic Square. It features timed 5 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities. The event is open to runners of all ages, and proceeds go to charitable causes. RUNAWAY provides technical support, making this an enjoyable and socially beneficial sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the circular road around Heroes of Polytechnic Square
Timed 5 km and 10 km races
Untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities
additional: The 5 km and 10 km races are timed. The 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races are untimed. Companions of people with disabilities and parents may participate without a race bib, starting at the back of the course. The event is charitable, with proceeds going to charitable causes. Registration is available through an online form, with various categories and age groups and a participation fee. The event takes place in Kato Kifisia, starting at Heroes of Polytechnic Square.

description: Run Greece Heraklion offers a unique road-running experience in the heart of Crete, with 10 km and 5 km races, a children’s race, and a Family Run. The race starts at Eleftherias Square and passes through the city’s main streets, offering beautiful views and support throughout. The organizers ensure runners’ safety and comfort with medical coverage and electronic timing. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. After finishing, runners receive a medal and a certificate of participation.
course_highlights: Start at Eleftherias Square, Dikaiosynis Avenue
Route through the city of Heraklion, with safety measures and support
Electronic timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: Registration includes a bib with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher’s medal, a certificate of participation with times, and an official race T-shirt. Full medical coverage is provided, including medical services and volunteer rescuers. Registrations are automatically canceled if the participation fee is not paid. Race bibs can be collected three days before the race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social participation, with various categories and activities for the whole family.

name: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo
location: Център на село Марково, Plovdiv Province, Bulgaria
organizer: Спортен клуб по планинско бягане и туризъм „Пловдив и Родопа“
description: Plovdiv Hills in Markovo is a mountain running race held in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains, around the village of Markovo in Plovdiv Province. The race offers four distances—8, 12, 22 and 44 km—as well as a 700-metre children’s course. Participants can enjoy well-marked and secured courses with aid stations providing water, food and drinks. Race services include timing, electronic results tracking, medical assistance and special race packs with gifts. The event is held under the auspices of Markovo mayor’s office and organised by the Plovdiv and Rhodope Mountain Running and Tourism Sports Club.
course_highlights: Courses of 8, 12, 22 and 44 km in the foothills of the Rhodope Mountains
Aid stations with water, electrolytes, fruit, snacks and special food
Well-marked and secured routes with timing and electronic results tracking
additional: Race packs include a race number, gifts and surprises from sponsors. The 8 km race includes a designer headband; the 12 and 22 km races include a designer organic cotton T-shirt; and the 44 km race includes a designer fleece vest. A headlamp is mandatory equipment. The children’s race is 700 metres long and free for children up to 8 years old. Parking is arranged on streets marked in red; motor vehicles are not permitted in the start/finish area. The awards ceremony begins at 12:00 and takes place in stages. In editions for which information is available, the start and expo area are in the centre of Markovo. Information about the distances and conditions refers to previous editions.

name: 3ο Kefalonia Backyard Ultra
price_range: Τελικές Τιμές για Αθλητές (μετά την έκπτωση 50%)
description: The 3rd Kefalonia Backyard Ultra is an ultra-distance backyard ultra race held in Argostoli, Kefalonia. Runners are invited to run a 6,706-meter loop, completing one lap every hour until only one winner remains. The event aims to bring participants closer to nature and challenge them to push their limits, offering a unique endurance and sporting experience on the beautiful island of Kefalonia.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop
Run one lap every hour until only one runner remains
Kefalonia’s natural setting, with mountains and sea
additional: The event offers athletes significant benefits, including free travel with Ionion Pelagos Lines and a 50% discount with Levante Ferries. The race consists of consecutive one-hour laps, with participants aiming to run for as long as they can. Supported by local sponsors, the event has continued to improve, offering a high-standard endurance and hospitality experience. The race features continuous laps on a loop course, with a fueling strategy and support from the organizing team. Registration is required, and the course is suitable for runners with endurance and strategic skills.

name: 78ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιέρας Πόλης Μεσολογγίου
location: Ιερά Μονή του Αγίου Συμεών, Μεσολόγγι, Greece
description: The 78th Road of Sacrifice of the Sacred City of Mesolongi is a historic road race held as part of the celebrations marking the anniversary of the historic Exodus. The race honors the people of Mesolongi who sacrificed themselves for the ideals of freedom and is the oldest road race in the country. The route starts at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon, where the Besieged Free Greeks took refuge, and finishes in the city’s Garden of Heroes, covering a total of 9,800 meters. This route has special historical and symbolic significance, offering participants a unique athletic and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Start at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon, a historic refuge for the Besieged Free Greeks
Finish in the Garden of Heroes in the city of Mesolongi
Total distance of 9,800 meters, with historical and symbolic significance
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. The route starts at the Holy Monastery of Agios Symeon and finishes in the city’s Garden of Heroes. The race honors the historic sacrifice of the people of Mesolongi and the Philhellenes during the Exodus of Mesolongi. The event includes three participation categories, participation for over-2500s, ages up to 17, participation via QR code, and takes place on a walking route around Mesolongi.

name: Evia Ultra Trail
description: The Evia Ultra Trail is a demanding mountain race held in the area of Steni, Evia. It offers a unique experience for runners who love the mountains and adventure, with routes crossing natural trails and scenic landscapes. The race is an important event for the local community and attracts runners from across Greece and abroad. The event is professionally organized and welcoming, with an emphasis on participant safety and support.
course_highlights: Mountain route with natural trails
Impressive landscapes of Steni, Evia
Support stations along the route
additional: The race includes 30 km routes with recorded support stations. It is included in the ITRA - UTMB Index for 2026. The organizers provide a technical briefing and race regulations for participants. The race includes aid stations, medical support, and different routes for runners of all levels, with an emphasis on safety and enjoying nature.

name: Helicon Mountain Race
description: The Helicon Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held at the Krya Springs in Livadeia. It offers courses of various distances, from 5.6 km to 38 km, through a captivating natural environment with rugged terrain and lush vegetation. The race is certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and offers nature and adventure enthusiasts a unique opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable mountain-running experience. A free yoga session is also offered for relaxation and recovery.
course_highlights: A range of courses from 5.6 to 38 km in a mountain setting
Certified by the International Skyrunning Federation
Natural landscape with lush vegetation and rugged terrain
additional: A free yoga session will be held on Saturday 4/4 at 15:00 at the Krya Open-Air Theatre; registration is required. You can also volunteer at the event by completing a dedicated form. Multiple courses, environmental awareness, local hospitality and cultural experiences, with a focus on mountain nature and adventure.

description: The Run Greece race in Syros offers a unique road-running experience, with 10 km and 5 km races, a children’s race, and a Family Run. The races start at Miaouli Square and combine urban and coastal scenery, making them ideal for runners of all levels. The event provides electronic timing, medical coverage, and finisher medals, creating a friendly and safe environment for all participants. Adults and children can take part, with special rates for students in group registrations.
course_highlights: Start in front of the Town Hall on Eleftheriou Venizelou Street
10 km and 5 km routes through the town and coastal area
Organized support with stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Entry to the 10 km race includes a race bib with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher medal, a participation certificate with times, and an official T-shirt. Medical coverage is provided by medical services and volunteer rescuers along the route. Registrations are automatically canceled if the entry fee is not paid. Race numbers and materials are collected before the race, with instructions sent by email. The race consists of four laps of the 10 km route, starting at Miaouli Square and finishing in front of the Town Hall. Registration closes a few days before the race.

name: Велинград Ултра
price_range: 23 евро за тениска, други цени не са посочени
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon offering three challenging courses in Velingrad, the Spa Capital of the Balkans. Participants can choose from 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain courses with varying elevation gain, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event offers professional organization, marked courses, aid stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: Courses of 11 km (520 m elevation gain), 27 km (1,420 m elevation gain), and 43 km (2,100 m elevation gain)
Mountain terrain with marked trails and aid stations
Start and finish in the center of Velingrad—the Spa Capital of the Balkans
additional: Race packs include a medal, an event-logo souvenir, timing, and a race number. Registration and race-pack collection are from 07:00 to 11:00 on race day. Cutoff times are set for the 27 km and 43 km distances. Event T-shirts are available for purchase for 23 euros. Mandatory additional equipment is not included in the race pack. The courses include different distances; registration is on 4 April 2026. The event includes medals, photos, and aid stations; additional equipment is required.

name: 1ος Μαραθώνιος Ηπείρου «Βασιλιάς Πύρρος»
description: The Epirus “King Pyrrhus” Marathon is a historic, fast marathon held in the city of Arta, on a course certified by World Athletics. The course is flat and runs along the Arachthos River, offering ideal weather conditions for runners aiming for a personal best. The race honors King Pyrrhus, an important ancient leader of Epirus, and combines sport with the region’s history and culture. The event includes a marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Arachthos River
Passes the historic Bridge of Arta
Start and finish at the statue of King Pyrrhus, Kilkis Square
additional: There are ample refreshment stations with bottled water on all courses. Timing uses a disposable chip that does not need to be returned. Electronic timing is provided, with checkpoints. Awards are presented after the races. Group registration is available for teams of 10 or more, with no restrictions on race selection. The event includes road races and regional routes, with an emphasis on the area’s cultural and historical significance. Registration opens soon, and the event is expected to attract runners from across Greece and abroad.

name: 2ο Amanitis Trail
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The Amanitis Trail 2027 offers a unique mountain-running experience in central Chios, starting from the picturesque semi-mountainous village of Avgonyma, with views of the Aegean Sea. The 40-kilometer route passes through historic and natural landscapes, including the medieval village of Anavatos and remote Agios Sideros, with a mix of trails, dirt roads, and panoramic views. The finish is back in Avgonyma, completing an authentic adventure through the island’s nature and history. Shorter 7- and 21-kilometer routes are also available, suitable for beginners and more experienced runners, respectively.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the traditional village of Avgonyma, overlooking the Aegean Sea
Route passes through the medieval castle-village of Anavatos
Sections through lush ravines, trails, and dirt roads with panoramic views
additional: Participants receive a race bib and timing chip, aid stations along the route, a commemorative finisher’s medal, and a technical race T-shirt, with a choice of two designs available until 20/2/26. There are age categories and participation requirements for the 40KM race relating to previous experience in mountain races. Participants enjoy aid stations along the route, commemorative medals, and technical T-shirts, subject to athlete eligibility requirements and detailed race regulations.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Βόλου
price_range: Half Marathon 15€, City Race 10€, Family Run 5€, Kids Run 500m δωρεάν
description: The 10th Volos Half Marathon is a celebratory sporting event held under the auspices of the Thessaly Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and EOSLMA-Y. The event includes the half marathon, the 5 km City Race, the 2 km Family Run, and the 500 m Kids Run, attracting thousands of participants each year. It is co-organized by the Volos Health Runners’ Club, the Municipality of Volos, the Region of Thessaly, the Magnesia Chamber of Commerce, and the University of Thessaly. Registration is exclusively online, with payment by card, and the participation package includes a commemorative T-shirt for the anniversary race. The start and accompanying races offer a unique running experience in the city of Volos.
course_highlights: A 21.1 km half marathon through the city of Volos
Accompanying races: 5 km City Race, 2 km Family Run, and 500 m Kids Run
Celebratory participation package with an anniversary-race T-shirt
additional: Registration is online only, with payment by card. Participation in the 500 m Kids Run is free, with on-site registration. Participation cannot be canceled with a refund after March 20, 2026. Runners who do not collect their participation package on the day and at the time of the start will not be able to collect it later. Routes for the half marathon, 5 km race, family race, and children’s race; online registration by card; registration period from 27/10/2025 to 14/2/2026; discounts and participation packages.

name: 3ος Γιτάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 3rd Gitaneios Road Race is an important sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with showcasing the historical heritage of Thesprotia. It includes 21 km and 5 km road races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race for children aged 6 and over. The course is paved and finishes at the archaeological site of Gitana, at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana. The event aspires to become an institution connecting sports with the history and culture of the region.
course_highlights: 21 km course from the Igoumenitsa bicycle path to the Archaeological Site of Gitana
Passes along the seafront, through the plain of Ragio–Kestrini and by the Kalamas River
Finish at the iconic Ancient Theatre of Gitana
additional: Participation is free. Buses will be available from the Pantheon in Igoumenitsa to the Archaeological Site of Gitana (08:00–08:30 a.m.), with return buses after the awards ceremony. For safety reasons, vehicle traffic at and around the Ancient Theatre of Gitana will be suspended before the start of the 5 km race and the children’s race. Paved routes, cultural monuments, refreshment stations, medical coverage, age requirements for participation

name: 3ο Γρεβενά City Run
description: The 3rd Grevena City Run is a distinctive road race held in the city of Grevena. Participants will run along the city’s main streets, climb steps and pass through picturesque alleys, enjoying views of the Grevenitis River. The race offers 10 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. The start and finish are at Aimilianou Square in Grevena, offering a lovely opportunity to discover the city and experience Grevena’s hospitality.
course_highlights: Routes along the city’s main streets
Pass through alleys and climb steps
Views of the Grevenitis River
additional: A 1,000-meter race for children and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. Start and finish at Aimilianou Square, Grevena. The race’s theme is “Sports for All,” and it emphasizes strengthening social cohesion and health through sport.

name: 5ο Race For Autism Gr
description: The 5th Race For Autism Gr takes place in the Kavouri area of Vouliagmeni, with the aim of raising awareness and promoting equal participation in sports for neurodivergent people. The event is supported by the Race for Autism Gr nonprofit civil company, which organizes amateur sporting events throughout Greece. The race promotes social inclusion and the acceptance of autistic people and their families. The event is held in collaboration with the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and aims to raise awareness about autism.
course_highlights: Location: Kavouri, Vouliagmeni
Amateur 5-kilometer race
Promotes equal participation in sports for neurodivergent people
additional: The event is supported by the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and local government. A parallel swimming event, “I Swim for Autism,” takes place at the Kallithea Swimming Pool. The event promotes the acceptance, participation, and inclusion of neurodivergent people in sports. It includes running races and other awareness-raising activities, with support from the Municipality of Vouliagmeni and local organizations. The event is open to all ages and abilities, promoting social inclusion and acceptance.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Γερανείων
description: The 10th Geraneia Mountain Race is a challenging trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Geraneia Mountains, near Loutraki in the Peloponnese. Celebrating a decade of challenges and participation, the race offers runners a unique experience on trails and mountain routes. The event is supported by the Municipality of Loutraki and is an important sporting event for the area. It brings organizers and athletes together in a friendly, energetic setting.
course_highlights: Mountain course in the Geraneia Mountains
Natural scenery with trails and varied terrain
Challenging course celebrating 10 years of history
additional: The event is organized by the Municipality of Loutraki. No information was found about registration prices, start times, or special participation categories. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary and highlights the challenge of every kilometer in the mountains. The race features trail running focused on nature and challenge, and offers opportunities for preparation and training at different levels of difficulty.

name: 11ος Νικηφόρειος Δρόμος
organizer: Τμήμα Αθλητισμού Δήμου Ρεθύμνης και Σύλλογος Δρομέων Υγείας Ρεθύμνου
description: The 11th Nikephoreios Run is organized by the Sports Department of the Municipality of Rethymno and the Rethymno Health Runners Club, with the support of the Region of Crete and other local organizations. The race takes place in Rethymno, starting from Kalonyktis, and includes routes on dirt roads and trails. The event features races of various distances, a children’s race, a bike ride, and a nature walk, offering a complete sporting experience for all participants.
course_highlights: 23 km route with 8 km on dirt roads and trails
10 km route with 2 km on dirt road
Starts in Kalonyktis and passes through Agios Andreas, Gonia, Fratzeskiana, and Metochia
additional: The event also includes a 2,000 m children’s race, a 23,000 m bike ride, and a nature walk. It takes place over two days, Saturday, April 4 and Sunday, April 5, 2026, starting from Kalonyktis (Cultural Association). Bike ride routes, nature walk, refreshments, bus transfer, traditional meal at the finish.

name: 12ος Φιλανθρωπικός Αγώνας Βουνού Αυτισμός – Ελπίδα 2026
location: Περιφερειακό δάσος Δήμου Ωραιοκάστρου, Ωραιόκαστρο, Θεσσαλονίκη, Greece
organizer: Σύλλογος Φίλων Αυτιστικού Ατόμου της Μονάδας «ΕΛΠΙΔΑ»
description: The 12th Charity Mountain Race “Autism - ELPIDA” takes place in the peri-urban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro, Thessaloniki, and includes 1 km, 5+ km and 15 km courses. The 15 km course features changes in elevation, with a total elevation gain of 500 metres, offering runners a challenging and beautiful experience. The race aims to raise awareness about children with autism and support the “ELPIDA” Autism Unit. Registration includes official timing, medical support, a medal, a commemorative certificate and a snack at the finish. There is also a baggage storage area and toilets at the start/finish venue.
course_highlights: Location: peri-urban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro
15 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain
Aid stations and official timing on the 5+ km and 15 km courses
additional: Registration includes a personal bib number, official timing for the 5+ km and 15 km courses, medical support, a certificate of participation, an electronic commemorative certificate, a medal, a snack at the finish, and gifts for the three youngest participants in the 1 km race. There is a baggage storage area and toilets at the start/finish venue. Online registration has definitively closed. The full name will be printed on the bib number for those who registered by 22 March 2026. Courses: 1 km, 5+ km and 15 km; participation includes a personal bib number, official timing, medical support, a medal, gifts and baggage storage.

description: The Poikilo Rocky Mountain race takes place on Mount Poikilo in Attica, starting and finishing at Panorama Square in Petroupoli. It offers routes for everyone, from the 1 km children’s race to the longer 29 km and 18 km races, catering to runners of different levels. The event provides full support, including timing, live results, and participant amenities. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with awards and special packages for teams.
course_highlights: 29 km, 18 km, 10 km, and 4 km routes, plus a 1 km children’s race
Start and finish at Panorama Square in Petroupoli
A variety of routes in the mountainous surroundings of Mount Poikilo
additional: Group registration offers a €2 discount per athlete for teams of more than 10 people. The start pack includes a keepsake, race bib, timing chip, sponsor gifts, an energy bar, coffee, baggage storage, live results, and photography services. The race office is open the day before for the longer races and on race day for the shorter ones. The event includes a 1 km children’s race and a 4 km fun race, starting and finishing in Petroupoli. The event takes place on 11 April 2027, with an emphasis on sporting quality and environmental protection.

name: 29ος Αγώνας Δρόμου / Πεζοπορίας Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudoumas Mountain Running / Hiking Race is a challenging 22.5-kilometer mountain race starting in Sternes and finishing at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas. The route includes 9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road, offering a unique experience in a natural mountain setting. The race is intended for runners in good physical condition and has a 3-hour time limit. After the finish, participants enjoy a meal and awards in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 22.5-kilometer mountain route with 9 km uphill and 13.5 km downhill
Starts in Sternes and finishes at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas
A dirt-road route through natural scenery with challenging terrain
additional: Free bus transport for athletes from Eleftherios Venizelos Square (Heraklion) at 7:30 a.m. on race day. There are multiple age- and gender-based participation categories, with prizes for the top finishers in each category and commemorative gifts for all participants. After the awards ceremony, a meal is served in the courtyard of the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas. The race includes routes in a mountainous area, offers transport from Heraklion, and provides discounts for passengers on ANEK LINES ferries. Participation categories include various age and gender categories, with a 3-hour time limit.

price_range: 5€ για τους αγώνες 3,5 km και 10 km, δωρεάν για τον παιδικό αγώνα

description: The Leuctra Popular Cross-Country Race is a traditional road race held in Leuctra, Boeotia, and organized by the Leuctra Cultural and Educational Association. The event includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing in Leuctra’s central square. It offers an enjoyable sporting experience with a nominal entry fee, promoting local sports culture and community participation. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their timing chip.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Leuctra’s central square
1.5 km course for children, and 3.5 km and 10 km courses for adults
Traditional cross-country race with a local character
additional: Participants must arrive at least one hour before the race starts to collect their timing chip. Courses through mountainous and urban areas; collection of the timing chip is required one hour beforehand.

name: Hydra’s Trail Event
location: Hydra, Hydra Regional Unit, Attica, Greece
description: Hydra’s Trail Event is an annual trail-running race held on the island of Hydra. It offers a variety of routes for runners of all levels, from a marathon to shorter, fun runs. The event combines the challenge of nature with the beauty of the landscape, attracting large numbers of participants and volunteers. It has a long tradition and a reputation for excellent organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes with a strong mountain character and natural beauty
A variety of races, from a marathon to routes for beginners and children
Routes crossing the picturesque island of Hydra
additional: Race T-shirts and medals are offered to participants. Volunteers can help support the athletes. The schedule includes multiple start times for different routes, with the first start at 07:00. The event includes medals, T-shirts, volunteer opportunities, and entries in various categories, with an emphasis on natural beauty and community.

name: 10ος Μαραθώνιος Κρήτης
description: The 10th Crete Marathon is an internationally recognized sporting event held in the beautiful city of Chania. Dedicated to the memory of the late Metropolitan Irineos Galanakis, the event includes marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km races, each with its own dedication and historical significance. The course starts and finishes at the Chania National Sports Center, passing notable landmarks around the city and offering a unique running experience in both urban and natural surroundings. The event is supported by the Chania Health Runners Club and local organizations, with an emphasis on quality and tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Chania National Sports Center
Course passing historic and coastal locations in the city of Chania
A choice of distances: marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km
additional: The races have different start times by distance: marathon at 07:00, 10 km at 07:30, 5 km at 08:30, and 2.5 km at 11:30. An official backpack and face towel are included as participant gifts. Registration is available online or in cash at the SDYCH office. The cancellation policy allows refunds until 31 January 2026. The courses are dedicated to important figures from Crete and Greece. Official merchandise includes T-shirts, towels, and backpacks. The event has a cultural and commemorative character, with participation from clubs and organizations across Crete.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Πεδίου Αρεως «Στις Γειτονιές της Αθήνας»
location: Pediou Areos Park, Athens, Attica, Greece
description: The 9th Pedion tou Areos Race “In the Neighborhoods of Athens” is organized by the “Athenaioi Dromeis” Athletic and Cultural Association to showcase Pedion tou Areos Park and raise awareness of environmental issues. The race includes 5 km and 10 km routes that start and finish inside the park and pass through the surrounding Athens neighborhoods, as well as a 1.3 km children’s race inside the park. The event emphasizes culture, fair play, and environmental awareness, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Statue of Athena inside Pedion tou Areos Park
5 km and 10 km routes through the neighborhoods around the park
1.3 km children’s race inside the park
additional: The children’s race consists of one lap inside the park. The 10 km race has a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes; after that, runners are required to run on the sidewalk at their own risk. The race is held under the auspices of several organizations, including the General Secretariat of Sports and the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Associations (EOSLMA-Y). The event emphasizes green races and environmental awareness. The routes pass through the park and surrounding neighborhoods; the event includes an environmental program and electronic timing. Participation is limited to 650 runners in total for the 5 km and 10 km races.

name: 19ος Μαραθώνιος Μεσσήνης
description: The Messini Marathon is an established running event organized by the Municipality of Messini with the support of the Peloponnese Region EAS SEGAS. The race promotes fair play and competition, inspired by ancient Greek tradition. Messini, with its historical significance, hosts this major sporting event, which attracts runners of different ages and abilities. The event includes marathon, 10 km, and 3 km races, offering participants a variety of options.
course_highlights: A marathon route with historical and cultural interest
A 10-kilometer race suitable for intermediate runners
A 3-kilometer race for beginners and children
additional: Volunteering is possible by contacting the president of SAM, Ioannis Poulakos. Certificates of participation are provided for all distances. The event is supported by the Municipality of Messini and the Peloponnese Region EAS SEGAS. It includes races for all ages, with entries and registrations, as well as volunteering opportunities. The race takes place on April 11, 2027.

description: The Dolichos Delphi–Olympia Road Race is a challenging 255-kilometer ultramarathon with a 48-hour duration. It starts in Delphi and finishes in Ancient Olympia. The course combines 60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails with 40% paved roads, crossing central Greece and the Peloponnese via the Rio–Antirrio Bridge. The mountainous route reaches an altitude of up to 1,100 meters, with significant elevation gain and loss. The race is organized by the OLYMPIOI sports club and invites runners to test their endurance in a pioneering Greek race.
course_highlights: A 255-kilometer route with a 48-hour duration
60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails; 40% paved roads
A mountainous route reaching up to 1,100 meters, with 5,420 meters of total elevation gain
additional: Included are transfers from Athens to Delphi and from Olympia to Athens; accommodation and meals in Ancient Olympia after the race; supplies and medical support during the race; transport in the event of withdrawal; a medal and commemorative certificate for finishers; and a guided tour of the archaeological site and museum of Ancient Olympia the following day. The race offers multiple distances (255 km, 144 km, and 111 km), with scenic surroundings and a challenging course, and takes place over three days in April. Support points and electronic tracking are available.

description: The 10th Kouri Forest Popular Road Race is organized by the Friends of Kouri Forest Association in collaboration with the Region of Thessaly, the Municipality of Almyros, and the Volos Health Runners Association “Centaur.” The event includes 5,000- and 10,000-meter races for adults, as well as 1,500- and 500-meter races for middle- and elementary-school students, respectively, and a separate 500-meter race for people with disabilities. The event has a charitable purpose, collecting food to support the Municipality of Almyros’s social grocery and Galini homes. Participation is free for children and costs 5 euros for adults. The race starts on Saturday afternoon.
course_highlights: 5,000- and 10,000-meter races for adults
1,500- and 500-meter races for students
Charitable event collecting food
additional: The event has a charitable purpose, collecting non-perishable food to support the Municipality of Almyros’s social grocery and Galini homes. Opening and closing ceremonies, participation in a natural setting, races for all ages and needs

name: Ε’ Δρόμος Γερακιού
description: The 5th Geraki Road Race is a distinctive 47.5-kilometer ultradistance race connecting the historic Byzantine castles of Mystras and Geraki in Laconia. The race follows a paved route with significant climbing, reaching an elevation of up to 650 meters, offering a unique experience combining sport, culture, and natural beauty. It is organized by the Greek Association of Long-Distance Runners “The Immortals” in cooperation with local organizations, and has a strong local and athletic character. The race starts at Mystras Castle and finishes in Geraki’s central square, with a 7-hour time limit.
course_highlights: 47.5-kilometer route between the Byzantine castles of Mystras and Geraki
Paved route with elevation ranging from 420 to 650 meters
8 aid stations staffed by volunteers along the route
additional: The day’s schedule includes registration opening at 12:00 with a pasta party, registration closing at 14:30, a technical briefing at 14:35, and transfer to the start at 14:45. The race has a 7-hour time limit, with a cutoff time of 22:00. Cutoff points are in place for the safety and smooth running of the race. The race includes 8 aid stations, a technical briefing, and a program featuring a pasta party. The route is paved, and the finishing time limit is 7 hours.

description: The Ypsilanteios Road Race in Nea Trapezounta, Pieria, is a sporting event offering three routes for everyone: a 10-kilometer race, a 1.1 km children’s race, and a 5.3 km walking route. The 10 km course is challenging, with elevation changes and beautiful views of Mount Olympus. It starts and finishes in the central square of Nea Trapezounta. The children’s race and walking route offer opportunities for younger participants and non-competitive runners. The event provides participants with medals, a light meal, and juice, while timing is overseen by the organizing committee. With medical coverage and a Pontian celebration after the race, it is a festival for the local community and runners.
course_highlights: 10 km route with +155 meters of elevation gain
Views of Mount Olympus along the route
Water stations at 3.2 and 7.7 km
additional: Registration is available exclusively on race day, up to 15 minutes before the start, in the central square. Timing is not electronic; it is overseen by the organizing committee. Medical coverage is provided by the Samaritans and Rescuers Volunteer Corps of the Hellenic Red Cross. A parent or guardian’s declaration of consent is required for minors participating in the children’s race. The awards ceremony begins at 19:00, followed by awards and a Pontian celebration. Three routes: 10 km, children’s race 1.1 km, and walking route 5.3 km. The race has +155 meters of elevation gain and a challenging course. Registration is on race day. Medal, meal, juice, manual timing, and medical coverage.

description: The 1st Amphipolis Ahepa Run is a new series of road races that brings together Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The courses pass through ancient trails and natural landscapes in Amphipolis, offering a unique running experience that honors the area’s rich cultural heritage. The event is open to runners of all levels, from children to experienced athletes, with parallel activities and support throughout the event.
course_highlights: Courses through ancient trails and natural landscapes in Amphipolis
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout the event
additional: Participant benefits: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic timing, medical support, bag and clothing storage, athlete transportation, and on-course and finish-line refreshments. There is a 1 km children’s race, a 5 km race for recreational runners and people with disabilities, and a 21 km half marathon. Participants who do not collect their race kit on Saturday 18/4 can collect it on race day, 19/4, at least one hour before the start. The event includes medals, T-shirts, support at stations, and cultural activities, with approximately 600 runners and volunteer support.

name: 1ο Kotylaion Run
price_range: 10-20 ευρώ (ανάλογα με το πακέτο και την επιλογή t-shirt)
description: The 1st Kotylaion Run will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, in the village of Koutselio, Ioannina. The event is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina and with the support of the Ioannina Runners’ Club, offering a unique mountain-running experience in the area. My Adventure, with many years of experience organizing sporting events in Epirus, supports the event, bringing together the area’s natural surroundings and mountainous terrain. The race is for runners who want to enjoy nature and an athletic challenge in a beautiful mountain landscape.
course_highlights: The mountainous terrain of Epirus
The natural surroundings of the village of Koutselio
Event held under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina
additional: Routes of 10 km and 5 km, plus a 1,000 m children’s race; registration is open until February 20, 2026. The finish and registration are at the race office. Please arrive early and follow the health regulations.

name: 3ο Kastra Mountain Trail
description: The 3rd Kastra Mountain Trail in Servia, Kozani, is a premier sporting event that attracts runners who love the mountains and nature. The route crosses the imposing natural landscape of the Pieria Mountains, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The Municipality of Servia actively supports the event and invites volunteers to help make it a success. The event combines sport with local natural beauty, creating a celebration for mountain-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Route at the foothills of the Pieria Mountains
Imposing natural scenery
Mountain running in a natural setting
additional: The Municipality of Servia is calling for volunteers to support the race. The event takes place in a natural setting with a strong mountain character at the foothills of the Pieria Mountains. The race is held on trails with gorges and forests; volunteer support, free participation and medical care, online registration, and a race in a natural setting with historic monuments.

name: 4ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Χανδρινού
description: The 4th Chandrino Mountain Race is organized by the Chandrino Athletic and Cultural Association “CHANDRINAIKOS” and will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, in Chandrino, Messenia. The event features mountain races over 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 1 km children’s road race. The route starts at “Platania” Park in the village and finishes at the summit of the conical Mount Profitis Ilias, offering panoramic views across Messenia and the surrounding landscapes. The race combines natural beauty, athletic challenge, and local tradition, inviting runners and visitors to enjoy a unique mountain-running experience.
course_highlights: 11 km and 6 km mountain-trail routes starting at “Platania” Park in the village of Chandrino
Finish at the summit of Mount Profitis Ilias (elevation 620 m), with panoramic views of Messenia, Mani, Taygetus, and the surrounding islands
1 km children’s road race starting at 10:15 a.m.
additional: The 11 km and 6 km mountain races start at 10:00 a.m., while the 1 km children’s race starts at 10:15 a.m. The route includes a trail with unique views and is suitable for runners seeking a mountain challenge. Chandrino has approximately 600 residents and is located in the Municipality of Pylos-Nestoras, Messenia. The mountain-running routes are technical, with highly challenging sections and impressive scenery, and are suitable for experienced runners and nature lovers.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιστίμπεη
location: Οχυρό Ιστίμπεη, Νέο Πετρίτσι, Σιντική, Σέρρες, Greece
description: The 5th Istibey Sacrifice Run is a 14-kilometer mountain race with 600 meters of positive elevation gain, held at Istibey Fort, near Neo Petritsi, Serres. The race is organized by the Friends of Istibey Fort Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Sintiki, as part of the 85th anniversary of the Battle of the Forts. The event aims to preserve historical memory through sport and showcase the area’s natural wealth. The course passes over the surface of the forts of the Metaxas Line, where defenders faced the German war machine in 1941.
course_highlights: 14.6 km mountain race with positive elevation gain
Course at Istibey Fort and along the Metaxas Line
Passes historic sites from the Battle of the Forts
additional: The race takes place on the Greek-Bulgarian border, in the northern part of Serres Prefecture. The event commemorates the Battle of the Forts and showcases the area’s natural wealth. No information was found about entry fees or the registration process. Routes of approximately 14 km and 600 m; historical and cultural significance; includes a race with historical and cultural character; routes with GPS and smartwatch; start at 10:00 a.m.

name: Lake Plastiras Trail
description: Lake Plastiras Trail is a festive mountain-running event held in the beautiful Lake Plastiras area of Karditsa, Greece. The race routes cross the historic Agrafa mountain range, offering unique natural scenery, varied terrain, and significant elevation gain. The race starts at the Botanical Garden of the Municipality of Lake Plastiras, beside the lake, and participants can enjoy routes that combine trails, dirt roads, and asphalt. The event promotes sport, recreation, and the natural environment and local history of the area.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: trails, dirt roads, and asphalt
Significant elevation gain with views of Lake Plastiras and the Agrafa mountains
Start and finish at the Botanical Garden of Neochori, on the lakeshore
additional: The event includes five races: 42 km (+2,400 m elevation gain), starting at 08:00; 23 km (+1,150 m elevation gain), starting at 10:00; 10 km (+100 m elevation gain), starting at 11:00; 5 km (+100 m elevation gain), on Saturday 18/4 at 18:00; and a 600 m children's race at 11:10. Water and refreshment stations are available. The 23 km route includes a technical descent and reaches its highest point at 1,808 m. The 5 km route is a loop and is suitable for beginners. The event promotes health, recreation, and the natural environment and local history. It includes routes with technical challenges, participants from Greece and abroad, and safety and health programs. Activities and accommodation options are also available in the area.
