The event features three routes—10 km, 5 km, and 2 km—through the streets of Panorama, finishing at the Olympic Sports Center. The race has a charitable purpose, with proceeds going to charitable associations and organizations. Everyone is welcome to take part, and runners of all ages turn out in large numbers, creating a celebration of sport and solidarity.
course_highlights: Three routes: 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km
Routes through the streets of Panorama
Finish at the Olympic Sports Center
additional: The event is supported by SEGAS and the “Panorama Lions” sports club. Proceeds go to charitable associations such as the Northern Greece Parents’ Association of Children with Neoplastic Diseases “Lampsi,” the Friends of Papageorgiou Hospital Association “Antirida,” and “SOS Children’s Village Filyro.” Registration is available online or in person at the Panorama Olympic Sports Center every day from 17:00 and on weekends from 11:00. Routes with special traffic arrangements, participation open to all ages, proceeds for charitable causes, collaboration with SEGAS and local clubs.

name: 14ος Αγώνας Ορεινού Τρεξίματος «Σαμαριά»
description: The 14th Samaria Mountain Race is a challenging 21.6-kilometer race through the impressive Samaria Gorge, one of Europe’s best-known and most visited natural landscapes. The course starts on the Omalos Plateau and follows trails and rural roads, offering unique panoramic views and a chance to encounter the area’s rare flora and fauna. The 4th Omalos Run, a 7-kilometer race, is also held for those who prefer a shorter course. Organized by the Chania Mountaineering Club, the race is an excellent opportunity for runners to enjoy the nature and history of Crete.
course_highlights: A 21.6 km course through Samaria Gorge, with rare flora and fauna
Multiple aid stations along the course
Panoramic views from the Kalyvaki location and varied terrain (trails, rural roads, and a paved section)
additional: The course includes 8 aid stations offering a variety of foods. The race starts and finishes at Xyloskalo (elevation 1,250 m). A shorter 7 km course (Omalos Run) is also available. The route passes through the gorge’s narrow sections, including “Sideroporta,” which is 3 meters wide and up to 700 meters high. Advice is provided on accommodation, transport, and equipment. The event includes services and checks, and participation requires online registration. The Samaria and Omalos area offers a unique mountain experience.

name: 39ος Κορακοβούνιος Δρόμος
price_range: 5€ για 4χλμ, 7€ για 4χλμ, άλλα ποσά κατόπιν επικοινωνίας
description: The 39th Korakovounios Road Race is one of the oldest and most historic road races in Crete, held in Korakovouni, Heraklion. The route combines natural beauty with an athletic challenge, attracting runners of all levels. The event has a long tradition and offers a unique running experience in the heart of the Cretan countryside. Participants enjoy authentic hospitality and support from the local communities.
course_highlights: A route through the authentic Cretan countryside
Passes through traditional villages and natural landscapes
Stone-paved lanes and forest trails
additional: The event places particular emphasis on protecting the natural environment. No information was found about start times, entry fees, or special packages. The page recommends following social media for updates and photos. Registration is open until 3 May; free bus transportation; race number and T-shirt collection on 9 May; technical support from SEGAS and medical coverage from CRETA Interclinic.

name: «Τρέξε για τη ζωή» για τη γιορτή της Μητέρας
description: “Run for Life” is a sporting event organized by Lesvos Runners in Mytilene to mark Mother’s Day. It’s a day full of energy, smiles, and love, where runners and walkers are invited to join a large group at Tsamakia Grove. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and promotes well-being and social participation through sport.
course_highlights: Route through Tsamakia Grove in Mytilene
Friendly, family-oriented setting for runners and walkers
Event dedicated to Mother’s Day
additional: The event takes place at Tsamakia Grove, starting at 11:00 a.m. No specific distances or categories are listed; participation is encouraged for everyone, regardless of ability. The event has a friendly, social character and celebrates Mother’s Day. It includes running or walking, with the aim of promoting health and the local community, and takes place on the Tsamakia pedestrian path on May 16, 2027.

name: Kassios Dias
description: Kassios Dias is a challenging technical mountain race held on the trails of northeastern Corfu, offering two distances of 25 and 12 kilometers. The routes pass through traditional semi-mountainous villages and the unique ecosystem of Erimitis, a protected NATURA area, combining mountain scenery with coastal beauty. The 25 km route passes caves and peaks with panoramic views, while the 1,200 m children’s race gives children the chance to experience the joy of running. The race is organized by the Kassios Dias Running and Hiking Association to promote sports and volunteerism.
course_highlights: 25 km route with +1,300 m of elevation gain, passing through the Peristerograva Cave
Passage through the protected NATURA ecosystem of Erimitis
Panoramic views from the summit of Matagonas (640 m elevation)
additional: Race-bib collection and new in-person registrations take place on Thursday and Saturday in Corfu and Kassiopi, as well as on race day before the start. The start and finish are at Kassiopi Harbor. A pre-race meal (Pasta Party) is held on Saturday. Registration is not required for the 1,200 m children’s race. Car access to Kassiopi Harbor on race day is limited due to traffic restrictions. Paid private parking is available, along with free parking spaces on a nearby peripheral road. On-site registration is also available, and the event offers accommodation and transport options to make participation convenient for runners. The area is a popular summer destination with easy access via the airport, road networks, and ferries.

name: Kifissia Runners In The Night
description: Kifissia Runners in the Night is an exciting 5-kilometer night race held in the center of Kifissia, starting and finishing at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium. Now in its fourth year, the event offers a unique running experience along the city’s illuminated streets, welcoming summer with a major celebration of sport. The race is organized by the Municipality of Kifissia in cooperation with the Region of Attica and is aimed at runners looking for a lively, energetic night route.
course_highlights: 5 km night race in the center of Kifissia
Start and finish at the Zirineio Municipal Stadium
Route along the city’s main streets, which are illuminated
additional: The race includes chip timing and a race number sent by email. Volunteers can take part and support the event. Registration and volunteer options are available. It is a major celebration of sport in the heart of Kifissia, with runners of all ages and abilities taking part.

name: Megalopolis Theater Run
description: The Megalopolis Theater Run is a road race held in Megalopolis, Arcadia, dedicated to the city’s ancient theater, the largest theater in the ancient Greek world. The race includes a 10 km route with a newly updated course, as well as 5 km and 1 km routes for everyone, offering a unique running experience in a historic setting. The organizers invite runners and volunteers to take part and embrace this celebration of sport and culture. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce.
course_highlights: 10 km route with a newly updated course
5 km and 1 km routes for everyone
Dedicated to the ancient theater of Megalopolis, the largest ancient theater
additional: A volunteer program is available for residents and anyone interested. The race is organized by the Municipality of Megalopolis in cooperation with the Peloponnese Region and the Arcadia Chamber of Commerce. The event includes multiple routes, registration for runners and volunteers, and takes place at a historic site dedicated to ancient Greek theater.

name: Sohos Mountain Games
organizer: Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος «Σώκος Ερμής» και Τοπική Κοινότητα Σοχού
description: The Sohos Mountain Games are the largest mountain running race held in Sochos, Thessaloniki, offering an unforgettable trail-running experience amid natural beauty and a variety of routes. Participants can choose from 30km, 10km, 5km, and a 1-mile route for children, with all races starting and finishing in the central square of Sochos. The race combines sport, local tradition, and a social gathering, with a party, DJ, and traditional kourbani after the finish. It is a celebration for all runners, from elite athletes to families and children.
course_highlights: 30km route with 1,300m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
10km route with 520m of elevation gain, moderate difficulty
5km Fun Run around Sochos, suitable for everyone
additional: All races start from the central square of Sochos. Race amenities include a technical T-shirt, Buff, Pre-Race Pasta Party, race bib, electronic timing, finisher’s medal, full refreshments, medical services, a traditional after-race meal, and an electronic participation certificate. There is also a big celebration with a DJ and traditional kourbani after the race. A discounted package is available for unemployed people, university students, school students, people with disabilities, and members of the Armed Forces and Security Forces. The event includes multiple trail routes, post-race activities, a party, free transport for early registrations, and a warm welcome.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора
price_range: до 12 април - по-ниска цена, след това - по-висока
description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run across the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vast sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature lovers and runners seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km of rugged coastal beauty with an endless horizon
17 km along breathtaking cliffs with a sea breeze
7 fast and impressive kilometres along the coast
additional: Race packs are collected in the cities of Varna and Shabla, with a signed participation declaration. To collect a race pack for another participant, their signed declaration is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, the waves, and the journey, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from partner Villa Daros. The event features races over different distances, is supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amid the natural scenery of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to the cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot “Slancheto” in Borisova Gradina and take part using the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular “Slancheto” area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of paved park paths
1.2 km of dirt-and-gravel path, followed by 1.8 km of wide paved road
additional: The race is accessible to wheelchair participants. The virtual Catcher Car begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to take part and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or in person. The event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race included in the XLkmrun calendar and organized by 5kmrun. It takes place around the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—over open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The course is open, with no shade and varied terrain
Held in the Plana Mountain, near Sofia
additional: A choice of three distances of varying lengths. The course is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May around the village of Plana. Trail race; distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km; held around the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. It attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. The event is part of Lukovit Municipality’s sports calendar and offers a mass 800-meter start for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The 8.8-kilometer course runs from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass 800-meter start for younger participants
Takes place in scenic natural and urban surroundings
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. Winner Ismail Senandzhi has won the race five times. The event also includes a mass 800-meter start. It takes place on 10 May 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular with running enthusiasts in the region.

name: Маратон "Розова долина" - Rose Valley Marathon

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: от 1 март до 3 май 2026 г. - 10 км - 20 евро

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: от 1 март до 3 май 2026 г. - 21 км - 25 евро

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: от 1 март до 3 май 2026 г. - 42 км - 30 евро

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for all running enthusiasts. Its main goal is to encourage physical activity and introduce participants to the beauty of Bulgaria’s Rose Valley. The race offers three distances: a classic 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak. The course passes through urban areas, bike paths, and a secondary road network, with approximately 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and features aid stations every 5 km, as well as prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: The first 10 km pass through urban areas
The course follows bike paths and a secondary road network
Approximately 100 meters of elevation gain
additional: Race packs can be collected on May 8 and 9, 2026, at the Orlovo Gnezdo Tourist Association office, and on May 10, 2026, at the start/finish area in Rosarium Park. Aid stations along the course provide water, drinks, and fruit approximately every 5 km. The start/finish area has designated personal-bag storage zones with tags bearing race numbers. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00 and includes overall and youth categories. On-site registration is from 08:00 to 09:00, and the start is at 09:00. The event offers different distances and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The 20th anniversary edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, creating opportunities for young talents and established sportspeople to compete. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports officials.
course_highlights: City stadium in Lukovit with a well-maintained track
Events from 100 m to 1500 m for different age groups
More than 200 athletes from 35 clubs across the country
additional: The competition includes different age groups, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m. Representatives of Lukovit Municipality and sports officials attend the awards ceremonies. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and attracts national-level athletes and young talents. It is held at the city stadium in Lukovit, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m, includes children and adults, and features participants from across the country.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers different distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.
course_highlights: The course runs along Shumen Reservoir
Options for individual and relay running
A range of time formats: 1, 2, 3, and 6 hours
additional: Options include individual runs lasting 6 hours and 3 hours, as well as mixed relays lasting 2 hours and 1 hour (under 18 years old).

name: 26ος Ευχίδειος Άθλος
description: The Euhideios Athlos is a historic ultradistance race that crosses the region between Delphi and Plataea, honoring the feat of the long-distance messenger Euchidas. Runners pass through historic battlefields and natural landscapes, with routes featuring uphill stretches on Mount Helicon and panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth. The race offers a unique experience combining sport, history, and culture, with starts and finishes at significant historic sites. The event includes three ultradistance routes, covering different levels of difficulty and distance.
course_highlights: 107.5 km route from Plataea to Delphi, passing historic battlefields
Climbs on mythical Mount Helicon with panoramic views of the Gulf of Corinth
A short 5 km section on a dirt road along the Mornos Canal
additional: The 215 km Euhideios Ultra-Athlos starts at 07:00. A pasta party and technical briefing are held the previous day. The route is mainly paved, except for a short 5 km dirt-road section. There are checkpoints and aid stations along the route. After the finish, a Delphic Light lighting ceremony, awards ceremony, and reception take place at the European Cultural Centre of Delphi. The event features multiple routes, historical and cultural significance, and a focus on showcasing the area’s natural beauty. Registration usually opens in late October or early November.

name: 5ο Run Πύργου
location: Κεντρική Πλατεία Πύργου, Πύργος, Ηλεία, Greece

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ΔΩΡΕΑΝ ΓΙΑ ΠΑΙΔΙΑ (ΕΚΤΟΣ ΑΝ ΕΠΙΘΥΜΟΥΝ ΠΑΚΕΤΟ ΠΑΡΟΧΩΝ 5 ευρώ)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ΔΩΡΕΑΝ ΓΙΑ ΠΑΙΔΙΑ (ΕΚΤΟΣ ΑΝ ΕΠΙΘΥΜΟΥΝ ΠΑΚΕΤΟ ΠΑΡΟΧΩΝ 5 ευρώ)

description: The 5th “5ο RUN PYRGOU” road race in Pyrgos, Elis, offers a celebration of sport for all ages, with 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes. The start and finish are at Pyrgos Central Square, with categories for adults and children, as well as special categories for people with disabilities. The race is co-organized by Pirgos AthleticEvents and the Municipality of Pyrgos, with the aim of promoting exercise and participation by the local community. The event awards medals and cups to category winners, creating a friendly and encouraging atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km, 2 km, 1 km and 500 m routes at Pyrgos Central Square
Categories for all ages, from toddlers to adults, as well as people with disabilities
Start and finish at the central square, in an urban setting
additional: Medals are awarded to the first three finishers in each category, and cups to the overall category winners. Minors aged 15–18 may participate with parental consent. All routes start at Pyrgos Central Square at different times between 18:30 and 20:30. The race is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pyrgos and includes various routes and categories for all ages and athletic levels. Participation promotes health and well-being, while electronic timing and results make it easier to track runners’ performance.

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κάστρου Διδυμοτείχου «Κώστας Γκατσιούδης»
description: The 8th Didymoteicho Castle Road Race “Kostas Gatsioudis” is an annual road race held in Didymoteicho. It includes 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, a race for people with disabilities, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The race began in 2016 on the initiative of military personnel, with the support of the Municipality of Didymoteicho and the Division. It is an important sporting and cultural event for the area, honoring the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km and 1 km races, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay
Includes a race for people with disabilities
Takes place at the historic Didymoteicho Castle
additional: The event honors the memory of Kostas Gatsioudis and General Charalambos Lalousis, and includes celebratory events. The course passes through the city’s historic castle, and participation is open to everyone, with registration via Google Form.

name: Ποσειδώνια
organizer: Δήμος Πόρου, Γυμναστική Ένωση Πόρου Τροιζηνίας

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή σε όλες τις εκδηλώσεις είναι δωρεάν

description: The Poseidonia races in Poros are a popular running event that attracts more than 900 runners from across Greece and abroad. They are organized by the Municipality of Poros and the Gymnastics Association of Poros Troizinia, offering races over different distances on the picturesque island of Poros. The event includes courses ranging from 300 meters to 10 kilometers, with electronic timing and free participation in all events. After the races, participants are treated to a free Pasta Party, creating a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses from 300 m to 10,000 m on a picturesque island
Electronic timing for athletes in the 5 km and 10 km races
Free Pasta Party after the races
additional: Registration includes a race T-shirt, a bottle of water, a banana, electronic timing, and a commemorative medal. Athletes traveling from Piraeus and Aegina receive a 50% discount on ferry tickets. The race office is open on Friday afternoon and Saturday morning for collecting race bibs, bags, and T-shirts. Travel to Poros is available by road and ferry. The event includes road races and mountain running, children’s races and family activities, with electronic timing and events for everyone.

name: Goulinas Trail
description: The Goulinas Trail mountain running race is held in the area of Spercheiada, Phthiotis, with the aim of showcasing the region through sport and a love of nature. It includes three routes of different lengths and elevation gains, offering an unforgettable experience to all participants. The start and finish are in Spercheiada’s central square, and the race emphasizes protecting the natural environment and sustainability. The event promotes fair play, cooperation, and a healthy lifestyle through sport.
course_highlights: Three routes: 6 km, 12 km, and 30 km, with elevation gains of 220 m, 700 m, and 2,000 m, respectively
Start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square
A nature-sensitive setting, with an emphasis on protection and a low environmental footprint
additional: All routes start and finish in Spercheiada’s Central Square. The 30 km race has a 7-hour finish time limit and an intermediate cutoff at 12.5 km, at 2 hours and 45 minutes. The race is environmentally friendly, with measures to reduce its impact on the natural environment. It includes different routes focused on nature and adventure, and offers information about accommodation and registration.

name: Business Run Varna

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Цена: 19 евро на дете. Регистрацията е индивидуална и отделна.

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the biggest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard Shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km before handing the relay baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams of 4, each running 4 km
The course is in the industrial zone of BulYard Shipbuilding Industry and Bulport Logistics
Each lap is 2 km, and each participant runs 2 laps
additional: Each participant receives a race bib and safety pins. The relay baton is equipped with an electronic timing chip. The start is at 9:00, and the first runner must be at the start with the baton at 8:50. Parking and a cloakroom are available next to the start area. Laser engraving on medals is available for an additional fee. Branded team tents are available for an additional fee. Registration deadlines are in early 2026. The event includes certificates and gifts, as well as the opportunity for companies to take part and enjoy team-building.

name: 6ο City Trail Αγρίνιο
description: The 6th Agrinio City Trail is a 16.4 km running race organized by the Agrinio Health Runners Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Agrinio. The race takes place as part of the celebrations for the city’s patron saint, Saint Christopher, and starts and finishes in the city’s central Dimokratias Square. A 6 km race and a 1 km race for younger runners are also held on the same day. The course includes trails and dirt roads in the Saint Christopher grove and Papastrateio Municipal Park, and is marked to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 16.4 km course featuring trails and dirt roads
Passes through the Saint Christopher grove and Papastrateio Municipal Park
Starts and finishes in Agrinio’s central Dimokratias Square
additional: The 6 km and 1 km races for young participants are held on the same day. All races start from Dimokratias Square. The course is marked to ensure runners’ safety. The events include 16.4 km and 6 km races, as well as a 1 km race for children, all starting from Dimokratias Square. The event aims to promote sport and health, with local runners and visitors taking part.

name: 13ο Paggaio Trail Run
description: The 13th Paggaio Trail Run is organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Kavala and offers two mountain races: a challenging 27-kilometer race for experienced runners and a 10-kilometer race for less experienced runners. The routes start and finish in the village of Domatia, at the foot of Mount Paggaio, and pass along trails, forest roads, and a few meters of asphalt. Mount Paggaio offers unique natural scenery and an unforgettable experience for those who love mountain running. The event welcomes both experienced and new runners to discover the area’s beauty through the race.
course_highlights: Routes along trails and forest roads, with a few meters of asphalt
Start and finish in the village of Domatia, at an elevation of 150 meters
Natural scenery and ridgelines of Mount Paggaio
additional: The event also includes routes for children, while the area’s natural beauty and cultural heritage are important features of the event.

name: 1ο «Το Καλωσόρισμα των Πελαργών»
description: The 1st “Welcoming the Storks” road race in Aiginio, Pieria, is a spring sports celebration held under the auspices of the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros. The event includes 11-kilometer and 5-kilometer races, as well as a 1,000-meter children’s race, offering athletes and visitors an opportunity to take part. The welcoming town of the Storks welcomes runners on a route that combines natural beauty and sporting spirit, promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region.
course_highlights: 11-kilometer race: Kolindros–Katachas–Aiginio route
5-kilometer race: circular route in Aiginio
1,000-meter children’s race: circular route in Aiginio
additional: The event takes place as part of the 1st Stork Festival and includes sports activities aimed at promoting mass participation in sports and helping participants discover the region. The event is supported by local clubs and organizations. Races for different levels and age groups; event on May 23, 2027; accompanying activities and environmental awareness.

name: 4ος Axios Running Festival
description: The Axios Running Festival is a multi-day sporting and cultural celebration held in the Axios Valley, offering a unique experience for runners of all ages and abilities. The event includes 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 1-mile road races, with certified courses and accompanying social, cultural, and environmental events. The race combines sport, tourism, and history, showcasing the region and supporting the local community. The event is held under the auspices of the Region of Central Macedonia and follows World Athletics regulations.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting at the Koufalia Town Hall and finishing at the Balkan Wars Military Museum
Courses that cross the Axios Valley, the Axios Dam, and the old Thessaloniki–Evzoni National Road
Courses certified in accordance with World Athletics regulations
additional: The race is held on the first Sunday of April each year (in this case, May 23, 2027) and forms part of a two-day, wide-ranging experience featuring environmental, cultural, and social events. Participation certificates can be printed for all distances. The event provides high-quality safety and support services for runners of all ages and abilities. It includes road races, health activities, and a walk, with an emphasis on environmental awareness.

name: 5ο Belles Historic Trail
description: The Belles Historic Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event that combines the natural beauty and historical memory of the Neou Petritsi area in Serres. The routes cross trails rich in natural vegetation, historic forts, and offer magnificent panoramic views, providing a unique experience for runners of all levels. The event includes races of different distances, from 1 km for children to 22.66 km for experienced athletes, with a welcoming atmosphere and local delicacies at the finish. Belles Historic Trail is a celebration of sport, culture, and nature that brings the community and visitors together.
course_highlights: Routes on trails with abundant natural vegetation and waterfalls
Historic forts and trails of the Battle of the Forts (1941)
Panoramic views of Lake Kerkini and Mount Belles
additional: Electronic timing with prompt, reliable results. Refreshment stations along the routes. Commemorative gifts for all athletes (windbreaker jacket, buff, socks). Medical coverage throughout the races. Traditional local delicacies at the finish. Children’s races on Sunday at 11:30. Race office and packet pickup on race day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 17:30. The event includes trail and on-road races for children and athletes of different levels, and offers medals and local cuisine to participants.

name: 5ο Godzilla Xanthi Trail
location: Xanthi, East Macedonia and Thrace, Greece

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Βασικό πακέτο : 20 ευρώ (Περιλαμβάνονται: Αριθμός συμμετοχής του αθλητή, Αναμνηστικό εγχαραγμένο Μετάλλιο, Ηλεκτρονικό δίπλωμα συμμετοχής, παροχή νερού, ισοτονικών ποτών και μικρογεύματα.)

tiers.label: tier_1
