description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes of 30 km, 14 km, and 7 km. The 30 km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes suit runners with different experience levels, with the 7 km route serving as an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Xanthi Runners Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, offering a unique sporting experience amid the area's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 28 km of trails and 1,850 m of elevation gain
14 km route with 12 km of trails and 600 m of elevation gain
Easy, circular 7 km route, ideal as an introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are at Thilia. Awards ceremonies take place at 11:30 for the 7 km race and at 14:30 for the 30 km and 14 km races. A volunteer follows the last runners to provide support. Bib pickup is at Xanthi's central square on the Saturday before the race and from early morning on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. There are three routes of varying difficulty, with the start and finish in the Ilia area, full refreshments, and awards. The 30 km route is particularly challenging and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannai Road Race is a sporting event held in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to take part in a road race that promotes mass participation in sports and a healthy lifestyle. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association, an organization with a long tradition of supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and a love of nature, fostering sportsmanship and a community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities
In collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations
Focus on social cohesion and volunteerism
additional: An event featuring 21.1 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for children and people with disabilities, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Grigoris Lambrakis Peace Run is a 23-kilometer road race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of Grigoris Lambrakis, a peace activist and martyr. The race takes place in Tripoli and follows routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the Arcadia Peace Committee’s annual sporting events. It is an event with historical and social significance that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: A 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
A race centered on the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. It is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the committee’s annual sporting events. The 2026 race was scheduled for Sunday, May 17, at 18:00 in Tripoli. Routes through various parts of Tripoli, participation by the Arcadia Peace Committee, a historical and social context, and references to previous editions.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Road Race “Georgios Apostolakis” is held in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race attracts many participants and is a celebration of sport and local tradition. The event honors his contribution and love of sport, while promoting social cohesion and health through physical activity.
course_highlights: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes in an urban setting
Organized by GEORGIOS APOSTOLAKIS PARK
Includes road races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes, age categories, road races and gymnastics, date: 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Road Race in Naousa is a running event honoring the historic heroic city and its unique traditions. The course gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural surroundings of Mount Vermio and the area’s rich cultural heritage. With its beautiful trails and welcoming atmosphere, Naousa is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and abilities. The race combines athletic challenge with historical remembrance and local hospitality.
course_highlights: A course at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing by Naousa’s historic and cultural landmarks
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naousa offers welcoming accommodation and local cuisine featuring Xinomavro wine and traditional dishes. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family excursions and adventures in nature. The event emphasizes historical remembrance, with online and in-person registration, and medals and commemorative gifts for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: Dental Run 2026 is an inclusive road race taking place at Goudi Park on May 17. Runners of all levels are invited to take part in a 5-kilometer race, a relaxed walk, or a children’s race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, and also offers non-athletes the opportunity to participate as volunteers. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, with support from well-known dental care product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option of a relaxed walk or a children’s race
Inclusive event open to runners and volunteers
additional: Those who do not wish to run can participate as volunteers. The event is supported by companies including Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. It is organized to raise awareness about health, with participation options including a 5-kilometer race, a walk, and a children’s race, as well as opportunities to volunteer.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professional runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The event brings together sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty: 3 km with 75 m of elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m of elevation gain, and 26 km with 1,514 m of elevation gain
Routes follow historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: The organizers are Apriltsi Municipality, the Troyan in the Future Association, and the National Society “Tradition” – 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with funds raised allocated to causes related to the fight against cancer and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event is organized to bring together sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different levels of difficulty and welcoming both professional runners and enthusiasts. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and scenic sea views. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon tests endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course runs along Varna’s coastline, with sea views
The race takes place in Bulgaria’s seaside capital
An atmosphere of support from local fans and international participants
additional: Late on-site registration is possible if places are available at the information center, which is open May 12–16, 2026. Race numbers can only be collected in person on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square, next to the Varna Opera House. The event also includes a 2 km city run with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; online and on-site registration; an event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Pleven Friendship Marathon is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. The organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a varied program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turn-around points
Refreshment stations every 5–6 km and water stations every 3 km and along the course
The course passes through Kaylaka Park and scenic parts of Pleven
additional: Race packets are distributed at the Children’s Activity Center on May 16 from 10:30 to 15:00 and on May 17 from 7:15 to 8:00. Personal energy products can be handed in on May 17 from 8:00 to 8:30. There is a medical station and an ambulance on the course. The awards ceremony is at 13:30, and a special run with BALIZ starts at 9:35. Registration is free for participants over 60 and people with disabilities upon request and submission of documents. Payment can be made via PayPal or bank transfer. Course, registration, charitable cause, children’s marathon

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held in the foothills of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event brings together sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: The Hobby route is 37 km with 1,274 m of elevation gain, suitable for cyclists of all levels.
The Difficult route is 47 km with 1,781 m of elevation gain, featuring challenging climbs and technical descents for advanced riders.
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the cycling route overlapping the Hobby route.
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, aid stations with food and drinks, a medical team, and festival activities at the start/finish area, including live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children’s race for children up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start/finish area. It includes a children’s race, a tent campsite, insurance, aid stations, and charitable giving.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th “All Together—All Equal” road race is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the assistance of the “Gefyra” (Bridge) support structure and the support of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association “Trachina.” The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness about people with disabilities. It features three routes of 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km. These are non-competitive routes, and there is no timing. Participation is free for people with disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km routes at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same location at the Castle
Routes suitable for people with disabilities and their companions; non-competitive
additional: The 2.5 km and 5 km routes are open to people with disabilities and companions aged over 12. The 800 m route is for people with disabilities of any age and primary school children (ages 6–12). There is no timing, and the race is symbolic in nature. The schedule includes registration opening at 10:00, the 800 m start at 11:00, and the 2.5 km and 5 km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. The event has a social purpose and includes children and adults, awareness-raising and cultural activities, and support from the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association.

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Lefkada Half Marathon is a night race organized by the Lefkada «Filandros» Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Region of the Ionian Islands. The event includes 21.1 km and 8 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, and the course runs around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with sunset views. The race is held under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and EOSLMA-Y.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 19:45
Course around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Schedule of events includes bib and chip collection, a pasta party, and awards. Children’s races have separate start times. The 8 km race starts at 17:45 and the 1 km children’s race at 16:30. Distances: 21.097 m and 8 km; races for children ages 6–12; parallel activities; courses in a protected NATURA area.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The “Angelis Govios” Road of Sacrifice is a historic road race being held for the 22nd year in Psachna, Evia, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Association under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Evian revolutionary military leader Angelis Govios and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The race starts in Psachna’s central square, and entry is free, with ample refreshments provided. The 15 km route is 50% unpaved, with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: 15 km route with 50% unpaved terrain and +131 m elevation gain.
5 km and 1 km routes on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
Start in Psachna’s central square.
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the start area and is free. Registration opens at 15:00. Ample refreshments are provided for runners. The event takes place on 29 May 2027, with the race starting at 17:00. It includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sport and historical remembrance.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke road race is organized by Stroke Hope Urban Non-Profit Company in cooperation with NeuroLife IKE, with the aim of raising awareness about prevention and supporting people affected by stroke. The event takes place at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes a 5 km race for runners and a 1 km race for children and people with disabilities. The race began in 2024 and aims to connect physical activity with health and social awareness. Technical direction is provided by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt route consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Eligibility: 5 km for people over 12 years of age with a medical certificate of fitness. 1 km for children aged 6–12, people with disabilities, and patients. The race includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY. The event will take place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, starting at 18:30, at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail in Metsovo is a challenging mountain race offering distances for all runners, from the 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain to shorter distances of 40 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as the 4.6 km Katara Vertical race. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains in the area, offering unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is ITRA-certified and is an important event for mountain-running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers provide for athletes’ safety and support, with aid stations and technical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain
40 km, 21 km, and 11 km races, plus a 4.6 km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: Races start at different times depending on the distance. Aid stations and technical support are available along the courses. The race is ITRA-certified and awards UTMB points for the 100 km ultramarathon. Information about accommodation and transport in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail also includes children’s races and special challenges, such as the 65.6 km URSA CHALLENGE with 4,810 m of elevation gain. The event combines racing and hiking, with an overnight stay in Metsovo and the involvement of volunteers and local organizations.

name: Маратон Каланджа
description: Kalandzha Marathon is a celebratory event marking 10 years since its founding in 2026. Held in the village of Sinemorets, it offers trail running distances of 42, 21, and 13 km, plus a 3 km children’s race, as well as mountain biking distances of 42 and 21 km. The routes follow the scenic trails of Strandzha Nature Park, bringing together sport, nature, and community. The event includes race packs, an awards ceremony, and a party, creating a festive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails in Strandzha Nature Park
Loop courses starting and finishing at Veleka Beach
Aid stations with fresh fruit, vegetables, and isotonic drinks
additional: The running races start on May 23, with time limits for each distance. Mountain biking takes place on May 24, with two distances. Starts and finishes are at Veleka Beach (North). Food and drink stations are provided along the routes. MTB bikes without electric assistance are permitted. After the race, there is a party at the “Koraba” bar. Early accommodation booking is recommended, for example at Casa Domingo in Sinemorets. Running and cycling routes, on-site registration, anniversary edition, nature trails in Strandzha

name: Epidavrios Dromos Theater 2 Theater
location: Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, Epidavros, Greece

name: 1ο Backyard Ultra Δράμας
description: The 1st Drama Backyard Ultra starts and finishes at Kart Track 69 Speedway in Drama. Runners start at 08:00 in the morning in May and follow the Backyard Ultra format, completing a 6.7 km lap within each hour and continuing until only one runner remains. The course crosses the lush area of the Kallifytos stream, with 67 metres of elevation gain per lap, which accumulates over the hours. There is also a team endurance competition, in which the best team is determined by its total number of laps.
course_highlights: 6.7 km lap with 67 metres of elevation gain
Course through the lush area of the Kallifytos stream
Direction alternates every hour to avoid monotony
additional: Start and finish at Kart Track 69 Speedway. Aid-station provisions change as the race progresses: snacks and drinks at first, pasta, cold beer from lap 7, pizza from lap 10, and homemade soup from lap 15. Reflective markers for running at night. Team endurance cup, with results recorded at bigsbackyardultra.com. The course includes a crossing of the green Kallifytos stream, with 67 metres of elevation gain per lap. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, in which the winner is the last runner to complete a lap alone. Entry costs 40 euros.

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: The 6th Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 will take place on 30–31 May in Vasiliki, Lefkada. This two-day event features road races and mountain running and is organized by the Lefkada Tourism Company and the Tourism and Culture Association of the wider area. Events include children’s scooter races, an exhilarating 3,500-meter aquathlon combining swimming and running, and the classic 13,000-meter road race, which starts from Porto Katsiki Beach. The main road race starts at 18:00, offering a unique sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: 13,000-meter road race starting from Porto Katsiki Beach
3,500-meter aquathlon: 500 meters of swimming and 3,000 meters of running on trails and paved roads
Children’s scooter races of 1,000 and 1,500 meters on Vasiliki Beach
additional: The children’s scooter races start at midday on Saturday, 30 May, from Vasiliki Beach. The 3,500-meter aquathlon includes approximately 500 meters of swimming from Agiofylli Beach to the neighboring Valta Beach, followed by 3,000 meters of running on trails and paved roads, with two aid stations. The 13,000-meter main road race starts from Porto Katsiki Beach at 18:00. The event includes various categories and distances, and participation requires registration for a fee.

name: 29ος Γύρος Πόλεως
description: The 29th Kyparissia City Run is organized by the Municipality of Trifylia and will take place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, starting and finishing in the town’s central square. The event includes races for all ages, from toddlers to adults, with distances ranging from 100 meters to 10 kilometers. Participation is free of charge. All finishers will receive a commemorative medal, and the top finishers in each category will be awarded. It is a celebration of sport that brings together the local community and runners of all ages on a beautiful route through the town.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Kyparissia’s central square
Routes for all ages, from 100 m to 10 km
Power walking and road races in an urban setting
additional: The program includes a 100 m race for toddlers, a 1,000 m race for primary school children, a 4,000 m race for middle school students, high school students, and adults, power walking for all ages, and a 10 km race for runners aged 18 and over. All finishers will receive a commemorative medal, and the top finishers in each category will be awarded. Participants can register using an online form. The event includes routes for children, teenagers, and adults, with an emphasis on community participation and promoting sport in the area.

name: DECATHLON Thracian Ultra
description: DECATHLON TRAKIA UTRA is a mountain running event that brings the spirit of the ancient Thracian lands to life through the magic of nature and sport. The race offers a variety of distances for beginners, experienced runners, and experts, including ultralong courses with breathtaking views and challenges. This event combines sporting spirit, history, and a love of nature to create an unforgettable experience for all participants. Join us and discover the magic of Thrace in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: 95K ultralong distance featuring challenging and scenic mountain trails
Night Trail 6K under the stars
Dynamic and scenic routes for the 12K and 20K distances
additional: The race offers distances from 6K to 95K, suitable for runners of different levels. There is a special race for children: DECATHLON Kids Run. A prize draw is held every month for registered participants. Multiple distances, mountain running, prize draw registration, children's race

name: Мемориал "Йорданка Аризанова"
description: The Yordanka Arizanova Memorial is an annual competition dedicated to the memory of legendary coach Yordanka Arizanova, who developed hundreds of accomplished athletes. The tournament takes place at Plovdiv Stadium and includes events such as the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, and 400 m hurdles, in which the coach achieved her greatest successes. The competition brings together both young and established athletes, who honor her legacy and contribution to Bulgarian athletics.
course_highlights: Events at Plovdiv Stadium
Events: 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 400 m hurdles
Traditionally attracts accomplished sprinters and runners
additional: The competition includes starts for children in the morning and for senior athletes in the afternoon. The winners are presented with awards by Yordanka Arizanova’s daughter, Angelina Petrova-Hristova. The tournament is annual and takes place at Plovdiv Stadium; it includes the 100 m, 200 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1500 m, and 400 m hurdles, with awards presented to the winners.

name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, Μαραθώνιος, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 12 km, 5 km
description: The organizers of the 5th Evrytania Trail Races invite you to run along the fir-covered trails of mountainous Evrytania, in one of Europe’s cleanest ecosystems. The races offer a unique opportunity to experience the magic of nature, cool off in the crystal-clear waters of the Krikellopotamos River, and enjoy the hospitality of traditional villages that serve as aid stations. The event includes races of different distances, suitable for both beginner and experienced runners, with beautiful and challenging courses combining trails, dirt roads, and paved roads.
course_highlights: Fir-covered trails, with trails making up 60% of all courses
Aid stations in traditional villages along the course
Elevation gains ranging from 350m to 1000m, depending on the distance
additional: The races include 6K, 12K, and 20K courses, with different time limits (2 hours for the 6K, 3 hours for the 12K, and 5 hours for the 20K). The 6K and 12K start on Saturday, May 30, at 17:00 from Krikello’s central square, while the 20K starts on Sunday, May 31, at 10:00 from the Prophet Elias grove in Domnista. Mandatory equipment is not required, but basic emergency gear and water are recommended. There is a generous time limit for walking or completing the course. The event is open to participants aged 16 and over (6K, 12K) and 18 and over (20K). The races combine trail running with cultural activities, with an emphasis on nature and local tradition. Participants should be prepared for challenging mountain routes and be self-sufficient with their equipment.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The 2nd Mountain Trail Running Races on the trails of the Valtinos Fighters – Chalkiopoulo Trail Run 2026 will take place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Neo Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania, with the start at 9 a.m. The event is organized by the Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the Chalkiopoulo Local Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races include two distances, 27 and 10 kilometers, crossing the beautiful mountain landscapes of Chalkiopoulo and Valtos and offering a unique mountain-running experience.
course_highlights: 27- and 10-kilometer routes on the trails of the Valtinos Fighters
Passages through local villages and natural landscapes, including Velaora, Paliagrapidia, Prophet Elias, and Saint Nicholas
Start and finish in Neo Chalkiopoulo, with varied terrain and a mountainous character
additional: The races are organized by the Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the Chalkiopoulo Local Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races start at 9 a.m. in Neo Chalkiopoulo. The 27 km route passes several local points of interest and villages, offering a complete mountain-running experience. Mountain-trail routes, a camping area, a meal for finishers, limited accommodation in the village—early booking is recommended.

name: 5η Γιορτή Αθλητισμού Δήμου Γαύδου
description: The 5th Gavdos Municipality Sports Festival is an open celebration of grassroots sport held on the island of Gavdos during the three-day Holy Spirit holiday. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and fair play, giving residents and visitors the opportunity to take part. The road races follow routes that showcase the island’s natural beauty and trails, offering a unique experience at the southernmost point of Europe. The event has become an established institution, with high participation and excellent organization.
course_highlights: Routes along Gavdos’s scenic trails
21 km, 11 km, and 6 km road races
The southernmost point of Europe as the race setting
additional: The event includes races for adults and children, with timing for adults but not for children. Participation exceeds 130–150 people, and the event has been highly successful and established as an institution. It takes place during the three-day Holy Spirit holiday and promotes fair play and a healthy lifestyle. Off-road races; participation for those over 15 with parental responsibility; and registrations for the 10 km, 6 km, and 1 km races subject to personal responsibility and acceptance of the participation terms.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: The 5th Posidonia Running Event will take place on May 31, 2026, in Piraeus, offering a 5-kilometer route through the city streets. The event welcomes runners from around the world and combines sport with support for charitable causes, as proceeds will go to the Municipality of Piraeus and its partner charities. The start and finish will be at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, with the race starting at 9:00 a.m. The event is part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition and promises a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometer route through the streets of Piraeus
Start and finish at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus
Held as part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition
additional: Registration for the race has already closed. The event supports charitable causes, with proceeds going to the Municipality of Piraeus and partner organizations. The race is open to people over 14 with medical clearance, with a limited number of participants and online registration. Proceeds go to charitable causes, and the event is an important meeting point for the shipping community.

name: 5ο Rock Solid Kastellorizo
description: The 5th Rock Solid Kastellorizo is a small trail-running weekend held on Kastellorizo in late May. It includes 22 km, 10 km, 5 km and 1.3 km courses, all starting from the same point. The main 22 km course is mountainous, with significant climbing, and requires serious preparation, while the shorter courses offer a friendlier, more sociable atmosphere. The race is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Mountain Sports and offers medals, plaques and awards to winners and the first local finishers.
course_highlights: Mountainous 22 km course with 1,006 metres of positive elevation gain
A mix of natural trails and asphalt, with views of the islet of Ro
Limited entries for the shorter courses for a more personal atmosphere
additional: The 10 km race is limited to 50 runners and has a 2 hours 30 minutes cut-off. The 5 km race is limited to 80 participants, and the 1.3 km children's race is limited to 50 participants. Medals, age-category plaques, awards for the top three men and women overall, and a separate plaque for the first local finisher are provided. There are aid stations, medical support and course markings. May weather is warm, with an average temperature of 28°C and a chance of 30 mm of rain. The event includes medals, awards and souvenirs, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and the sporting experience.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Karya Olympus Trail is a mountain running race held in Karya, offering a unique experience for runners who love nature and the challenge of the mountains. The race showcases the beauty of Mount Olympus and the surrounding area, combining demanding trails with stunning views. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels, with the aim of promoting sport and local tradition. The organizers are welcoming and support participants every step of the way.
course_highlights: Mountain course on Mount Olympus
Trails with natural beauty and scenic views
Challenging terrain for runners of all levels
additional: The event includes different courses, with the longest race at 25 km, and takes place on the slopes of Mount Olympus, attracting runners of all levels. Taking part combines nature, endurance, and an authentic mountain atmosphere.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: The 42nd Distomo Sacrifice Road Race is a memorial race held on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Distomo, honoring the victims of the 1944 massacre. The 11.2-kilometer course starts at the historic site of Karakolithos and finishes at National Resistance Square. Entry is free, and a 1.1-kilometer children’s race starts at the same time. The organizers provide runner transport, timing, medical coverage, and refreshments along the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: 11.2-kilometer course with minor elevation changes
Starts at the historic site of Karakolithos
Finishes at National Resistance Square in Distomo
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:30 to 09:30 at the starting area. Organized bus transport for runners from National Resistance Square to the start is available between 07:30 and 08:30. Water stations are located at the 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th kilometers. Water, juice, and bananas are offered at the finish. Full medical coverage is provided, with a doctor and ambulance. The first three men and women are awarded prizes, and all finishers receive commemorative medals and participation certificates. The race is held in memory of the victims of the 1944 Distomo massacre, alongside commemorative events and activities in the area.

name: Mystras Trail
organizer: Δήμος Σπάρτης και ο Σύλλογος Σπαρτιάτες Δρομείς
description: Mystras Trail 2026 is organized by the Municipality of Sparta and the Spartans Runners Club, with the support of the Sparta Mountaineering Club, as part of the Paleologian celebrations. It is a demanding mountain race featuring three circular routes of different distances, with starts between 09:00 and 10:00 on the morning of May 31, 2026. The routes cross technical trails with loose ground and rocks, offering a challenge for experienced runners. The event provides electronic timing, aid stations, and a race T-shirt for all participants.
course_highlights: Three circular routes of different distances: 26 km, 12 km, and 6 km
Technical trails with loose ground and rocks; demanding terrain
Positive elevation gain of up to 1,680 meters on the longest route
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day at the starting area, at least one hour before the start. Timing is provided by a chip, which athletes must wear throughout the race and return after finishing. Aid stations along the routes provide water, isotonic drinks, and snacks. Trophies will be awarded to the top three men and women in each route, with exceptions for the age categories. The route is technical and demanding, with loose ground and rocks. The event includes electronic timing, a chip, and medals for all finishers. There are three routes, with participation across various categories and age groups.

name: Sifnathlon
organizer: Δήμος Σίφνου και Ένωση Συμμετασχόντων σε Ολυμπιακούς Αγώνες
description: SiFNaThLoN 2026 in Sifnos invites runners and swimmers to enjoy a unique sporting experience on one of the most charming islands in the Cyclades. The events take place over two days, with open-water swimming on May 30 and running races on May 31, amid Sifnos’s enchanting scenery, including Platys Gialos beach and the Kamares area. The running courses combine paved roads and dirt roads, offering participants a variety of terrain. This event combines sport with the beauty of the Aegean and is ideal for athletes of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Open-water swimming at Platys Gialos beach
Running courses on mixed terrain, combining paved roads and dirt roads
Races amid the enchanting scenery of Kamares and Platys Gialos
additional: The events take place over two days: on Saturday, May 30, 2026, the open-water swimming event features distances of 3 km and 1.5 km for adults, and 300 m for children. On Sunday, May 31, 2026, the 10 km and 4 km running races for adults take place, along with children’s races for primary and middle school students. The children’s races are held at the 5-a-side football pitch in Kamares. The running course is mixed, with paved roads and dirt roads. The event includes 4 km and 10 km running races, as well as swimming races for children, in a beautiful location with beaches and trails that encourage enjoyment and physical activity.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: The Karya Olympus Trail 2026 offers a unique mountain-running experience in the idyllic valley of Karya, under the protection of Mount Olympus. The routes follow marked trails with varying distances and elevation gains, suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes races of 25, 13, and 5 kilometers, as well as children’s races, with services such as electronic timing, commemorative medals, and technical T-shirts. The race starts early in the morning, while the awards ceremony takes place at the start-finish area. The region’s natural beauty and historical interest make the race a complete sporting and cultural experience.
course_highlights: Routes on marked trails with elevation gains from +285 m to +1500 m
Natural beauty of the Ziliana Valley and views of Mount Olympus
A range of distances from 0.6 Km to 25 Km, suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Services: race bib, commemorative medal, electronic timing chip, technical T-shirt for 25Km & 13Km, buff for 5Km, water and light snacks at the aid stations and finish, and a sweeper following the last runner. Awards ceremony at 13:00 at the start-finish area. Includes 25 km, 13 km, and 5 km routes, with organized services and commemorative items. Registration is open until 10 May 2026.

name: Titnata Trail
description: The Titnata Trail 13km is a short mountain-running race held in Karya, Greece. The 13-kilometer route includes +760 meters of elevation gain, offering a challenging uphill course on a marked trail. The race starts at 08:50 and is limited to 200 runners. Finishers receive a commemorative technical T-shirt.
course_highlights: 13 km marked mountain trail
+760 meters of elevation gain
Uphill and challenging course
additional: Limited to 200 runners. A course map is available to help participants prepare before the race. Trail race, registration fee 15 euros, technical T-shirt for finishers, trail map available

name: Αγώνας δρόμου ιστορικής μνήμης «Βασιλί – Δασόλοφος»
organizer: Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Βασιλί και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δασολόφου
description: The “Vasili–Dasolofos” historical remembrance road race is organized by the Vasili Cultural Association and the Dasolofos Cultural and Beautification Association in memory of the 40 Greeks executed in 1944. The race starts from the square in Vasili and passes through historic and picturesque locations in the area, honoring the memory of the heroes and promoting unity and historical awareness. After the finish, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen. The event combines sport with culture and history, inviting participants to send a message of remembrance and respect.
course_highlights: Start at the square in Vasili
Route via the Folklore Museum, the Enipeas Bridge, the Vamvakou square, and the villages of Revmata and Sitochoro
Finish at the square in Dasolofos
additional: After the race, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen in Kato Dasolofos by the Municipality of Farsala. Those interested in registering can contact the presidents of the associations. A road race with a historical and cultural character, a route through villages, a remembrance ceremony, and a memorial service.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: The Karya Mini Trail is part of the Karya Olympus Trail, held in Karya, an idyllic valley on Mount Olympus. The 5-kilometre route follows a marked trail with 285 metres of elevation gain, offering a beautiful mountain-running experience. The event also includes longer routes and children’s races, with provisions such as electronic timing, souvenirs and refreshments. With its rich history and natural beauty, Karya offers a unique setting for runners and visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km route on a marked trail
+285 metres of elevation gain
Natural scenery in the Ziliana Valley near Karya
additional: Amenities: race bib, commemorative buff for the 5 km race, electronic timing chip, water and light refreshments at aid stations and at the finish, and a sweeper following the last runner. Awards ceremony at 13:00 at the start/finish area. Mountain terrain; includes a medal, T-shirt, water stations, and online registration with bank transfer.

name: 7 Hills Run
description: 7 Hills Run is part of the RunBG Trail Series and takes place in the village of Zhelyava, Sofia. This is a challenging race that attracts mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Sofia area. The organizers provide professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with varied climbs and descents
Beautiful natural views around the village of Zhelyava
Part of the established RunBG Trail Series
additional: The event is part of a series of trail races held in Bulgaria and is aimed at amateurs and professionals who want to test themselves in mountain conditions.

name: Купа Мургаш 2026
description: Murgash Cup 2026 is the 17th edition of a mountain biking competition in the cross-country marathon (XCM) discipline, held in the village of Zhelyava. The race offers three main routes of varying distances and elevation gain, suited to different categories of competitors, including hobby riders and e-bikes. The routes cross scenic and challenging terrain, including the famous Zhelyava Trail, which is popular with cyclists. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes, and the event is suitable for moderately and well-prepared cyclists.
course_highlights: Murgash Epic – 62 km with 2,505 m of elevation gain
Murgash Classic – 40 km with 1,348 m of elevation gain
Zhelyava Trail – an iconic section with a 9.9 km climb
additional: The race includes junior boys’ and girls’ categories in different age groups, as well as an e-bike category with assistance up to 25 km/h. The organizer reserves the right to make changes to the routes. Multiple routes of varying distances and elevation gain are suitable for different fitness levels, including an e-bike category.

name: Tihiorace Ultra Edition
description: Tihiorace Ultra Edition is a challenging mountain running event held amid the stunning scenery of Tihio, Dorida, Greece. It features three long ultradistance routes with substantial elevation gain, offering unique trails through nature. The event is for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the natural environment, with distances ranging from 75 to 250 kilometers. The organizers are welcoming and support participants with useful information and facilities.
course_highlights: Unique trails through stunning natural scenery
Substantial elevation gain (up to 14,000 m)
Ultradistance routes of 75 km, 170 km, and 250 km
additional: The event features three routes: UltraSummits TihioRace 250Km, X-Ultra TihioRace 170Km, and 75-Ultra Tihiorace 75km, with elevation gains of 14,000 m, 9,100 m, and 3,500 m, respectively. The organizers also provide information about accommodation, access, restaurants, and attractions in the Tihio, Dorida area. Support is also available for athletes with disabilities in other events organized by the same team. The event features rugged mountain terrain and multiple ultra routes, and entries are open until 17/05/2026. There are options across various ultra distances, with significant elevation gain and beautiful scenery.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: The Nea Smyrni Night Run 2026 is a 5-kilometer race organized by the Municipality of Nea Smyrni in collaboration with the Attica Region and the Nea Smyrni Commercial Association, as part of World Environment Day. The event has a sporting, ecological, and recreational character, aiming to promote environmental protection and sustainable development. The course follows El. Venizelou Street, with the start and finish at 54 Omirou Street. A concert and party follow the race, while local shops take part with special offers and discounts.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer course along El. Venizelou Street
Night race with music at points along the course
Start and finish at 54 Omirou Street
additional: Registration opens on 13/05 at 12:00, with an extension until 19/05 at 12:00 for a limited number of places with professional timing and a bib number. At the finish, athletes receive medals, bananas, and water. All participants receive free access to a full set of photos and a certificate of participation by email. A concert and party follow the race, while shops in Nea Smyrni stay open with special offers until 22:30. 5 km course, public roads, events, concert, happenings, participation through online registration, events and happenings, updates in the coming days.

name: Δρόμος της Ελιάς
description: The Olive Road is a traditional road race held in Gargalianoi, Messinia. The course starts and finishes in Gargalianoi’s central square, offering a pleasant running experience in a scenic area. The race is open to runners of all levels and promotes physical activity and health. It is organized in collaboration with the Central and Southern Peloponnese Regional Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and the Municipality of Trifylia.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Gargalianoi’s central square
A 12-kilometer course through scenic surroundings
Co-organized by the Municipality of Trifylia and the Central and Southern Peloponnese Regional Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS)
additional: The event is part of the area’s cultural and sporting activities, promoting health and local culture.

name: Global Day Run
description: Global Day Run Patras 2026 is a friendly running event held in Agia, Patras, aiming to promote running as a way to improve physical and mental health. The event includes 8 km and 4 km races and a 1 km children’s race, aimed mainly at beginner runners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. As part of the global celebration of running, the event encourages families and friends to take part without a competitive focus. The race starts on the afternoon of Saturday, June 6, 2026, on Agia Beach.
course_highlights: 8 km and 4 km courses along Agia Beach, starting and finishing at the park benches opposite the snack kiosk
1 km children’s race on a dirt course with minimal elevation changes inside the park
A beginner- and recreational-runner-friendly course in a natural setting
additional: The children’s race starts 300 meters before the finish and follows a dirt course with minimal elevation changes. The event is part of the global celebrations for World Running Day and is aimed mainly at beginners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. Organized in cooperation with the Municipality of Patras, it includes 8 km and 4 km races and a 1 km children’s race on dirt courses, with medals and cups awarded afterward.

name: Salomon Vitosha Trail
description: Salomon Vitosha Trail 2026 is a mountain race offering a unique experience in the wilderness of Vitosha. The race features three distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Aleko Hut, and the courses cross varied terrain, including an ascent of Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha. The organizers aim to develop trail-running culture in Bulgaria and encourage an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Courses of 40 km, 27 km, and 12 km with elevation gains of 2,000, 1,300, and 600 meters
Passage over Cherni Vrah, the highest point on Vitosha (2,290 m)
Varied terrain: forest trails, wet peat, rocky paths, streams, and moraines
additional: The race bib includes a timing chip. The awards ceremony takes place in front of Aleko Hut after the third finisher in each distance and group crosses the finish line. Every participant receives a medal and a one-week gym training pass at Next Level. Participants who have paid the entry fee receive a 30% discount on Salomon products and 10% on Suunto products at Sport Box. GPS devices are recommended for navigating the courses. The courses range from 12 km to 40 km and include an ascent of Cherni Vrah; conditions include mud, rocks, forests, and open meadows; registration is online or on site.

name: Национален шампионат под 18 г.
description: The Under-18 National Championship in Stara Zagora is a prestigious athletics competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The event brings together young athletes under 18 who compete in various track events. It is part of the national calendar and provides young athletics talents with an opportunity to compete and develop.
course_highlights: Track competitions in Stara Zagora
Participation by young athletes under 18
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The competition will bring together young athletes from across the country and will be an important part of the national sports program for young people.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: The Vlasti Wind Trail is a distinctive mountain-running event held in the natural surroundings of Vlasti, Kozani. It combines the sporting experience with promoting the harmonious coexistence of people and nature, with an emphasis on Renewable Energy Sources and sustainable development. The event is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation, supporting the local community and highlighting the value of clean energy. The routes offer a unique experience amid beautiful natural scenery, with respect for the environment and local tradition.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with positive elevation gain of +500 m (21 km) and +250 m (9 km)
Natural surroundings of the wider Vlasti area in Kozani
Emphasis on harmonious coexistence with nature and Renewable Energy Sources
additional: Race office hours: 08:30–09:30. Passing through all checkpoints is mandatory. A commemorative medal, refreshments at aid stations, a meal the evening before and after the race, medical coverage, and photography coverage throughout the event are provided. Littering outside designated areas, damaging flora, or disturbing fauna is prohibited. An organized camping area is available near the start, with respect for nature. The race includes routes through mountainous terrain, with provisions and safety rules, and is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: The 2nd Kourouta Road Race 2026 invites runners to take on a course where the road meets the waves, offering unique views of the Aegean Sea. The event features 10 km, 4,300 m, and a 1,000 m children’s race, with electronic timing and a commemorative medal for all finishers. The organizers provide medical coverage from the Hellenic Red Cross and traffic safety support from the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. The start and awards ceremony take place in Kourouta Central Square, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course with views of the Aegean Sea
1,000 m children’s race for primary and middle school students
Electronic chip timing and commemorative finisher’s medal
additional: The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 11:00 in Kourouta Central Square. Medical support is provided by the Hellenic Red Cross. Traffic support is provided by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. Children may participate with a signed declaration from a parent or guardian. Race packs will be distributed on Saturday in Amaliada and on Sunday in Kourouta, from early morning. There are three different races: 10 km, 4.3 km, and a 1 km children’s race. The awards ceremony will take place after the race, with trophies for the top three men and women in the 10 km race. The course is paved, with a short unpaved section, and both the start and finish are in Kourouta Central Square.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: The 2nd Sykourio Trail is a mountain running race held in the Sykourio area of the Municipality of Tempi, on Mount Kissavos, on June 7, 2026. It features three routes of varying difficulty and distance, crossing trails, dirt roads, and paved roads for a full mountain running experience. The race is open to runners of all ages, with a special route for children within the settlement. The event provides electronic timing, food and water along the route, and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Routes on trails, dirt roads, and paved roads
1,200 m of positive elevation gain on the main 21 km route
1 km children’s race within the settlement of Sykourio
additional: Registration opens on March 28, 2026, and closes on June 1, 2026. Entry includes a race bib or electronic timing chip, food and water along the route, and refreshments at the finish. Registration is individual only, and payment is accepted exclusively online by credit or debit card. Online public registration runs from March 28 to June 1, 2026, and includes a bib/chip, aid stations, and a technical briefing. The routes vary in difficulty and require preparation suited to their distances.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: The 4th Sykareios Road Race takes place in Kryoneri, Attica, on Sunday, June 7, 2026. It offers two distances, 15 km and 5.5 km, starting and finishing at the Kryoneri Municipal Unit Gate. The race is open to runners of various ages and offers commemorative medals to all finishers, as well as awards to the top men and women. The organizers emphasize runner safety and support, with aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: 15 km course with a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes
5.5 km course with a time limit of 1 hour and 15 minutes
Aid stations with water and isotonic drinks approximately every 3 km on the long course
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:00 at the start/finish area. Participation is limited to 250 runners in the 15 km and 200 in the 5.5 km. Awards are given to the top three men and women overall in each distance. The race takes place in the morning, starting at 07:20, and includes scenic routes through the area's natural landscapes.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: The 4th Argithea Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held in the area of Petrito, Karditsa, on June 7, 2026. It includes several courses, such as the Argithea Skyrace 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain, the Vlachogiannis Race 15 km with 700 m of ascent, a 5 km family race, and a 1 km children’s race. There is also the Lakos Vertical course, 3.6 km with 700 m of ascent, offering a unique experience on trails through a fir forest with views of the Agrafa peaks. The race attracts runners who love the mountains and a challenge, while also offering activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Argithea Skyrace: 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain
Vlachogiannis Race: 15 km with 700 m of ascent
Lakos Vertical: 3.6 km with 700 m of continuous ascent through a fir forest
additional: The Lakos Vertical course starts from the Vasilades settlement and climbs continuously along an old stone-paved path and trails with potable water. The finish is at Tsoutes, at an elevation of 1,750 m, with views of the Aforismeni, Karagounis, and Delidim peaks. There are also races for families and children, as well as hiking and mountain bike races. The event includes mountain running races, a vertical race, family and children’s courses, and activities on the natural trails and in the landscapes of the Thessalian Agrafa mountains.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: The 5th Aqua Mare Road Race takes place in Megara, with the start and finish at Varea Beach, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar. Participants can choose between two courses, 10 km and 5.3 km, running alongside the waves on a beautiful coastal route. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with free transport and a commemorative T-shirt for runners. The race starts early in the morning, making for a day filled with adrenaline and relaxation.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5.3 km courses by the sea
Start and finish at Varea Beach in Megara, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar
Coastal scenery with views of the waves
additional: Free athlete transport by bus from Aigaleo to Megara and back. Departure at 07:15 a.m. from Davaki Square (Aigaleo) and return at 14:00 from Megara. A commemorative T-shirt is also available for purchase at a cost of 8 euros. Registration is open until June 2, 2026. Free bus transport from Aigaleo. Participation is limited to adults with a medical certificate. The entry includes a timing chip, medal, water, and a T-shirt (optional).

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: The 6th Raches Run - Agroinvest is a sporting event organized by the Raches Interactive Association ALOPI on Raches Beach in Phthiotis. It includes 10,000-meter and 5,000-meter races, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children, promoting sports and social solidarity. The race showcases the beauty and history of the area while strengthening participants’ connection with the village and the local community.
course_highlights: 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, plus a 1,000 m race for children
Held on Raches Beach in Phthiotis
Promotes cultural heritage and local development
additional: The routes are safe and marked with signs and ribbons, and the event takes place in warm summer weather. No specific information about entry fees is available.

name: 6ο Vamvakou Mountain Run
description: The 6th Vamvakou Mountain Run, taking place on June 7, 2026, is a mountain race offering a unique experience on the authentic trails of the Laconian Parnon. With three distances of 29, 19, and 7 kilometers, the race combines physical challenge, changing landscapes, and the warm hospitality of the revitalized village of Vamvakou. Organized under the supervision of runner and coach Ioannis Dimopoulos, the race is part of the Vamvakou Revival Initiative and is supported by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation. The race is open to runners of all levels and offers electronic timing, medals, awards, and prize draws.
course_highlights: Three distances: 29 km (positive elevation gain +1,353 m), 19 km (+800 m), and 7 km (+385 m)
Trails through fir and pine forests, gorges, and open vistas
Start and finish in Vamvakou’s square, at an elevation of 950 m
additional: Limited number of entries (200). All participants receive a race bib, timing chip, commemorative T-shirt, medal, and light meal at the finish. Electronic timing is available on all courses. Awards for the top three men and women in each race, as well as age categories. Prize draws for one lucky participant per distance. Transportation is available from Athens and Kalamata. A pasta party and activities for children will be held. Trail running, mountain terrain, multiple race distances, organized by a non-profit, support from SNF, registration open until 31/05/2026

name: Artemida Sunset Run
location: Δημοτικό Γήπεδο Αρτέμιδος, Σπάτα, East Attica, Greece
description: The Artemida Sunset Run is the first road race to be held in Artemida, offering 5- and 10-kilometer routes at sunset. The routes are predetermined and marked on public roads, with the start and finish at the Artemida Municipal Stadium. The event includes electronic timing, participation medals, an event T-shirt, and awards by age category. The race is open to runners aged 15 and over, with a total participation limit of 300 runners across both distances.
course_highlights: Route along the seafront, with a turnaround point at the small church where it meets Androu Street
Marked route on public roads, with two laps for the 10,000 meters
Water stations and electronic timing at two points
additional: Collect the timing chip and event T-shirt from the Spata Municipal Stadium before race day. Participation is limited to 300 runners across the 5,000- and 10,000-meter distances. Time limits are 40 minutes for the 5,000 meters and 70 minutes for the 10,000 meters. There is a baggage-storage area and an ambulance providing medical coverage throughout the race. The event includes activities and participant check-in at the Municipal Stadium, with participants aged 15 and over. Participation is limited, with starts at 19:00 and 19:05, and includes a medal, T-shirt, and refreshment stations.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: Kilkis Trail is organized by the Kilkis Runners’ Health Association and offers a variety of races, including the main 20-kilometer trail race, a 4.8 km health run, a 4x4.8 km relay, and a 1 km children’s race. The Kilkis Trail course follows trails and dirt roads around the city of Kilkis, with gentle slopes and technical sections, covering approximately 850 meters of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the Kilkis summer cinema, offering runners a beautiful and challenging experience. The race takes place on Sunday, June 7, 2026, and is open to runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 20 km course on trails and dirt roads, with 850 meters of elevation gain
Technical trails that require care and experience
Start and finish at the Kilkis summer cinema
additional: The Kilkis Trail course is marked with signs, course tape, and markers. The cutoff time for the Kilkis Trail is 13:00, 3.5 hours after the start. Bib pickup is on Saturday 17/6 at Town Hall Square and on Sunday 18/6 at the start area, from 7:30 a.m. until 15 minutes before the start. There are cafés and food shops near the start-finish area. The event includes registration, detailed information about the courses and schedule, and an emphasis on community and health.

name: 5ο CHOLOMON TRAIL
description: The 5th Cholomon Trail mountain race is organized by the Chalkidiki Runners and Walkers Association “Ypsizonos” and offers three distances—10, 21, and 50 kilometers—through the dense forest of Cholomon. The routes cross trails lined with imposing trees and pass through natural landscapes of unparalleled beauty, offering a unique mountain-running experience. Free entry is also available to those who donate blood to the association’s blood bank. The race is supported by the Chalkidiki Regional Unit, the Municipality of Polygyros, and the Polygyros Forestry Department.
course_highlights: 50 km with 2,800+ meters of elevation gain: 1 km paved road, 10 km dirt road, and 39 km trail
12-hour time limit, with a cutoff at 6 hours at the 30.5 km aid station
Water, isotonic drinks, and snacks during the race
additional: Free entry for those who donate blood to the association’s blood bank (applies to the 10 km and 21 km races). Group registrations of 10 people receive a €5 discount for the 50 km and 21 km races, and a €2 discount for the 10 km race. All 50 km runners receive a hiking backpack, technical T-shirt, and commemorative medal. Payment must be made within 3 days of registration, and no later than 28/05/2026. Three different race distances, mountain-running races, start and finish in Polygyros, Chalkidiki, with a 12-hour time limit to complete the race.

name: Vamvakou Mountain Run
description: The 6th Vamvakou Mountain Run, taking place on June 7, 2026, invites runners of all levels to discover the rhythm of the mountain across three routes of 29, 19 and 7 kilometers. The route starts from Vamvakou’s square and climbs to an elevation of up to 1,900 meters, offering a unique experience in one of the Peloponnese’s most unspoiled mountain landscapes. The race combines athletic competition with an escape from the urban pace, and the event includes electronic timing, medals, awards and prize draws. The event is part of the Vamvakou Revival initiative and is supported by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation.
course_highlights: 29-, 19- and 7-kilometer routes with elevation gains of +1,353 m, +800 m and +385 m, respectively
Run on trails through fir and pine forests, alongside gorges and open vistas
Start and finish at Vamvakou’s square, at an elevation of 950 meters
additional: All participants receive a race bib, timing chip, bag for personal belongings, commemorative T-shirt and medal, as well as a light meal at the finish. The event includes electronic timing on all routes, awards for the top overall finishers and age-group winners, and prize draws for lucky participants. The 29 km and 19 km routes start at 09:30, while the 7 km route starts at 10:00. The race is limited to 200 participants per route, and online registration and payment are required. Three routes (7 km, 19 km and 29 km), registration online, free transport from Athens and Kalamata, activities for accompanying guests and children, registration deadline: 31/05/2026

name: Rhodo Rock
description: Rhodo Rock is a remarkable ultramarathon held in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains, near the town of Momchilgrad. This unique sporting event brings together participants from around the world who love the challenges of mountain routes and the beauty of nature. The race offers a variety of courses featuring peaks, valleys, rivers, and forest trails, suitable for both professional athletes and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. Participants can look forward to an exciting experience and an atmosphere that combines sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with peaks and valleys
River crossings and forest trails
The scenic natural beauty of the Rhodope Mountains
additional: All participants who finish within the cutoff time receive a finisher’s medal for the 60 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 9 km distances. Included are a T-shirt with an original design, gifts in the race pack, timing, a medical examination when collecting the race number, medical teams during the event, race photography, and securing all necessary permits. Multiple routes, mountain terrain, natural beauty, and a race for amateurs and professionals.

name: Business Run Sofia
price_range: до 1 януари 2026 (ранна), до 20 април 2026 (стандартна), до 18 май 2026 (късна), от 19 май 2026 (последен влак)

tiers.description: 487 лева/249 евра/ без ДДС/ 584.40 лева/298.80 евра/ с ДДС до 1 януари 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 299 евро/584.79 лева без ДДС / 358.80 евра/701.75 лева/ с ДДС до 20 април 2026
