description: Business Run Sofia is the largest team-building event in Bulgaria, bringing together employees from different companies for a corporate relay race. The race features teams of 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km, for a total of 4.8 km. In addition to the relay, there are Power Walk, CEO Dash, and Kids Run events, and every participant receives insurance, a medal, and gifts. The event is a great opportunity to strengthen team bonds and enjoy active time with colleagues.
course_highlights: Relay: 4 participants, each running 4 laps of 1.2 km (4.8 km total)
Power Walk: a team of 4 completes one 4 km lap together
CEO Dash: one 1.2 km lap
additional: Every participant receives accident insurance from MetLife for the day of the event. Each team receives a set of beach towels, an assembled medal, a plaque showing the company's placing, and gifts from partners. Laser engraving on the medals is available (€40 excluding VAT per team), as is a branded tent (€1,000 excluding VAT). Arriving at least an hour early is recommended; a cloakroom is available. The car park at Vasil Levski Stadium is closed, so taking the metro is recommended. A team-building event with various activities, company participation, an urban course, and different prices depending on the registration date.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: The 10th Anniversary Road Race “The Passage of the Apostle Paul” is organized by the Holy Metropolis of Kitros, Katerini and Platamon, the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros, and the “ZEUS” Athletic and Cultural Association of Runners of Pieria. The race is 10,000 meters long and follows a paved route through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos. It starts at the Church of the Apostle Paul in Methoni’s central square and finishes at Ancient Pydna. The scenic route features gentle climbs and descents and is marked throughout.
course_highlights: 10 km paved route
Passes through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos
Starts at the Church of the Apostle Paul and finishes at Ancient Pydna
additional: The race is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultramarathons. Cultural associations and organizations from the area take part. Runners of all distances and sports enthusiasts are invited to run or walk the route. It takes place on June 20, 2026, with the start and finish at Ancient Pydna, and includes cultural and sporting activities.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Βουφράδος
description: The 5th Voufrados Run, organized by the Hatzis Cultural Association “Anagennisi” in cooperation with the Municipality of Messini and the Messini Sports Association, includes 20 km and 5 km running and power-walking events, as well as a 1,500-meter race. The routes are semi-mountainous and pass through the area around the village of Hatzi in Messenia, showcasing natural beauty and forgotten settlements. The event aims to promote physical activity and improve quality of life through physical and mental well-being. The start and finish are at Hatzi’s central square, offering a friendly, welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Semi-mountainous routes around the village of Hatzi in Messenia
Pass through natural landscapes and forgotten settlements
Start and finish at Hatzi’s central square
additional: Event schedule: 15:00 race registration opens for collection of race materials at Hatzi’s central square. 17:30 start of the 20 km race, 17:45 start of the 5 km race, 17:50 start of the 1.5 km race. 20:30 end of finishes, 20:40 awards ceremony for the winners at Hatzi’s central square. 21:00 post-race energy recovery with traditional products at the central square. Organized in cooperation with the Municipality of Messini and local associations, with the aim of promoting sports and social cohesion.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: The 5th Livadia Night Run is a night race held in Livadia, near the Erkinas springs in the Krya area. The race includes three distances: a 10 km main race, 5 km, and 1 km for students, catering to runners of all ages and abilities. The race starts at 20:00, with electronic chip timing provided by CHRONOLOG. It is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia in cooperation with the Municipality of Livadeia, offering a local sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 20:00
1 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes near the Erkinas springs
Electronic chip timing by CHRONOLOG
additional: Race packs can be collected from the Tholoto hall next to the start. The 10 km race is open to registered SEGAS club athletes and independent runners aged 17 and over. June weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C, making the night start ideal. The event attracts runners from across the region and offers a distinctive running experience at night, with participation from both registered athletes and recreational runners.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: The 5th Olympic Day Run in Ancient Olympia is a unique and official Olympic running event that honors Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games. The race brings together Olympians, Paralympians, and distinguished athletes, creating a large Olympic running team. The event includes 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m races, with routes passing through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia, offering a unique sporting and cultural experience. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Olympic Committee and other important organizations, with the aim of showcasing Olympic heritage.
course_highlights: Routes through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia
Start and finish at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall
Route along the Alfeios River and the provincial road
additional: The races include distances of 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m. The event combines sporting, educational, and cultural activities with high standards of presentation and safety. It is organized by the Hellenic Olympic Committee, the International Olympic Academy, the Olympic Museum of Thessaloniki, and the Municipality of Ancient Olympia. It includes information about routes, registration, sponsors, and volunteers. The event promotes sport and culture in Greece, specifically in Ancient Olympia.

name: 16ος Ανδάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 16th Andaneios Run, covering 17,000 meters, will take place on Saturday, June 13, 2026, starting at the Arcadian Gate of Ancient Messene and finishing in Diavolitsi. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race will also be held. The event is part of two days of activities, including events about Ancient Andania, hiking routes, and tours of the wider area, offering participants a complete experience. The Messinia Runners’ Club welcomes all runners to enjoy this unique sporting and cultural experience.
course_highlights: 17,000-meter route from the Arcadian Gate of Ancient Messene to Diavolitsi
Additional 5,000-meter race and 1,000-meter children’s race
Hiking routes and cultural events in the wider area
additional: The races take place as part of two days of events (June 13 and 14) with accompanying cultural and hiking activities. Contact: 6942553154 (Thymios Alexopoulos). The event includes 17,000-meter, 5,000-meter, and 1,000-meter children’s races, a cycling route, cultural activities, and outdoor events, with free participation.

name: Ιεράπετρα City Run in Stadium Vol 6
location: Vouzounerekeio Δημοτικό Στάδιο, Ιεράπετρα, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: Ierapetra City Run in Stadium Vol 6 is an evening road race held inside the Vouzounerekeio Municipal Stadium in Ierapetra, Crete. The race is organized by the Ierapetra Health Runners Club in cooperation with the Region of Crete and offers officially timed races in a lively stadium atmosphere, with music, lights, and refreshments. The program includes a 400-meter children’s race, 5- and 10-kilometer races, and a mixed 4 x 800-meter relay. Participants enjoy a unique experience inside the stadium, with support and awards for the top runners.
course_highlights: Evening race inside Vouzounerekeio Municipal Stadium
Officially timed races with chip timing
Music, lights, water, refreshments, and souvlaki for participants
additional: Includes a 400 m children’s race, a 5 km race run in two heats, a 10 km race for ages 18+, and a mixed 4 x 800 m relay with two men and two women per team. All races except the children’s race use chip timing. June weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C, a low of 20°C, and average rainfall of 25 mm. The event includes a children’s race, medals, a T-shirt, snacks, music, and food. The event takes place in an indoor stadium, with hot and humid weather expected.

name: Тепе Джамборе 2026 Tepe Jambore
location: Летен театър, Пловдив, Пловдивска област, България
description: Tepe Jambore is a sports and cultural marathon in Plovdiv, combining running, movement, and culture across the city center and its hills. The event offers a unique urban adventure with artistic and cultural performances, including jazz music, theater, and dance, turning running into a celebration of sport and culture. The routes pass through landmark city locations, hills, paths, and green spaces, and are suitable for all ages and fitness levels. This is not a standard race, but an experience that brings the community together and supports causes for people facing social disadvantage.
course_highlights: Champions’ Jambore — 13 km with 450 meters of elevation gain, passing over all of Plovdiv’s hills
Laid-Back Jambore — 7 km with 250 meters of elevation gain
Kids’ Jambore — 1 km in Bunardzhik Park, on a safe route in a supervised environment
additional: The event includes cultural stops featuring theater, music, dance, beer and wine with snacks, performers, and surprises. The start-finish area hosts a party with music and entertainment. Participants can volunteer with the Jambore Squad, helping support participants and the event organization. Corporate teams take part in a competition that celebrates team spirit and raises donations for the “Plovdiv112” volunteer formation. The routes include 13 km, 7 km, and 1 km options; the event is part of Plovdiv’s 2026 cultural calendar and offers entertainment for the whole family.

name: ДИВОТО ЗОВЕ МАДЖАРОВО 2026
description: Wild Calls Madzharovo is an annual event combining cycling and trail running in the scenic Eastern Rhodopes. It takes place in the town of Madzharovo, situated in the crater of an ancient volcano and surrounded by unique natural landscapes and historic landmarks. The courses offer a variety of distances and challenges suitable for both recreational and elite athletes. Organized by the Dimitar Madzharov Cycling Club, the event aims to showcase the region’s beauty and bring sports enthusiasts together in a spirit of adventure and respect for nature.
course_highlights: Trail running with up to 900 m of elevation gain and panoramic views of Botev Peak
Routes passing through dense forests and old trails, and near a waterfall
Unique natural scenery in a volcanic crater, close to the Arda River and its striking meanders
additional: Start and finish at the square in front of the Municipality in Madzharovo. Services include chip timing, mountain rescue, emergency medical assistance, a tasty lunch in the festival area, and the option to camp in the Arda River canyon or at a campsite in the town park. Multiple MTB, duathlon, and trail running distances; starts on June 13 and 14, 2026, including children’s races and eco activities.

name: Национален шампионат под 14г
description: The National Championships for under-14 athletes in Gabrovo is a two-day athletics event that brings together more than 300 young athletes from across the country. Held at Hristo Botev Stadium, it gives the youngest talents the opportunity to compete in classic track and field events. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sports calendar and takes place alongside the international Nikola Valchanov Tournament. It is a significant event that supports the development of young athletes and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Events at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo
Classic track and field events for under-14 athletes
Two-day format with more than 300 participants from across the country
additional: Held at Hristo Botev Stadium in Gabrovo, the event is part of the national sports calendar for 2026.

name: Отвъд Мостъ / Beyond the Bridge
description: Otvad Mosta is a unique bike-and-run event in Lovech, combining a sporting challenge with historical and natural landmarks. Participants pass over four iconic bridges and follow scenic routes that include the Devetashko Plateau, the Kakrina Inn, Hisarya Fortress, and the Bash Bunar and Stratesh parks. The event is suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners, with 20% of the fees going to a charitable cause. It is an opportunity to enjoy nature and history and experience an unforgettable adventure.
course_highlights: Crossing four iconic bridges in Lovech
Muddy and rocky trails on the Devetashko Plateau
Historical landmarks such as the Kakrina Inn and Hisarya Fortress
additional: Registration is available online or in person on certain days. During the last two weeks before the event, registration is available with restrictions: no personalized race bib, and merchandise is available in on-site sizes. The fee is determined by the time of payment. A medical examination is not required for the 5 km run. Included are aid stations with food and drinks, a finisher’s medal, product prizes, and discount vouchers from partners. Duathlon: 40 km cross-country cycling + 12 km running; charity campaign; historical routes; nature views.

name: Турнир "Никола Вълчанов"
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 3000 метра, 1500 метра, 0.8 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km, 0.1 km
description: The “Nikola Valchanov” athletics tournament in Gabrovo is a traditional sporting event held at Aprilov Stadium. It features 17 events, including sprints and shot put, for age groups ranging from under-14s to men and women. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event attracts both young and experienced athletes and begins with an official opening at 11:00.
course_highlights: Events at Aprilov Stadium in Gabrovo
17 events, including sprints and shot put
Participation across age groups, from under-14s to men and women
additional: The tournament’s official opening is at 11:00 at Aprilov Stadium. The organizers are Gabrovo Municipality, the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, and the TOT ATLET athletics club. The event features events for different age groups. The tournament includes 17 events, with participants from 23 clubs, and has a record number of over 170 athletes.

name: 8ο Γράμμος Mountain Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή για τον αγώνα 21km είναι 25€

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Η συμμετοχή για τον αγώνα 10km είναι 15€

description: The 8th Grammos Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race held in the beautiful Mastorochoria region, in the village of Plikati, Municipality of Konitsa. It features two distances, 21 km and 10 km, starting and finishing in the village square. The 21 km course follows the ridge of the Grammos mountain range, with a total elevation difference of more than 1,680 meters, offering a unique experience for runners with good fitness and mountain-running experience. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. for the 21 km and 10:30 a.m. for the 10 km, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Loop course along the ridge of the Grammos mountain range
More than 1,680 meters of elevation difference for the 21 km
Start and finish in Plikati village square
additional: Electronic chip timing is provided. Participants receive a commemorative medal, water, fruit and snacks at the aid stations, as well as medical services during and after the race. The maximum time allowed for the 21 km is 5 hours and 30 minutes. A sweeper follows the last runner to provide support and ensure safety. In the event of adverse weather conditions, the organizers reserve the right to change or cancel sections of the course. The race takes place on a mountain trail, registration is via an external link, and the time limit is 5 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Ημιμαραθώνιος Δολιανών
description: The 10th Doliana Mountain Half Marathon, taking place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, in Ano Doliana, Arcadia, offers a challenging and beautiful 21,076-meter mountain half-marathon course with significant elevation change. Runners will enjoy steep uphill and downhill sections in a natural setting, reaching an altitude of up to 1,303 meters. The event emphasizes participant safety and provides a physiotherapist at the finish, as well as a photographer at points along the course. Results will be announced on the race’s official website.
course_highlights: A 21,076 m mountain half marathon with approximately 808 m of elevation gain and loss.
Maximum altitude of 1,303 m, with steep uphill and downhill sections (+28.9% and -31.1%).
A course with 50% uphill and 47.8% downhill sections in a natural mountain setting.
additional: A physiotherapist will be available at the finish for recovery. A photographer will be at the start, finish, and points along the course. Runner safety will be supported by volunteer rescuers along the route. A race bib will help judges identify runners. The course includes elevation changes and technical differences in water provision and infrastructure. Water stations are available, and the time limit is 4.5 hours. Registration opens via the official website.

name: 13ος Δρόμος Σέιχ Σου
description: The 13th Seich Sou Run is a trail-running race organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners Club. The routes include 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run through Thessaloniki’s Seich Sou peri-urban forest. The race aims to introduce residents to the natural environment and promote exercise and forest protection. The event is supported by O.M.A.K. Kalamaria and offers an opportunity for gentle trail running in a natural and historic setting.
course_highlights: Location: Seich Sou peri-urban forest, Thessaloniki
Routes: 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run
Gentle trail running in a natural setting
additional: The race is held with the support of O.M.A.K. Kalamaria. The event aims to introduce participants to the peri-urban forest, familiarize them with the challenges of trail running, and protect the natural environment. The Thessaloniki Health Runners Club was founded in 1993 and promotes grassroots mass participation in sport, exercise for health, and sports education. It will take place on Sunday, June 14, 2026, with participants taking part in different routes and support from local organizations, aiming to introduce them to the forest and promote exercise in nature.

name: Triglav Skyrun
location: село Тъжа, Национален парк Централен Балкан, България
description: Triglav Skyrun is a unique mountain race held in Central Balkan National Park, Bulgaria. The course passes three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka—and includes an ascent of Golyam Kadamliya (2,275.4 m), the third-highest peak in the Balkan Mountains. The race offers three distances of varying difficulty, all starting from the picturesque village of Tazha, the starting point for all three routes. This event for lovers of mountain running and nature combines a challenge with the beauty of the wild mountains.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sokolna Reserve, with its pristine nature
Ascent of Golyam Kadamliya Peak — 2,275.4 m
Passage through three iconic mountain huts—Sokolna, Triglav, and Rusalka
additional: The race starts in the village of Tazha. There are three distances with different start times: 7:30 for 34K, 8:30 for 20K, and 9:00 for 12K. Race packs can be collected both on the evening before the race and on race day, from 6:00 until 15 minutes before the start. The awards ceremony begins at 14:00. All winners receive a singlet bearing the race logo. A designer singlet can be ordered during registration. Participants under 18 may enter only the 12K and 20K, with a parental consent form. Refunds are available until 30.04.2026, subject to a 20% fee; no refunds are available after that date. The organizers are looking for volunteers to help with the event. Courses: 12K, 20K, 34K; registration is open until the limit of 300 places is reached; designer singlets can be ordered during registration; the event includes social events and a camping option.

name: Бягай бос с усмивка
description: Run Barefoot with a Smile is a unique event held in picturesque Belogradchik. The course offers the opportunity to run barefoot, combining sport and enjoyment in nature. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to experience the freedom and joy of running without shoes in a beautiful and inspiring setting.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on natural terrain
Scenic views of the Belogradchik Rocks
A unique atmosphere of freedom and smiles

name: У Царството на ТрибАлете
description: The mountain race “In the Kingdom of the TribAlletes” is a unique event in the heart of the Vratsa Balkan, offering a challenging 12.7 km distance with almost 1,000 metres of elevation gain. The course passes through beautiful natural landmarks such as Borov Kamak Waterfall and the peaks of Dudil and Buk, combining tough climbs with technical descents. The race is for those who appreciate natural beauty and mountain running, and prizes are placed along the course, including special surprises from the heart. Organized by BG Events & Guiding, it is part of a series of events promoting Northwest Bulgaria as a destination for sport and tourism.
course_highlights: 12.7 km with almost 1,000 m of elevation gain
Passes beneath Borov Kamak Waterfall, which is over 70 m high
Technical, steep descent from Buk Peak, with views of the Vratsa Balkan and the Iskar Gorge
additional: The start is at the entrance to the Borov Kamak eco-trail, and the finish is in the pine forest. The first 5 km are the toughest, with the biggest climb. Prizes are placed along the course. Register by calling 0878 259 772. The course features waterfalls, climbs, descents, technical sections, and natural beauty.

name: 1ο Chios Night Run
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: The 1st Chios Night Run is a night race held at the central port of Chios. The course offers a unique running experience, with aid stations every 2.5 kilometers and an official technical race T-shirt. After the finish, participants can enjoy a hot dog party and a music festival, creating a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The race includes age categories and a special category for security forces and armed forces.
course_highlights: Location: Central Port of Chios
Aid stations every 2.5 kilometers
Official technical race T-shirt
additional: A hot dog party and music festival take place after the race. Age categories: 15–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60+, with awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place. Special category for security forces and armed forces. Entry includes chip timing, a technical T-shirt, a medal, water, and snacks. The course is urban and held at night, starting and finishing at the central port of Chios. An early start is recommended due to hot and humid weather.

name: 2ο Φεστιβάλ Αθλητισμού Δυτικής Μάνης
price_range: 10 ευρώ ανά αγώνα, δωρεάν για τους παιδικούς αγώνες
description: The 2nd West Mani Sports Festival is a two-day sporting event held in Stoupa, Messinia, by the sea. It includes open-water swimming over distances of 0.5 km, 1 km and 2 km, running, children’s races and aquathlon. The 500-metre course is triangular, with electronic timing and awards. All participants receive a medal, bib, swim cap, technical T-shirt and local products. The event is organized by the Municipality of West Mani, and proceeds support the West Mani GAIA volunteer association.
course_highlights: Open-water swimming in front of Stoupa Beach
Triangular 500-metre course with one right turn
A different swim-cap color for each distance
additional: Participants under 18 need written parental consent. There are free children’s races and aquathlon events involving running and swimming. Each participant receives a bib, swim cap, technical T-shirt and local products. The swimming events start in the early afternoon. June weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 32°C and high humidity, so an early-morning start is recommended. Events take place on sea routes and mountain/paved trails, with races for children and adults, awards and distinctions, and environmentally friendly and cultural activities.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: The Koufalia Hill Run “Dimitra Iordanidou” is a distinctive event that combines the natural beauty of the Koufalia hills with an athletic challenge. It features 6 km and 10 km routes, mainly on dirt trails through a pine forest, with climbs and descents offering unique views of landmarks such as the Monastery of Gregory Palamas and the Gavana Cave. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities for children and parents, and aims to promote sport and connection with nature in the local community. It honors the memory of Dimitra Iordanidou, who conceived the race and established it as an annual tradition.
course_highlights: Dirt routes with trails through a pine forest
Pass by the Monastery of Gregory Palamas
Technically challenging sections with climbs and descents, and views of Gavana Cave
additional: The event includes activities for children and parents, as well as a parent-child race and a race for people with disabilities accompanied by a guide. The start and finish are at the Koufalia Tennis Club courts. The 10 km and 6 km routes share sections and feature steep climbs and descents, natural obstacles, and technical sections. The event is supported by local organizations and volunteers. The race takes place in the peri-urban forest of Koufalia, with an emphasis on community and the natural environment. Options are available for different ability levels and ages, and the event promotes outdoor exercise and family participation.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: The Beyond Kerkini Running Experience is a unique road race held at the Lithotopos Marina, beside Lake Kerkini. It offers courses that combine different landscapes and terrain, from flat asphalt routes to challenging mountain trails. Each course offers a distinctive view of the area’s natural beauty, with the chance to run among imposing rocky outcrops and through landscapes that change from dawn to sunset. The event also includes free activities for families and children, making it a full-day sporting experience for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes extending from the western side to the eastern embankment of Lake Kerkini
A combination of mountain trails, dirt paths and asphalt across different routes
A running experience among imposing rocky outcrops and the lake
additional: Free activities for children and families on Saturday. Free bus transportation. Technical T-shirts and a commemorative finisher’s medal in every race. Chip timing and an athlete bib. Maurten energy gels and a light meal provided. Medical coverage and a rescue team are available. Changing rooms, showers and a baggage-storage area are available. Free photographs. Water and refreshments along the course. Includes free bus transportation, routes offering different levels of difficulty, and a celebration of sport in a captivating natural setting.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The 16th Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, singing, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folk performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances by traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunities to take part in or observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants submit applications through an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, covering different folk genres in a competitive format. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO to provide advisory services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from across Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities to exchange traditions.

description: The 3rd Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run invites you to discover the wild, unspoiled beauty of Mount Panetoliko through three spectacular routes. The races offer a unique mountain-running experience amid fir-covered slopes, waterfalls, alpine peaks, and picturesque trails. The event welcomes both experienced runners and newcomers to the sport, with electronic timing, aid stations, and transportation to and from the city of Agrinio. Experience the magic of the mountain and create unforgettable memories.
course_highlights: Routes featuring fir-covered slopes and alpine peaks
Passage through picturesque trails and waterfalls
1,030 meters of elevation gain in the 21 km race
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip. Free bus transportation is available to and from the cities of Agrinio and Antirrio, while spaces last. Race numbers and athlete packs are distributed at race headquarters up to 30 minutes before the start. Runners in the 21 km and 8 km races receive a technical dry-fit shirt, a commemorative medal, a surprise running accessory, and a bag of local products. The event takes place on June 21, 2026. Registration opens in March 2026. Transportation options are available from Agrinio and Antirrio. Official merchandise.

name: 3ο Galatsi Night Run
price_range: 10€ για μη κατοίκους, δωρεάν για κατοίκους

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Δημότες και κάτοικοι άλλων δήμων μπορούν να συμμετέχουν με αντίτιμο 10€

description: The 3rd Galatsi Night Run is a nighttime running event held in Galatsi, Athens, starting and finishing at the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium - PALE. The 5 km course follows the city’s main road, Veikou Avenue. There is also a 1 km children’s race for primary school students, held within the grounds of PALE. The event promotes public participation in sport and physical exercise, with an emphasis on safety and an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Nighttime 5 km race along the main road, Veikou Avenue
1 km children’s race within the grounds of the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium - PALE
Safe, looped course for children, free of vehicles
additional: Participants can collect their race packs at PALE on Saturday, June 20 (10:00–15:00) and Sunday, June 21 (10:00–13:00). Galatsi residents and municipal citizens participate free of charge. The children’s race starts at 20:40 and the 5 km race at 20:55. Awards are presented to the top three overall finishers, and all participants receive medals. The race includes online registration, a participation pack, medical coverage, and participation limits of 1,500 adults and 200 children.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: The 5th ORESTIS Road Race in Orestiada is a sporting event that attracts runners and sports enthusiasts from the area. The race offers an opportunity to take part in an organized route through the city, promoting health and physical activity. The event is friendly and open to everyone, aiming to strengthen the local community and promote sports. It has become an important sporting occasion for the Orestiada area.
course_highlights: 10 km routes and possibly other distances
Participants from Greece and Bulgaria
Organized in a scenic area of Orestiada
additional: The race is an important sporting event for the area, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
location: Φλώρινα, Δήμος Φλώρινας, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Φλώρινας, Ελλάδα
description: The Municipality of Florina and GoEvents are organizing the two-day running event GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY, a sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with the beauty of the city of Florina. The races take place on June 20 & 21, starting and finishing at Georgiou Modi Square. Runners of all ages and ability levels are invited to take part in routes through the city and along the Sakoulevas River, enjoying the area’s distinctive atmosphere. The events include 10 km and 5 km races, a 3 km night race, and a 1 km fun run for families and children.
course_highlights: A dynamic 10-kilometer urban route through Florina, starting from the village of Simos Ioannidis
A scenic 5-kilometer route along the Sakoulevas River, beside the water and greenery
A 3-kilometer night race in the city center, with music and lighting creating a festive atmosphere
additional: The races start and finish at Georgiou Modi Square. Participation is open to people aged 18 and over; participants under 18 must provide a signed parental or guardian consent form. Medals are awarded to all participants, and prizes to the top three in each age and gender category. The event emphasizes urban exploration and family participation, with multiple routes and activities in a welcoming setting.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: The 25th Road Race and Power Walking Event “In the Footsteps of the Apostle Paul” is organized by the Municipality of Corinth and symbolically retraces the route followed by the Apostle Paul in the area. The race takes place on Sunday, June 21, 2026, starting from the ancient port of Kenchreai and finishing at the main square of Ancient Corinth. The course is 11.4 kilometers long and includes three support stations along the way. It is a historic and cultural route that combines sport and tradition.
course_highlights: 11.4 km route from the ancient port of Kenchreai to Ancient Corinth
Three support stations along the route
Symbolic retracing of the Apostle Paul’s journey
additional: The course map is available via the event’s online platform (Google My Maps). The event is held as part of local celebrations, with traffic management by the traffic police and medical coverage provided by Corinth Hospital. All finishers receive a technical T-shirt and also take part in the event.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances suited to skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience amid Bulgaria’s natural scenery, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site
Stunning views and a skyrunning course
A range of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points, respectively, from a previous race are required to register. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times before the start. Transport to the start area is provided for the 25 km distance. The awards ceremony takes place at Central Square in Bansko. A multi-distance race featuring an ultramarathon and mountain routes, with exceptional natural views.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop of around 5 km with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose from three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop of around 5 km
Held in Vrana Park, on the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation gain along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is one loop of around 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The minimal elevation gain makes it suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and offers different distances. It is held in Vrana Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park, with the start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park with varied terrain
Start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State
Includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, bicycles must meet EU requirements, with a speed limit of 25 km/h and a power limit of 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on site.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: The SNF Nostos Run 2026 is a much-loved evening road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, returning on June 23 to celebrate 30 years of the SNF’s philanthropic work. The race features 10 km, 6 km, and 1 km routes for Special Olympics athletes, starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center. The event emphasizes giving and solidarity: the SNF will contribute three times the total amount raised through participant fees to support nonprofit organizations. Along the route, participants will enjoy music from percussion bands and a DJ set at the finish. Timing is official, but the race is non-competitive.
course_highlights: 10 km and 6 km routes starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the SNFCC
1 km route for Special Olympics athletes
Music along the route from the Batala and Quilombo percussion bands, and a DJ set at the finish
additional: The race is non-competitive, but official timing will be provided. The event is organized in collaboration with the nonprofit organization Anagennisi & Proodos, under the scientific supervision of Sports Excellence, the Department of Athletic Excellence at the First Department of Orthopaedic Surgery of the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens. The SNF will contribute three times the total amount raised through participant fees to support the nonprofits Lampsi and Pnoe Agapis. The urban routes are designed to emphasize charitable action and support for organizations serving children with cancer and cancer patients. The event also includes a special 1 km route for Special Olympics athletes.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: The 2nd Silk City Run in Soufli is a road race inviting amateur and experienced runners, families, and young people to enjoy a unique route through the city of silk. Running through the streets of Soufli is not just a race, but a journey toward a healthier, more balanced, and more creative way of life. The Municipality of Soufli warmly welcomes all participants, offering an opportunity for renewal and energy.
course_highlights: Route through Soufli, known as the city of silk
A welcoming setting for amateur and experienced runners
An opportunity for families and young people to take part in a sporting event
additional: 5 km and 10 km routes, electronic timing, refreshment station, participation for ages 18 and over

name: 11ες Ορεινές Διαδρομές Βοριτσίου
description: The 11th Voritsi Mountain Routes is a trail running event held in Voritsi, Heraklion, Crete, on June 27, 2026. The event offers various routes through beautiful natural scenery and across varied terrain, ideal for runners who love adventure and the outdoors. It gives athletes and nature lovers an opportunity to enjoy Crete’s beauty through an organized and welcoming sporting experience.
course_highlights: Mountain routes through natural scenery
Varied terrain and trails
Routes suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The trail races include Tsikoudia Trail, Lagoudera, and Voritsani Relay. The route is probably mountainous and technical, with several options for participants and detailed instructions available.

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: The Olympus Marathon is a unique 44-kilometer mountain running race with +3350 meters of elevation gain, held on the mythical Mount Olympus. The route starts at the archaeological site of Dion and follows trails through forests, alpine meadows, and peaks, reaching Litochoro. The race honors the ancient tradition of pilgrims who climbed Mount Olympus to pay tribute to Zeus, offering runners a unique experience as they follow the traces of history on the mountain of the gods. It is a certified SKYRUNNING race and a challenge for experienced mountain runners.
course_highlights: 44 kilometers with +3350 meters of elevation gain
Route from the archaeological site of Dion to Litochoro
Passing through alpine meadows, beech forests, and the peaks of Mount Olympus
additional: The route includes three aid and water stations, an athlete's gift pack, a pasta party on the Friday before the race, a finisher's medal, and transport from Litochoro. The race has a 12-hour time limit and requires participants to have prior mountain-racing experience. Technical support, first aid, and volunteers are available along the entire route. The event includes accompanying races such as the Olympus Ultra 71 km, Olympus Vertical 4 km, Melindra Trail 5 km, and Kopsi ton Aeton 14 km. Registration opens in February 2026, with early-bird discounts. The event combines sport, nature, and tradition.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
location: Παραλία του Πόρτο Χέλι, Πόρτο Χέλι, Αργολίδας, Greece
description: The Municipality of Ermionida and the Municipal Community of Porto Heli invite you to the major sports celebration “Porto Heli Night Run,” taking place on Saturday, June 27, 2026. The race is dedicated to the memory of Minos Kyriakou and includes events for everyone, from an 11 km trail run and a 5 km night run to children’s races and a race for people with disabilities. Each participant will receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal, offering a unique sporting experience in beautiful Porto Heli.
course_highlights: 11 km Trail Run in a natural setting
5 km Night Run with atmospheric lighting
Children’s races of 500 m and 1,000 m, and a 300 m race for people with disabilities
additional: A commemorative T-shirt and medal for all participants. Multiple courses and categories, with registration open until 24/06/2026; medals and T-shirts for all participants.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings, near Koprinka Reservoir in Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: 2 km swim along the sandy shores of Koprinka Reservoir
60 km cycling through the forests of Sredna Gora over rugged terrain
15 km run through the forest and along the reservoir shore, with panoramic views
additional: Cutoff times: swimming — 1:40 hours; cycling — 5:30 hours; running — 2:30 hours. Any time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is limited to people over 18. The day before the race, there is a children’s race for different age groups. Courses: 2 km swimming, 60 km cycling, 14 km running; registration at different prices; included: medals, aid stations, professional timing, medical support, bicycle service, prizes, and photos.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a waste-free race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: A 9-stage loop around Vitosha, passing through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultramarathon with varied terrain and elevation
Start and finish in front of Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the ALPI store in Sofia and at the start, up to 60 minutes before the race. The race emphasizes environmental protection: participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. A special SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels is available. The awards ceremony takes place on race day after the finish. The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon disciplines. The course includes remote parts of the mountain, with a total elevation gain of over 2,000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of a mountain ultramarathon and cycling event.

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: The 4th “Kakolyri 1944” Memorial Run honors the victims of the 1944 massacre in the village of Taxiarches. It is organized by the Municipality of Kymi-Aliveri and the Taxiarches Cultural Association, with support from cultural associations and communities in the area. It includes a 21 km half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1.2 km children’s race, with routes passing through historic villages and natural landscapes. The event offers electronic timing, commemorative medals and T-shirts, as well as full support with aid stations and medical coverage.
course_highlights: A 20.8 km circular half-marathon route passing through the villages of Pyrgos, Andronianoi, Taxiarches, Giannides, Agios Vlasis, and Konnistres
Aid stations with water and electrolytes at several points along the route
Routes combining trails, dirt roads, and settlements of historical and natural interest
additional: Electronic timing by Fitrace. All athletes receive a commemorative medal and a dry-fit T-shirt. There are 7 water stations along the half-marathon route and 2 stations along the 5 km route. Water, fruit, soft drinks, and savory snacks are provided at the finish. Medical coverage is provided by a doctor, an EKAB ambulance, and volunteer rescuers. The event is supported by volunteer groups and associations. It includes technical descriptions, GPX route maps, historical facts and information, as well as participation and support from volunteers and associations such as the Hellenic Red Cross and the Evia Runners Association.

name: Coast To Coast Run
description: The Coast to Coast Run in Ierapetra, Crete, is a 21,100-meter half marathon starting at Pachia Ammos beach and finishing at Minos Square in Ierapetra. It crosses the narrowest point of Crete, passing beautiful natural scenery and the Ha Gorge. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race are also held in the town of Ierapetra. The event has a cultural and tourism focus, offering a unique experience that connects the north and south coasts of eastern Crete. The organizers provide transportation for athletes and ensure the races are held safely.
course_highlights: 21,100-meter half marathon from Pachia Ammos beach to Ierapetra
Route crossing the narrowest point of Crete, with views of Ha Gorge
The final 4 kilometers run through Ierapetra, with views of the South Cretan Sea
additional: Half-marathon participants are transported by bus from Minos Square until 08:00 a.m. The 5,000-meter race and the 5,000-meter Health Run & Power Walking event start and finish at Minos Square. There is also a 1,000-meter children’s race. The event includes various routes and activities, highlighting the beauty of nature and community participation.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. It is organized by the Troyan in the Future Association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km and 70 km, with varying elevation gain
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan, featuring natural and historical landmarks
Open to both professionals and enthusiasts
additional: Race packs are collected on site, with priority given to participants in the longer distances. Participants must carry their race number, a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and a mobile phone with the organizers’ number. The program includes a technical briefing and an awards ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events promoting an active lifestyle

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose from an ultra-distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for an active holiday in the national resort of Varshets.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a range of distances
Start in front of Hotel Medicus in the town of Varshets
Routes through scenic natural surroundings
additional: Race packs can be collected at Varshets Municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12–13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start at Hotel Medicus; online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach between Kamchia Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and aids provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River.
The distances are 10 km and 21.1 km, with aid stations approximately every 5 km.
Runners can run barefoot, and rescue equipment is provided for the river crossing.
additional: The start is in the evening. Race numbers are distributed from 15:00, and baggage storage is available. The time limits are 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3 hours 30 minutes for 10 km. Children can take part in the 2.2 km children’s run for free. Participants must bring a water container for the aid stations. Timing uses RFID chips. In unfavorable conditions, the river crossing may be made by boats provided by the organizers. Registration is available online and on site. Fees can be paid via EasyPay or ePay. Accompaniment is available, and children under 7 may participate with an accompanying adult.

name: 8ο Skloupo Trail Run

description: The 8th Skloupo Trail Run is a trail race held in the picturesque village of Ampelochori (Skloupo), in the Municipality of North Tzoumerka. It features three races: 13.5 km, 5 km, and a 1 km Kids Race, offering a unique experience through forests of fir and conifer trees, with steep climbs and descents. The course combines dirt trails and paved sections, with beautiful natural scenery and historic sites in the village. The race is open to runners of all ages, with special care for younger participants.
course_highlights: 13.5 km course, including 8.35 km of dirt trail through a forest of fir and conifer trees
Significant total elevation gain of 395 metres
Passes historic sites and traditional trails in Ampelochori
additional: Runners receive a race pack with a bib and timing chip, safety pins, and a commemorative T-shirt. The maximum number of entries is 300 for the two adult races and 50 for the Kids Race. Time limits are 2 hours for the 13.5 km race and 1 hour for the 5 km race. Discarding items along the course is prohibited, and regulations are strictly enforced. Three courses, electronic timing, medical services, photography coverage, commemorative T-shirt and medal, entry in the 1 km Kids Race

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the scenic resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a 48 km ultra distance
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
A 1 km distance for children and beginners
additional: The start is in front of Hotel Medicus. Race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of Hotel Medicus; registration at www.runbulgaria.org

name: 3ο Πολύλοφος Run
description: The 3rd Polylophos Run is organized by the Polylophos Messinia Cultural Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Messini. The event features road races and power walking over 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 m routes around the community of Polylophos. The course is mixed, with asphalt and dirt sections, and both the start and finish are at the central square of the local community. The event aims to bring athletes and recreational participants together for physical activity that improves health and quality of life, while showcasing the natural beauty of the area.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 m routes around the community of Polylophos
Mixed course with asphalt and dirt sections
Start and finish at the central square of Polylophos
additional: Event schedule: 17:30 registration desk opens for race-pack collection, 19:15 start of the 10 km race, 19:20 start of the 1000 m race, 19:30 start of the 5000 m race, 20:45 finish line closes, 21:00 awards ceremony and refreshments featuring local products at the central square. Routes of 10 km, 5 km, and 1000 m; races for all ages; running races; events for students and adults; technical support and prizes.

name: 5ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Κουρκούλας
description: The 5th Kourkoula Night Run is a distinctive night race over 5.5 and 11 kilometers, held on Mount Kourkoula in Glykovrysi, Laconia. The race offers a unique experience in which the light comes not from the sun but from the runners themselves, with headlamps illuminating every step. The course combines exercise with a sense of exploration and enjoyment of the moment, creating an almost mystical calm. It is a challenge for those who want to experience something different and enjoy the night with determination and energy.
course_highlights: Night course of 5.5 and 11 kilometers on Mount Kourkoula
Illumination provided only by the runners’ headlamps
An almost mystical calm and a sense of exploration
additional: The race is organized by the Kallisthenis Athletic and Cultural Association and the Local Community of Glykovrysi, Municipality of Evrotas. The start is at 21:15 on the evening of Saturday, July 11, 2026. A headlamp is required to illuminate the route. 5.5- and 11-kilometer courses, a downhill race, a 1-kilometer race for children, a race on a paved road, participation by cars in the event, start from Old Kourkoula.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. Held at a stadium in Sofia, it offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talent in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Stadium competition in Sofia
Participation by the best athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, which has a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will bring together young athletes from across the country.

description: TRI Legend Batak 2026 is a triathlon event taking place on July 11, 2026, at Batak Reservoir. The race offers three distances: Legend, Turbo, and Legend Relay, suitable for both experienced athletes and beginners. The course is marked and has aid stations, while the atmosphere is filled with camaraderie and challenge. This is a place where the race happens with you, not just for you.
course_highlights: Legend: 1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run
Turbo: 0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run
Legend Relay: the same distance as Legend, completed by a team of two or three
additional: Marked course, aid stations, and limited places for each distance (Legend - 120, Turbo - 60, Legend Relay - 20 teams). The race fosters community and camaraderie among participants. Distances: Legend (1.9 km swim, 90 km cycling, 21 km run), Turbo (0.9 km swim, 52 km cycling, 10 km run), Relay (the same as Legend, in teams). Registration with different prices and places. The event is part of a legendary experience in the Rhodope Mountains and is suitable for both advanced athletes and beginners.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
price_range: 12 € (5 χλμ, με μπλούζα), 15 € (10 χλμ, με μπλούζα), δωρεάν (παιδικός)
description: The 4th Mytilene Night Run is a popular nighttime road race held in the city of Mytilene. The 5 km and 10 km routes cross the city, starting and finishing at Tsamakia, with much of the course following pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic. The race is organized by the Lesvos Runners Club in cooperation with the Municipality of Mytilene and other local organizations, offering a unique running experience under the night sky. High participation and a warm atmosphere characterize the event, which has become an institution on the island of Lesvos.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the city of Mytilene
Start and finish at Tsamakia
Much of the route follows pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic
additional: A 1 km children's race on the pedestrian street took place beforehand, with children participating. After the races, awards are presented at the beach at Tsamakia. Lesvos Ride provides technical support, and medical coverage is provided by Mytilene Hospital and other organizations. The Traffic Police and Port Traffic Police cooperate in managing traffic. The race is held under the auspices of the Lesvos Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS Lesvos). Registration is available online until July 9, 2026, and the event takes place as part of the Lesvian Summer events. Participants can enjoy special offers on ferry tickets and run along the city's illuminated streets.

description: The 15th Faethon Skyrace “Apostolos Tsourekas” will take place on July 12, 2026, in Kokkinopilos on Mount Olympus. This is a challenging mountain-running event offering two courses: the Faethon SkyRace, 23 km with +1,800 m of elevation gain over alpine terrain, and the Faethon Trail, 14 km with +400 m, crossing historic trails and lush forests. The event also includes the 1 km Faethonaki Run for children, giving them the opportunity to discover mountain running. The race starts from the central square of Kokkinopilos, and the event is driven by a vision and love for Mount Olympus and mountain running.
course_highlights: Faethon SkyRace: 23 km with +1,800 m of elevation gain over alpine terrain, reaching peaks of up to 2,520 m
Faethon Trail: 14 km with +400 m, along historic trails and through lush forests
Routes along trails of exceptional natural beauty on Mount Olympus, with alpine ridgelines and pristine forest
additional: The race has a 6-hour cutoff (until 14:00). There is an intermediate refreshment station at Diaselo Kardara, at 14 km and an elevation of 2,340 m, with a 3.5-hour cutoff. Participation is open to people over 18 who have completed a mountain race of at least 15 km within the last 2 years. A medical certificate is not required, but participants must sign a declaration of responsibility. The event also includes the 1 km Faethonaki Run for children, which takes place on Saturday, July 11. Registration opens on April 15, 2026. The event features mountain running, skyrunning, and routes over technical and natural terrain.

name: Faethon Skyrace
description: Faethon Skyrace is a demanding mountain-running race held on mythical Mount Olympus, in the Kokkinopilos area. The 24-kilometer route, with +1,800 meters of elevation gain, offers a unique experience across trails, alpine terrain, and peaks above 2,000 meters. The race starts from the village’s central square and has a 6-hour time limit, with intermediate aid stations. It is intended for experienced athletes in good physical condition with experience in mountain races.
course_highlights: 24 km route with +1,800 m of elevation gain
Trails and alpine terrain on western Mount Olympus
Passage through the unspoiled forest of Kokkinopilos and peaks above 2,000 m
additional: The race is limited to 300 participants. A medical certificate is not required, but participants must sign a declaration of responsibility. There is a 6-hour finish time limit, with an intermediate aid station at Diaselo Kardara, at 14 km (2,340 m elevation). Free bus transport from Thessaloniki is provided for athletes. The event includes races of 23 km, 14 km, and 1 km for children, with registration by bank transfer, and participation in a race of high difficulty and natural beauty. The start and finish are in a historic area with a rich natural and cultural heritage.

name: XL kmrun - Сеславци
description: XLkmrun is an organized, non-professional track and field race over middle and long distances, offering a challenge for runners of different fitness levels. The event takes place in Sofia and is part of the 5KM RUN initiative, which promotes a healthy lifestyle through free, organized running. It gives everyone the opportunity to take part in a sporting atmosphere that embraces diversity and community.
course_highlights: Middle and long distances
Organized but non-professional race
Takes place in Sofia
additional: The event is part of an initiative to promote running and a healthy lifestyle in Bulgaria.

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: The Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) race is the largest mountain running event in Greece, offering a unique experience amid the natural beauty and culture of the Zagori region. With routes crossing stone bridges and villages and passing through the impressive Vikos Gorge, runners can test their endurance on demanding trails with significant elevation changes. ZMR includes multiple routes, from a 5 km race for everyone to the two-day 93 km Challenge, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The event is welcoming and professional, with an emphasis on athlete safety and support.
course_highlights: Routes featuring stone-built bridges and villages of Zagori
The impressive Vikos Gorge and the Tymfi mountain range
Significant elevation changes and demanding trails
additional: Races start at different times depending on the route: the Challenge and TeRA start at 05:00, the Zagori Classic 33 km at 06:30, the Half Marathon at 07:30, the Forest 10 km at 08:45, the Fun 5 km at 21:00, and the ZAGORAKI Kids Race at 19:00. The Challenge is a two-day race (18–19 July 2026) covering a total of 93 km. Special routes are available for children and runners of all levels. The event provides support and aid stations, and enforces strict rules to ensure participants’ safety. It includes races for children and adults, with registration opening on 27 March 2026. Information is available about accommodation, regulations, and volunteering.

name: Трявна ултра
description: Tryavna Ultra is an ultramarathon offering challenging distances amid the beautiful Balkan Mountains scenery around the town of Tryavna. The event includes 100 km, 42 km and 21 km races, as well as cycling routes and a duathlon. The courses have varied terrain and include numerous aid stations to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. It is organized by the iRun association, which has many years of experience staging sporting events and building a sports community.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distances from 21 km to 100 km
Varied mountain terrain with elevation profiles exceeding 1,500 m
Numerous aid stations along the courses
additional: The event includes running, cycling and duathlon with combined distances. The organizer, iRun, is an association with more than 50 sporting events held. The website has information about accommodation, the event’s history and results from previous years. Multiple distances for running, cycling and duathlon; an event with technical conferences and race packs; held in the town of Tryavna, Bulgaria.

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, 33 km, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Zagori Mountain Running is Greece’s largest mountain running race, offering a unique experience through the region’s imposing landscapes. The routes cross stone bridges, the Vikos Gorge and the Tymfi mountain range, combining natural beauty with demanding terrain. With multiple route options, from 5 km to 93 km, the race caters to runners of all preferences and levels. The event is welcoming and well organized, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: Zagori’s stone arch bridges
The impressive Vikos Gorge
The Tymfi mountain range, with significant elevation changes
additional: Multiple routes with different dates and start times: Challenge 93 km over 2 days (18–19/07/2026, 05:00 & 06:30), TeRA 60 km (18/07/2026, 05:00), Classic Race 33 km (19/07/2026, 06:30), Half Marathon 21 km (18/07/2026, 07:30), Forest 10 km (19/07/2026, 08:45), Fun 5 km (18/07/2026, 21:00), ZAGORAKI Kids Race (18/07/2026, 19:00). Registration opens on 27 March 2026, with entries also available for children’s races and fun runs. The event also provides information about accommodation and transport in the area.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: The Salt Road is a running race held in Messolonghi, offering 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m courses. The event emphasizes accurate electronic timing and excellent organization, aiming to offer runners from all over Greece an unforgettable experience. It combines sporting spirit with local tradition, attracting participants of all ages and abilities. The organizers ensure prompt results announcements and provide commemorative participation certificates.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m courses
Accurate electronic chip timing
Double start and finish gates, 4 meters wide
additional: Registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Results are announced and posted promptly, 5–10 minutes after the race ends. A commemorative electronic participation certificate with individual results is provided. The race announcer keeps participants informed throughout the event. The race is a celebration of sport and the local community, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the area's cultural heritage.

name: I Run Myrtos
description: The Myrtos Cultural Association, in collaboration with the Ierapetra Health Runners Association, organizes the I Run Myrtos race, featuring 12.2-kilometer and 5-kilometer routes, as well as a 750-meter children’s race. The race takes place in Myrtos Square and offers electronic timing and aid stations. The course is mostly paved and has little elevation change, making it suitable for runners of all ages. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with awards and commemorative medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Myrtos Square
12.2 km and 5 km routes with little elevation change
Electronic timing and aid stations on each route
additional: The 750-meter children’s race is free for children aged 6–12 with parental consent. Awards go to the first three men and women overall and the first finisher in each age category. Men and women have separate age categories. The course has aid stations at specific kilometer points. terrain: flat, registration: online until 14 July 2025, includes technical T-shirt, medals, water, medical support

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: The 10th WAVE Running returns in full force on July 24–25, 2026, along the Keramoti–Avdira coastline, with its main base at Myrodato Beach in Xanthi. The anniversary event offers three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km through the unique natural environment of the Nestos Delta. Side events highlight the event’s character and philosophy, including beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical events, creating a complete celebration of sport, nature, and culture.
course_highlights: Three routes: 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km
The natural environment of the Nestos Delta
Main base at Myrodato Beach
additional: Side events such as beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical events highlight the event’s character and philosophy. Routes: 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km; natural environment, side events, exhibitions, musical events.

name: Балкан ултра
description: Balkan Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in the area around Pleven Hut, Apriltsi. The courses include technical sections with significant elevation gain and require good physical fitness and mountain skills. Participants can choose between two main distances—Sky and Ultra—each with a unique route through beautiful and challenging mountain terrain. The race offers impressive views and varied trails, including passages over peaks such as Botev and Mlechnia Chal.
course_highlights: Technical sections with significant elevation gain and a climb to Botev Peak
A route along the mountain ridge with varied terrain and steep descents
A long ridge run passing numerous mountain huts and checkpoints
additional: Participants in the Ultra distance must have valid mountain insurance and must have finished two races with at least 4,000 meters of elevation gain in the past 3 years. Entry to the Sky distance is open to all. A GPS device is mandatory for navigation using the provided GPS track. There are checkpoints with cut-off times, for example, at Petolachkata—10 hours. The courses include technical sections; accommodation options include Pleven Hut, camping, or staying in Apriltsi. The race is approximately 78 km long, with a record under 13 hours.

name: Магура Run
description: Magura RUN is a running event held near the village of Rabisha, Belogradchik, in northwestern Bulgaria. The event celebrates a love of movement and running, inviting all runners to take part regardless of their pace. The course offers a unique experience in nature, with the chance to run at both sunset and sunrise, combining sport with the beauty of the local landscape. The organizers, BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, put a great deal of effort and energy into creating an authentic and challenging event that may be the last of its kind because of changes in nature.
course_highlights: The course passes by Rabisha Lake and through the area around the village of Rabisha
The chance to run at sunset and sunrise
Held amid the scenic natural landscapes of northwestern Bulgaria
additional: The event is organized by BG EVENTS AND GUIDING, with an emphasis on authenticity and energy. Possible challenges in preparing for the event include finding workers to clear the course. The race takes place on July 27 and 28 near Rabisha Lake. No information is provided about start times, prices, or registration.

name: Национален шампионат под 23г.
description: The National Championships for boys and girls under 18 are one of the largest events in the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s sporting calendar. The competition features a range of events, with the discus and hammer events held at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad. Traditionally, the championships bring together young athletes from across the country, giving them the opportunity to compete at a high level and showcase their talent. The event is organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: Track and field events for boys and girls under 18
Discus and hammer events at the National Sports Academy in Studentski Grad
Competition held at Vasil Levski National Stadium
additional: Venue: Pravets; events: long jump and triple jump; date: 25 July 2026

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: The 2nd Oinousses Run is a unique event combining running and cycling on the enchanting island of Oinousses. The 13 km running course passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation and offers impressive views of Chios, while the 20 km cycling route makes a full loop of the island, with gentle climbs and fast descents. Participants enjoy a wonderful experience amid picturesque landscapes and coastal routes, with amenities including electronic timing, a medal, a commemorative T-shirt, and aid stations. The event is organized by the Chios Cyclists and the Municipality of Oinousses, offering a friendly, summertime sporting event.
course_highlights: Coastal and traditional routes
Passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation
Impressive views of Chios
additional: The maximum number of participants is 150 athletes due to limited places on the ferry. Race amenities: race number, electronic timing, commemorative T-shirt, finisher's medal, aid stations (water, isotonic drinks, fruit), medical coverage, photography coverage, and 50% off ferry transport. The event includes 13 km and 20 km routes, with participation limited to 150 athletes, and offers commemorative T-shirts, a medal, aid stations, and medical coverage.

name: Славееви Планини Ултра
distance_verbose: 50 km, 50 km, 33 km, 28 km, 16 km, 10 km
description: Slaveevi Planini Ultra 2026 is a trail running and mountain biking event held in the surroundings of the town of Dospat in the Rhodope Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 9 to 56 km, with different difficulty levels and up to 2,900 m of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy scenic forests, panoramic views, and fresh air, combining sport, adventure, and a love of the mountains. The start and finish are in the town center, and the race is suitable for both experienced runners and cyclists and enthusiasts looking for new challenges.
course_highlights: Distances from 9 to 56 km with up to 2,900 m of elevation gain
Route through scenic forests with panoramic views
Start and finish in the center of Dospat
additional: The race package includes a medal, a souvenir bearing the event logo, timing, a race number, course marking, photo coverage, and aid stations. Additional and mandatory equipment is not included. Registration at lower fees is available until April 30, 2026, 23:59:59; payment is due by May 2 at 12:00. Registration at early-bird fees is available until April 30, 2026, with medals, race packages, and aid stations included.
