description: The first national road running championships in Bulgaria will take place in Plovdiv on August 1, 2026. The event features distances of 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as races for children and beginners. It is part of the Run Bulgaria series and offers a prize fund of over 4,000 BGN. This is an important opportunity for recreational and professional runners to compete on attractive courses and prepare for European and world championships.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 mile (1,609 m), 5 km, 10 km and half marathon (21.1 km)
The race takes place in Plovdiv, one of Bulgaria’s major cities
Includes 1 km races for children and beginners
additional: The 1 km mass participation run is free for everyone. Before the championships, there will be Kids’ Athletics activities and a press conference with awards for the best runners of 2024. The race is part of the Run Bulgaria series and serves as preparation for the European Road Running Championships. Distances: 1 mile, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 1 km for children and beginners; online registration; a 40 BGN entry fee for some distances; free 1 km mass participation start.

name: С ухание на малини и боровинки Run
description: With the scent of raspberries and blueberries, Run is an exciting trail running race held in northwestern Bulgaria, in the area of Midzhur Hut and Kopren Hut. Participants can choose from courses of varying difficulty and technical features, running amid stunning mountain views. The race offers adrenaline, new friendships, and a sense of achievement on every course. The organizers recommend wearing trail running shoes and note that the race may be canceled in unfavorable weather conditions.
course_highlights: Mountain courses of varying difficulty and technical features
Stunning views in northwestern Bulgaria between the Iskar and Timok rivers
The opportunity to climb peaks and run in nature
additional: A reservation must be made at least one week before the chosen date. The races do not include transportation to the venue. Participants must wear specialized trail running shoes. The voucher is valid for one participant. The race may be canceled in bad weather. Information about the course, registration, and participation requirements is unavailable; the event is part of trail running races in northwestern Bulgaria.

name: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare
description: Green Heart Half Ultra Chepelare is an event in the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in Chepelare, in the Western Rhodopes. The start and finish are at Olympic Square, at an elevation of 1,062 m. The courses pass through Rhodope forests, mountain meadows, and panoramic ridge trails, reaching a maximum elevation of 1,872 m. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking.
course_highlights: The courses pass through Rhodope forests and mountain meadows
Panoramic ridge trails reach a maximum elevation of 1,872 m
Three distances with elevation gain of up to +1,887 m and descent of up to −1,885 m
additional: Free parking opens at 05:00 at Vasil Dechev Secondary School. Registration and race-pack collection are from 6:30 to 8:00 at Olympic Square, with on-site payment available via Revolut, PayPal, or ePay. Mountain biking and running starts are separated by distance and begin between 8:30 and 9:30. There is a children's run and a children's program with yoga, games, and cake. The children's awards and awards for all distances are scheduled for the afternoon. The event includes different distances and packages for combined participation, with the mountain biking start scheduled for 08:30 on August 1, 2026.

name: 10α Παραποτάμια
description: The Pantavrechei Mountaineering Club is organizing the 10th consecutive edition of the Riverside Races on August 2, 2026, in Prodromos, Evrytania. These are mixed river-crossing and trail races, with two routes of 8 and 14 kilometers starting at Dipotama Prousou and finishing in the square in Prodromos. The course includes sections through the water, trails with 350 meters of elevation gain, and two water stations. The event is co-organized with the Evrytania Regional Unit and the Municipality of Karpenisi, under the auspices of the SEGAS Association of Central Greece.
course_highlights: Two routes of 8 and 14 km with a shared start and finish
Crossings through the waters of the Krikelopotamos and Prousiotis rivers
350 meters of elevation gain and two water stations
additional: The time limit is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Participants who do not finish within this time must sign a declaration and continue at their own risk. The race starts from the Bakoyannis Bridge. The event includes mixed races and trails, with an emphasis on nature and the local community.

name: 13ος Αυξέντιος Δρόμος
description: The 13th Avxentios Race is a 7.4-kilometer road race held in the Pirouniana area of Heraklion, Crete. The start and finish are in the courtyard of the Church of the Holy Spirit. The circular route follows rural dirt roads and accessible trails, passing important local landmarks such as the settlement of Pirouniana, the stone fountain, Agios Georgios Chostos (11th century), the waterfall, and the forest. The race is open to men, women, teenage boys, and teenage girls, offering an opportunity for physical activity in a natural and historic setting.
course_highlights: Circular route along rural dirt roads and accessible trails
Passes through the settlement of Pirouniana and by the stone fountain
Route with views of Agios Georgios Chostos, the waterfall, and the forest
additional: Transport to the start is by bus, or alternatively by private vehicles and pickup trucks. Sports events are held for all ages. The race includes men's and women's age-group categories. The route has minimal paved-road sections and is nature-oriented. Routes of 7.4 km and 600 m; rural grassy track; three age categories; finish in the courtyard of the Church of the Holy Spirit; includes competitive categories and routes for students and teenage girls.

name: Parapotamia -Krikelopotamos o bregmenos dromos
description: The Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos: The Wet Road race is organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania region. This mountain race crosses rivers and trails, offering a unique experience in a natural setting rich in history and beauty. Founded in 2015, the club is active in the region and maintains trails while promoting mountain sports. Taking part in the race supports the continuation of the club’s activities and helps showcase the area.
course_highlights: Routes crossing rivers and trails in South Evrytania
A natural mountain setting rich in history
Trail maintenance and promotion by the organizing club
additional: The Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club was founded in 2015 and organizes the Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos: The Wet Road river-and-trail race. The club opens and maintains trails and recognizes people who have contributed to the region. The club can be contacted by phone and email for registration and information. The event includes trails, river crossings, and local music, with online registration. It takes place on August 2, 2026, in the Evrytania region.

name: 13οι Αυξέντιοι Αγώνες Κρήτης
location: Πιρουνιανά, Αγία Βαρβάρα, Heraklion, Crete, Greece

description: Balkaniada West is a mountain race taking place on 2 August 2026, starting at 06:00. The event includes several distances of varying lengths and elevation gain, with routes through scenic mountain areas around Gorski Rai Hut. The event has a limited number of participants, and applications require prior approval. The organizers provide transport, accommodation and food, as well as branded clothing for those who finish within the cut-off time.
course_highlights: Vertical Kilometer: 3.8 km with 830 m of positive elevation gain
Distances: 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
A 10 km prologue with 900 m of positive elevation gain from the village of Chuprene to Gorski Rai Hut (untimed)
additional: The race has a limited number of participants (30 for the first edition). You must have completed races with cut-off times in 2025 or provide evidence of similar achievements. Transport is arranged from Sofia to Kom Hut and from Kom Hut to the village of Chuprene. Accommodation, dinner and breakfast at Kom and Gorski Rai huts are included. Everyone who finishes successfully receives branded clothing. The event includes a prologue, organized transport, accommodation, breakfasts and branded clothing for finishers. Limited to 30 participants; selection is based on experience.

name: 2ο Olympia Night Run «Run Under Zeus»
description: The 2nd Olympia Night Run “Run Under Zeus” is a night race held in the heart of Ancient Olympia, honoring the tradition of the first Olympic Games. The race takes place under the light of the full moon, bringing to life the myth of Hercules and Zeus and offering a unique running experience in a historic and mythical setting. The event is supported by the Greek National Tourism Organization and aims to combine sport with a message of life and culture.
course_highlights: Night race under the light of the full moon
Route through the heart of Ancient Olympia
Historic and mythical setting with views of the Aegean Sea
additional: The race honors the tradition of the first Olympic Games, which were organized by the Curetes and held under the light of the full moon. It is supported by PharmaLead and the Greek National Tourism Organization. Greek Olympians embrace the event, giving the race an athletic and cultural character. A night race with a cultural character; participation may be possible through registration; the route passes significant archaeological sites in the area.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, environmental and social responsibility, with the help of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as the most beautiful part of life: taking part is considered a victory, and finishing a triumph. The event welcomes everyone, encouraging young people and children to take part in creative and enjoyable activities.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promoting health, well-being and social cohesion
additional: People over 15 may participate in the race. Minors require parental consent to take part. The event is organized on a nonprofit basis with the help of volunteers and promotes social responsibility and cohesion. Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, open to participants over 15, promote health and social cohesion. The Namati race on 9 August 2026 is the largest mountain race in Western Macedonia.

name: RILA RUN
description: Ride Or Run - Rila is a popular and unconventional race held in the Rila Mountains, starting in the village of Pastra and finishing at Kalin Reservoir. The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with more than 1,800 meters of elevation gain. The race attracts both cyclists and runners, who face a serious challenge in mountain conditions. After a hiatus of several years, the event once again brings together the top athletes in this discipline.
course_highlights: 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road
More than 1,800 meters of elevation gain
Route from the village of Pastra to Kalin Reservoir in the Rila Mountains
additional: The course is a 15.3 km climb along a high-mountain road, with aid stations at 5, 10, and 15.3 km. The event offers running, cycling, and duathlon races.

name: Мусала Екстрийм
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race held in Borovets, offering two distances: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains. The race combines technically challenging sections with fast descents and requires strength, speed, and skill. In addition to the individual races, there is a team race, as well as the option to take part in a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain, passing over Yastrebets, Aleko, Musala, and Mancho
16 km Yastrebets Trail Run with 1,000 m of elevation gain on a marked course
Technical, rocky, and steep sections with panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Stara Planina mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race pack collection on the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards for the winners at 11:00 for the Yastrebets Trail Run and at 15:00 for Musala Extreme. The team race has no limit on the number of participants per team. Duathlon with cycling the following day on a route through Lakatiska Rila. The course has technical sections requiring mountain-running skills; registration and an entry fee are required; mandatory equipment applies; shorter-distance races and a team race are available; duathlon with cycling the following day.

name: Musala Extreme
organizer: Клуб за изкуство и спорт "Дунавска" / Borosport
description: Musala Extreme is a challenging mountain race in Borovets, Bulgaria, covering 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain. The course passes over peaks such as Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho, offering impressive views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains. The race requires technical skills on rocky and steep sections, combining strength, speed, and care. The shorter Yastrebets Trail Run, covering 16 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, takes place alongside it and is suitable for runners looking for an easier route. The organizers also offer a team race and a duathlon with cycling the following day.
course_highlights: 38 km with 2,200 m of elevation gain over the peaks of Yastrebets, Aleko, Lyudmil Yankov, Musala, and Mancho
Technical rocky and steep sections requiring skill and care
Panoramic views of the Rila, Pirin, Vitosha, and Balkan Mountains
additional: Start and finish on the ski slope in front of Hotel Rila. Race-pack collection takes place the evening before the race and on race morning. Awards are presented after each distance. Participants can also enter the team race or the duathlon with cycling the following day. The course is 38 km long with 2,200 m of elevation gain, including a climb to Musala Peak and sections through mountain shelters and trails. The registration deadline is August 10, and the race supports initiatives to restore vegetation.

name: Βαλτινές Διαδρομές
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιποπουλιωτών Αθήνας – Πειραϊά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The “Valtines Routes” road races are being held for the fourth consecutive year alongside the Inachos River, in N. Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania. The Chalkiopoulites Association of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit” invites you to take part in a celebration of culture and sport, held as part of the cultural events taking place from August 10 to 17. The races include three routes, with electronic timing and support from volunteers and the local community.
course_highlights: Three routes alongside the Inachos River
Electronic timing
Organized by the Chalkiopoulites Association of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit”
additional: The races take place on Sunday, August 11, 2024, starting at 18:30. The event is supported by volunteers and the local community of Chalkiopoulo. Timing is electronic. The event is part of cultural events running from August 10 to 17. Routes of 1,000 m, 10,000 m, and 5,000 m; electronic timing; cultural events; volunteer support; out-and-back routes finishing at the Primary School.

name: XL kmrun - с. Кътина
description: XL Kătina is a mountain running race in the XLkmrun series, held in the area around the village of Kătina, Sofia. The race offers three distances of varying lengths, suitable for different fitness levels. The routes follow natural trails and cart roads, offering a challenge amid beautiful scenery. The event is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: Mountain running in the area around the village of Kătina
Three distances: 4.8 km, 9.6 km and 14.4 km
Routes on natural trails and cart roads
additional: The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various mountain and park runs in Sofia and other cities. Each event offers a choice of several distances. Results and photos from previous editions are available on the website. No specific information is available about start times, fees or participant caps. The event includes three distances and takes place in August 2026.

name: Хисаря рън
description: Hisarya Run is an annual race that attracts runners of different ages and ability levels. The course starts and finishes at the modern Krepost Stadium and passes the preserved Roman fortress wall and two beautiful parks in Hisarya. The race offers two main distances: 7.85 km for more experienced runners and 1.6 km, suitable for children and teenagers. The event is part of RUN BULGARIA and combines sport with the region’s cultural and historical landmarks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Krepost Stadium
The course passes the Roman fortress wall
The course runs through two beautiful parks in Hisarya
additional: Both professional athletes and children and teenagers take part in the race. Lectures and an athletics academy for children are also included. The event is part of the larger RUN BULGARIA initiative. The next race is scheduled for August 16, 2026. As part of the RUN BULGARIA series, it offers prizes for the winners and participation opportunities for all ages.

name: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra
description: DECATHLON Persenk Ultra is one of Bulgaria’s leading trail running races, held every summer in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains. The event brings together runners from around the world, who can enjoy the unique spirit, culture, and natural beauty of this ancient mountain region. The 50-kilometer course passes through some of the wildest and most beautiful parts of the mountains, including the Wonderful Bridges, the Chimneys, and Tsirikova Church, offering a challenge and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers through the heart of the Rhodope Mountains
Passes by the Wonderful Bridges and the Chimneys
The route includes Tsirikova Church and wild natural scenery
additional: The race is a benchmark for wilderness and natural beauty, combining sport and culture in the heart of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Χίου
description: The 14th Chios Half Marathon is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. The race and accompanying sports and cultural activities will take place in the traditional settlement of Kampos, Chios, on August 23, 2026. Alongside the half marathon, there will also be 1.5 km (children’s), 5 km, and 10.5 km races, as well as races for people with disabilities. This celebration of sport and culture invites runners of all ages and abilities to participate.
course_highlights: Routes through the traditional settlement of Kampos, Chios
Additional races for people with disabilities and a 1.5 km children’s race
Cultural activities alongside the races
additional: The event includes accompanying sports and cultural activities. It is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in cooperation with the Municipality and the Regional Unit of Chios. Races are available for people with disabilities, as well as a 1.5 km children’s race and 5 km and 10.5 km races. Routes through natural landscapes, road and trail events, and activities on the island of Chios.

name: Στη Σκιά του Κριάκουρα
description: The “In the Shadow of Kriakouras” mountain race is being held for the 12th year in Theodoriana, Arta, offering two challenging courses of 10 and 23 kilometres. The routes cross fir forests, rivers and trails of exceptional natural beauty and difficulty, revealing the secrets of the Tzoumerka mountains. The race is dedicated to the person who inspired the first event in 2014 and serves as a qualifying race for participation in major mountain marathons. The start and finish are in the central square of Theodoriana, with all races starting at 10:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Challenging 10 km and 23 km routes amid exceptional natural beauty
Sections through fir forests, three fast-flowing rivers and trails
A wide variety of natural terrain, including wild-boar wallows and bear habitat
additional: Entry includes a technical T-shirt, commemorative medal, electronic timing, individual refreshments and a meal featuring traditional products after the race. Race bibs can be collected from the race office on Saturday from 18:00 to 21:00 and on Sunday from 8:00 to 9:30. There are 12 aid stations on the 23 km course and 4 on the 10 km course. Hiking poles and GPS devices are permitted. Camping is available, along with a wide range of accommodation options in the area. The race takes place on 23 August 2026 and is open to both men and women. The event promotes sport, connection with nature and local tradition.

name: Black Yard Ultra
location: Black Yard Ultra, Βερδικούσια, Λάρισας, Greece
description: BLACK YARD Ultra by Mamali Festival is a challenging ultra trail race that starts and finishes at Mamali Festival Base Camp, at an elevation of approximately 1,454 meters. It features a Last Runner Standing ultra race, a 12-kilometer race, and a 1-kilometer children’s race. The 12-kilometer loop has 514 meters of ascent and runs mainly on trails and dirt roads. The ultra requires experience, as the laps become increasingly demanding and the time allowed to complete them decreases. Base Camp offers camping facilities, showers, food, and a festival atmosphere, creating a unique experience for participants.
course_highlights: 12 km loop with 514 meters of ascent
10 km of trail and 2 km of dirt road
Race elevation of approximately 1,454 meters
additional: The Last Runner Standing race allows 2 hours for the first lap, with the time decreasing by 3 minutes for each subsequent lap. Mandatory gear: headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, and emergency blanket. Base Camp offers free camping, showers, toilets, food, electricity, and a festival atmosphere. Aid stations provide electrolytes, bananas, water, Coca-Cola, and snacks; after 4 hours, potatoes, pasta, and soup are also available. Maximum number of participants: 100. A medical certificate is required. August weather is hot and humid, with an average temperature of 35°C and 25 mm of rainfall, making an early morning start essential. Trail, ultra race, Last Runner Standing format, camping available, registration requires a medical certificate, mandatory gear includes a headlamp, phone, water bottles, rain jacket, and emergency blanket.

description: Mamali BlackYard Ultra 2026 is a Last Runner Standing-style endurance race held in the mountain setting of Mamali, at an elevation of 1,454 meters, on August 29–30, 2026. Runners are challenged to complete consecutive laps of the same course. A 12-kilometer trail race is also held for those seeking a fast-paced mountain experience. There is also a non-timed 1-kilometer children’s race, ideal for families. The event offers a fully organized Base Camp with free camping, coffee, refreshments, and a festival atmosphere throughout the race.
course_highlights: Last Runner Standing-style endurance race with consecutive laps
Mountain course at an elevation of 1,454 meters
Fast-paced 12-kilometer trail race
additional: The event uses electronic chip timing. Race-pack pickup takes place at least one hour before the race and on the previous day at a location to be announced. A Base Camp operates at the start and finish area, offering free camping in an enclosed area, coffee, refreshments, rest areas, and a festival atmosphere. The course may be modified or postponed in the event of dangerous weather conditions. Trail and ultra race, festival atmosphere, camping facilities, medical certificate required, specific equipment required (headlamp, batteries, clothing, food), limited entries (up to 100 participants).

name: Adventure Sky Run
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, offering three distances of varying difficulty and length. The courses pass through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km trail course, and a challenging 55 km run connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa. The race offers impressive natural scenery and the chance to push beyond your limits.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through ancient Rila pine forests
25 km single-track course climbing toward Zeleni Preslap, with panoramic views of the Rila Lakes
The 55 km course connects the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs can be collected on August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 20:00 at Hotel Rila, Borovets Resort, and on the morning of August 29, 2026, before the start. Separate starts: 06:00 for 55 km, 09:00 for 12 km and 25 km. Award ceremony after the race and organized transport for 55 km participants to Samokov and Borovets. Distances: 12 km, 25 km, and 55 km; registration and equipment requirements; held in Borovets and Malyovitsa; mountain running in the Rila Mountains.

name: Adventure Skyrun 2026
location: Malyovitsa Sports Center, Bansko Ski Resort, Samokov, Bulgaria
description: Adventure Skyrun is a mountain race held in the Rila Mountains since 2016, with three distances passing through scenic locations such as Malyovitsa Peak, Musala Peak, Ribni Ezera Hut, and Strashnoto Lake. Participants can choose between a 12 km forest course, a 25 km route with climbs and single-track trails, and a 55 km ultramarathon connecting the resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa, with technical and rocky sections. The race offers impressive natural scenery and challenges for runners with different levels of experience. The organizers provide aid stations and transport after the finish of the longest distance.
course_highlights: 12 km forest course through centuries-old Rila pine forests
25 km of single-track trails and a climb toward Malyovitsa Peak with panoramic views
55 km ultramarathon climbing Musala Peak and passing Ribni Ezera and Strashnoto Lake
additional: Race packs are distributed on 28.08.2026 in front of Hotel Rila in Borovets resort and on 29.08.2026 in front of the Malyovitsa Central Mountain School for the shorter distances. The time limit is 14 hours for the 55 km and 9 hours for the 25 km. Participants must bring their own water container, as there are no bottles at the aid stations. Valid mountain insurance is mandatory for the 25 km and 55 km distances. After the 55 km finish, organized transport to Samokov and Borovets is available. Advance registration and payment are mandatory; equipment is required for 55 km participants; the race is intended for advanced runners; there is no race-day registration except for the children's run.

name: Kom Epic Half Ultra Берковица
description: Kom Epic Half Ultra Berkovitsa is a mountain race, part of the Bulgarian Half Ultra Challenge Series, held in the Western Balkan Mountains. The start is at Yordan Radichkov Square in Berkovitsa, at an elevation of 405 m, and the courses climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), with impressive views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains. Participants can choose from three distances, which are the same for mountain running and mountain biking. The event also includes a children’s race and a rich program for children after the race.
course_highlights: Climb to Kom Peak (2,016 m), the westernmost peak in Bulgaria above 2,000 m
Views of the Danubian Plain, the Rila Mountains and the Rhodope Mountains
Three distances with substantial elevation gain, starting at 405 m above sea level
additional: Free parking at Yordan Radichkov Square, next to the Municipality building. On-site payment by bank transfer, Revolut, PayPal or ePay during registration from 6:30 to 8:00. Children’s yoga, games and cake after the race. Mountain running and mountain biking starts over different distances, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The race is part of an ultramarathon series and is intended for runners seeking a serious mountain challenge.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλληλεγγύης Ι.Ν. Αγίου Χαραλάμπους
7ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Δρόμου Γουμένισσας «Τρέχω Για Μένα»
Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion, with the support of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as a wonderful part of life: taking part is considered a victory, and finishing is a triumph. The event is open to people over 15 and encourages young people and children to participate with their parents’ consent.
course_highlights: Four road races in different locations in the Municipality of Voio
Beautiful mountain routes
Promoting health, well-being, and social cohesion
additional: People over 15 may participate in the race. Parental consent is required for minors. The event is organized with the help of volunteers and promotes environmental and social responsibility. Four different routes in mountain areas; participation for ages 15 and over; volunteer involvement; and raising environmental and social awareness.

name: Δρόμος Μάχης Μαραθώνα
location: Μαραθώνας, Δήμος Μαραθώνα, Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ανατολικής Αττικής, Ελλάδα
description: The Marathon Battle Road Race is a historic running event organized by the Telmissos Marathon Runners’ Association. The race honors the memory of the Battle of Marathon and offers a unique running experience along a route of historical and natural beauty. Telmissos actively supports the race and invites runners of all levels to take part and run together in Marathon. The event includes accompanying races and group registrations, fostering a spirit of community and sporting tradition.
course_highlights: Historic route in Marathon
Natural scenery with views of Lake Marathon
Accompanying 5- and 10-kilometer races
additional: Telmissos offers group registrations for the Athens Marathon and supports accompanying races and ultramarathons. There is also the option to participate in group training sessions and volunteer. The club’s apparel is available to participants. Routes of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon, and ultradistance races, with an emphasis on the area’s history and cultural heritage.

name: Ορειβατικός Μαραθώνιος Ολύμπου
description: The Olympus Mountaineering Marathon is a historic race organized by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Thessaloniki. It is a challenging route across Mount Olympus, offering participants unique natural beauty and challenges. The event includes 5, 15, and 42-kilometer races, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The organizers emphasize athlete safety and support, with aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: 5, 15, and 42-kilometer routes on Mount Olympus
Unique natural scenery and a mountain setting
Aid stations along the route
additional: Athletes who placed first in their category in the previous marathon are eligible for free entry, subject to submitting an application. Payment of fees is facilitated through bank accounts held by the Hellenic Mountaineering Club of Thessaloniki. Information is available on required equipment, along with suggestions for renting equipment through the club. Races of 5, 15, and 42 kilometers; entry by application; date: 2026-09-06; Litochoro, Pieria.

name: Teteven's Peaks
price_range: от 39 EUR до 115.39 EUR в зависимост от периода на регистрация
description: Teteven's Peaks offers an adventure for every mountain running and hiking enthusiast amid the beautiful scenery of the Teteven Balkan. The event features several distances: a challenging 27 km trail, a vertical climb, an easy 6 km route, and a walk with a mountain guide. Participants can enjoy fresh air, picturesque views, and well-organized aid stations. The event is suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and families, and provides medals, T-shirts, and personalized race numbers with timing chips.
course_highlights: Start in front of the municipality building in Teteven, followed by a climb to Mount Petrahilya
Aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, and food at key points along the route
Impressive views of the Balkan Mountains and the Teteven Balkan
additional: All participants receive a personalized race number with an RFID timing chip and can be tracked in real time. Medical teams and volunteers are present on the course and in the start/finish area. Aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, energy bars, and fruit. After the race, participants can explore the natural beauty around Teteven. Changing rooms and baggage storage are available in the start/finish area. Terrain: mountain trails. Registration includes a T-shirt, medal, insurance, an RFID chip for accurate timing, aid stations, and medical assistance.

name: Via Pontica

description: The Via Pontica cross-border marathon takes place annually and offers a unique running experience through Bulgaria and Romania. Participants run along a scenic route beside Lake Durankulak, the northern Bulgarian beaches, and the Romanian coastal settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai, crossing the border without stopping. The event includes distances of 28 km, 16 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with the finish on the beach near the village of Krapets. It is organized by the Zелена стъпка (Green Step) club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The route follows unpaved and farm tracks, with sandy sections beside Lake Durankulak and toward Cosmos campsite
Crossing the state border between Bulgaria and Romania without stopping
A coastal promenade through the Romanian settlements of Vama Veche and 2 Mai
additional: Children run free of charge and do not cross the border into Romania. Cutoff times: 4:30 hours for 28 km and 3:00 hours for 16 km. The fee includes fruit, water, electronic timing, bus transport for the 16 km race, medical assistance, and toilets at the start/finish. Changing distance is possible for a fee and payment of the difference in fees. T-shirts with an original design are available for an additional charge. Two running distances (16 km and 28 km) and a 2 km children’s race; transport to the start points; registration and fees; prizes for the top three finishers; coastal routes and a crossing of the border into Romania.

name: Екиден маратон
location: Национален стадион „Васил Левски“, София, София-град, България
description: The Sofia Team Marathon is a relay race held on September 6, 2026, at Vasil Levski National Stadium. The race promotes road relay running and marks 140 years since the Unification of the Principality of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia. Teams cover a total of 42.195 km, divided into six legs of different lengths, with color-coded bib numbers. The race is organized by the Sports Club “Sport for All Sofia in Europe” and the Bulgarian “Sport for All” Federation to determine the national relay running champions.
course_highlights: Total distance of 42.195 km, divided into 6 legs: 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 10 km, 5 km, 7.195 km
Start and finish in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Cutoff time for all teams: 4 hours and 1 minute
additional: Bib numbers and relay batons can be collected on September 5 from 10:00 to 19:30 and on September 6 from 7:30 to 8:30 in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium. Teams register primarily through the website 5kmrun.bg. There are checkpoint cutoff times, with specific times and passing limits for each leg. Registration on September 5 and 6, 2025, in front of Vasil Levski National Stadium; the event includes relays and various distances, including 42.195 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 7.195 km.

name: 20ό Hercules Series
description: The 20th Hercules Series is a series of mountain races held in Ypati, Fthiotida, offering routes of varying distances that cross the most iconic trails of Mount Oiti. The races include challenging routes featuring natural beauty, historic sites, and picturesque villages, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and offers a unique mountain-running experience in a captivating setting.
course_highlights: Routes through the wild trails and fir forests of Oiti
Passage through picturesque villages and alpine meadows
Historic sites and the natural beauty of the area
additional: The event includes multiple distances (1.2K, 7K, 16.7K, 42.6K) and combines natural beauty with historic trails. Support from volunteer groups is available, and group registration is possible. The start and route details are listed on the event’s official pages. The event features races at different distances and offers an opportunity to take part in a local sporting event with a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail (OUT 100K) is a demanding 101.7-kilometer ultradistance race on Mount Oiti, with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain. The route combines natural and historic trails, passing through mountain villages, dense forests, and Oiti’s highest peak, offering a unique experience that tests the limits of body and mind. The race brings together sport, nature, and history, making it a challenge for mountain-running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 101.7-kilometer route with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain
Passes through mountain villages and dense forests
Climb to Oiti’s highest peak
additional: The race is in the UTMB 100K category and awards 4 ITRA points. Volunteers can help at aid stations and at race administration/start. Equipment with a capacity of at least 8 liters is recommended. The race combines hiking and mountain running, with registration through a club. The route follows natural trails and passes through mountain villages, offering an authentic mountain-running experience.

name: Пирин ултра
price_range: от 48 до 118 EUR в зависимост от датата и дистанцията
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers a unique experience for skyrunning enthusiasts, with impressive views and challenging courses of varying lengths. The event attracts runners from around the world, who compete in four distances across beautiful, wild mountain terrain. The organizers provide medical examinations and strict safety rules to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Courses of 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km through Pirin National Park
Mountain terrain with technical sections and scenic views
Checkpoints along the course and staffed aid stations
additional: A medical examination is mandatory before collecting the race pack. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times. ITRA points are required to register for the 38 km and 160 km distances. The awards ceremony takes place at the Central Square in Bansko. Transport is arranged for participants in the 25 km distance to the starting point. Registration requires ITRA points for the longer distances; the race includes 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km courses.

name: 8ο Acheloos Run
description: The 8th Acheloos Run is organized by the Oiniades Running Team in Neochori, Messolonghi, and features road races on public roads for all ages. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas alongside the Acheloos River, with flat terrain and historic sites, offering a unique running experience. The finish is near the sea, where runners can enjoy local products and music at a beach party. Volunteers and safety organizations support the event to ensure participants’ safety.
course_highlights: Route alongside the calm waters of the Acheloos River
Passes through an environmentally sensitive area and historic villages
Finish near the sea with a beach party and local products
additional: Race packs can be collected at Heroes’ Square in Neochori on Friday, 11 September, and Saturday, 12 September 2026. Participants should be at the start area 45 minutes before the start. Water stations are located at designated distances. The route is supported by volunteers, police, EKAB, and other organizations. Training guidance for runners is available on the official website. The races include 1,000m, 5km, 10km, and a 21.1km half-marathon. The start is scheduled for 8:00 a.m. on Sunday, 13 September 2026. The event takes place in a beautiful area close to nature and water, with the aim of promoting sports and social cohesion.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: Oiti Ultra Trail is a challenging 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon held on Mount Oiti, combining natural beauty, history, and endurance. The course includes trails through dense forests, mountain settlements, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering runners a unique experience. The race is part of the events organized by the TRAHINA Fthiotida Runners’ Club and is a UTMB 100K category race with 4 ITRA points. The event connects sport with the nature and history of the region.
course_highlights: 101.7-kilometer course with 5,265 meters of positive elevation gain
Passes along historic and natural trails on Mount Oiti
Passes through mountain settlements and over the highest peak of Oiti
additional: The race is a UTMB 100K category race with 4 ITRA points. Volunteers can help at aid stations and with race administration/start operations. The event is supported by local sponsors and co-organizers. Participants receive an OUT medal. Trail running, mountain terrain, high elevation gain, well-marked course, organized aid stations, emphasis on safety and environmental responsibility

name: Serifos Sunset Race
description: The Serifos Sunset Race 2026 is a unique sporting event combining running and swimming races on the enchanting island of Serifos, on the weekend of September 12–13, 2026. The routes include 5 km and 10 km running races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach, as well as 750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay. The event offers a unique sunset running experience, ideal for runners and swimmers of all levels. It also provides an opportunity to visit the beautiful island of Serifos and enjoy local activities and hospitality.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach
750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay
A unique sunset running experience on Serifos
additional: The 5 km race starts at 17:50 from Vagia. Lifeguard and rescue coverage is provided. Car and motorcycle rentals are available on the island. Serifos is connected by ferry to Piraeus, Lavrio and other Cyclades islands. Volunteer opportunities are available for the event. The event includes running and swimming races, with detailed information about routes, safety, awards and registration. Events take place at Vagia and Livadi beaches.

description: Syros Trail Challenge 2026 is a running event held in Ermoupoli, Syros, featuring 3 km and 10 km routes. The courses wind through paved alleyways, stairways, paths, and cobbled lanes, offering a unique experience in both urban and natural surroundings. The race is open to men and women over 18, with age categories for the 10 km event. All participants receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal. The start and finish are at Miaouli Square in Ermoupoli. The maximum time allowed to complete the races is 2 hours and 30 minutes.
course_highlights: 10 km with 550 m elevation gain; 90% paved alleyways, paths, and stairways; 10% asphalt
3 km with 90 m elevation gain; 95% paved alleyways and stairways; 5% asphalt
Start and finish at Miaouli Square, Ermoupoli
additional: Registration opens on May 1, 2026, and closes on September 6, 2026, or when 170 paid entries have been reached. Individual registration is available on race day. Each athlete may participate in only one event. Age categories are offered for the 10 km race. All finishers receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal. Registration opens in May 2026, with a limit of 170 participants. The event includes medals and T-shirts, and the course showcases Syros’s landscape and architecture.

name: 1ο Prostate Cancer Race «Τρέχουμε για την Πρόληψη»
11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Μνήμης για τη Μικρασιατική Καταστροφή «Από τον Ασκάνιο στον Ερασίνο»
8ο Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail
organizer: Α.Σ. Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail και Δήμος Νάουσας
description: The Naousa Vermio Trail offers a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Vermio and in the city of Naousa. It includes routes of different distances, including the challenging 6 Peaks race, 44 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain; the Amazonios, 24.4 km; the Ververa, 10 km; and the fun Alsos Fun & Run, 6 km. The routes cross beautiful natural landscapes, peaks, and trails, offering a challenge for runners of all levels. The event is welcoming and supports participants with aid stations and course markings.
course_highlights: 6 Peaks route: 44 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain
A range of distances from 6 to 44 km for runners of different levels
Passes through Mount Vermio and natural trails with beautiful scenery
additional: Available routes: 6 Peaks 44 km, Amazonios 24.4 km, Ververa 10 km, Alsos Fun & Run 6 km. Course markings and aid stations are provided. Contact numbers: 697 696 1886, 697 394 5967. Information includes routes, maps, results, aid stations, and time limits.

name: Patmos ChoRun
description: Patmos ChoRun 2026 is a running race held on Patmos on Sunday, September 13, 2026. It includes a 21-kilometer race (half marathon), a 5-kilometer race, a 1,000-meter children’s race, and a power walk. Starts take place at central locations in Chora, offering a scenic running experience on the island’s public roads. The event is organized by the Patmos Gymnastics Club “Stadion” in cooperation with the Municipality of Patmos and the South Aegean Region, under the auspices of the Dodecanese Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS).
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon starting at Panagia Geranou
5,000 m and 1,000 m children’s race routes starting and finishing at Chora Town Hall Square
Running on Patmos’s public roads amid beautiful island scenery
additional: The races take place on public roads under the auspices of the Dodecanese Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS). The start and finish for the shorter distances are at Chora Town Hall Square, while the half marathon starts at Panagia Geranou and finishes at Chora Town Hall Square. The event features various routes and is organized with the support of local authorities and organizations, promoting sport and culture on the island.

name: Hercules Series
description: Hercules Series is a mountain running race series held in Ypati and Oiti on September 12 and 13, 2026. It includes four unique courses of different distances and difficulty levels, as well as a children’s race in Loutra Ypatis. The routes feature demanding climbs and natural beauty, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the mountains. The event is open to everyone and is organized by the Fthiotida Runners’ Club TRACHINA.
course_highlights: Hercules Marathon: 42.6 km with 2,727 m of positive elevation gain
Helleborus: 16.7 km with 1,225 m of positive elevation gain
Farmakides Trail: 7 km with 428 m of positive elevation gain
additional: Children’s Lagopodaros race: 500 m and 1 km, with no registration required, in Loutra Ypatis on September 12, 2026. The races take place in the Oiti mountain range and feature significant elevation gain. Volunteer participation and sponsor support are available. The event includes races in a natural setting, with registration through the website, and offers activities for the whole family.

name: Чудобой 2026
price_range: 60-100 лв. depending on registration period and category
description: Chudoboy is a team adventure race combining sporting disciplines with creative and intellectual challenges in nature in the village of Asparuhovo, Varna. The race offers three categories with different levels of technical difficulty and course length—Elite, Hobby, and Ailyak—suitable for different levels of fitness. Teams consist of two people, at least one of whom must be an adult. The race is for adventure lovers seeking both a competitive and adventurous spirit.
course_highlights: Varied stages: climbing, kayaking, orienteering, cycling, abseiling, self-rescue, swimming, and a cave
Three categories with different levels of difficulty and course length—Elite, Hobby, and Ailyak
Checkpoints with a cut-off time of 16:00
additional: The race begins with technical briefings for each category and the distribution of race packs. Starts are on September 13, 2026: 07:30 for Elite, 08:00 for Hobby, and 08:30 for Ailyak. Checkpoints close at 16:00, and the race ends at 17:00. Teams finishing after 17:00 are ranked after the others. Multiple stages and categories; registration is not currently open; the race includes technical briefings and race packs.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Ημιμαραθώνιος «Νικηταράς»
description: The 1st International “Nikitaras 2026” Half Marathon is an off-stadium road race held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli, as part of a three-day series of events in honor of Yiannis Kouros. The race starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli, offering a unique experience for runners wishing to take part in an international half marathon. The event emphasizes safety and course quality, with a limited number of participants to ensure better organization and runners’ well-being.
course_highlights: Starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli
Off-stadium course with varied terrain
Held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli
additional: The race is invitation-only, with a limited number of participants for safety and organizational reasons. The course is mainly hilly, following old paved roads, but also includes dirt roads and trails, where runners are encouraged to bring flashlights in case they pass through at night. Includes a three-day event program, volunteer opportunities, and a route from Ano Doliana to Tripoli.

description: The Ioannina Lake Run is a flat, paved 30-kilometer race around Lake Pamvotida, offering a unique experience amid scenery of natural beauty. It is aimed both at runners trying this distance for the first time and at those seeking strong performances. The start and finish are at Mavili Square in Ioannina, with staggered starts beginning at 8:15 a.m. The event has a long tradition and attracts thousands of runners every year, creating a three-day running festival with races for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Flat, paved 30 km route around Lake Pamvotida
Start and finish at Mavili Square, Ioannina
Scenery of natural beauty with views of the lake and the city
additional: Chips, race bibs, and commemorative items can be collected at Mavili Square on Friday 18/09 (17:00-20:00) and Saturday 19/09 (10:00-21:00). Collection is also available on Sunday before the start, from 7:00 a.m. The start is staggered in groups. The maximum number of participants is 3,000 runners. Runners over 18 years of age are eligible to participate. A medical and cardiac check-up is recommended before taking part. The organizers do not require medical certificates, and runners participate at their own sole responsibility. The course includes 11 aid stations, electronic timing, a commemorative medal, and a finisher’s certificate. There are parallel routes and races for all ages and ability levels, starting and finishing in the heart of the city.

name: Шосеен пробег „Карнобат”
location: Площад Трети март, Карнобат, Бургас, България
description: The Karnobat Road Race is a traditional athletics competition organized by Atlet Club (Karnobat) and Karnobat Municipality. The event includes various distances for men, women, and junior athletes, with the course passing through Third of March Central Square in Karnobat. It attracts athletes from different age groups and offers an opportunity for sporting competition and promoting athletics in the region.
course_highlights: The course passes through Third of March Central Square in Karnobat
Distances for men, women, and junior athletes: 2000 m, 3000 m, 4000 m, and 5000 m
Organized by Atlet Club (Karnobat) and Karnobat Municipality
additional: Date: September 19, 2026. Various distances for different age groups. The event is held outdoors in Karnobat, with participants in different categories and age groups.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Διπλός Μαραθώνιος Δρόμος “Γιάννης Κούρος 2026”
organizer: Γιάννης Κούρος – Πέρα από τα όρια
description: The 1st International Double Marathon “Yiannis Kouros 2026” is a demanding ultramarathon of approximately 455 kilometers, starting and finishing in Tripoli. The race crosses varied terrain, mainly hilly, old paved roads, as well as dirt roads and trails. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for the night sections. The time limit is 84 hours, and entry is by invitation, with strict performance criteria. The race is part of a three-day celebratory program honoring Yiannis Kouros and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli.
course_highlights: Approximately 455 kilometers across varied terrain
Mainly hilly, old paved roads, as well as dirt roads and trails
Night sections where a headlamp is recommended
additional: Entry is by invitation, with a limited number of participants and strict performance criteria (for example, mileage requirements from previous 24-hour, 48-hour, or 6-day races). The time limit is 84 hours. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for trails they may run on at night. Participation includes the double marathon, a half marathon, and parallel events. Registration opens by July 2026. The organizers aim to establish the event as a regular fixture and attract runners from around the world.

name: 3ο Dadia Trail Run
location: Δάσος της Δαδιάς, Σουφλί, Έβρος, Greece
description: The 3rd Dadia Trail Run is a mountain race held in the Dadia Forest, in Soufli, Evros, every September since 2024. The race is organized to help regenerate the natural environment and promote mass participation in sports, inspired by the message that hope can be reborn from the ashes. The event is supported by the «ORAMA» Authentic Athens Marathon Runners’ Group and retired General Charalambos Lalousis, Honorary Chief of the Hellenic Army General Staff, who has a special connection to the area. The race invites everyone to take an active part in the effort to regenerate the forest and life.
course_highlights: Route through the Dadia Forest
Natural environment of particular ecological importance
Mountain race with a strong focus on regeneration and environmental awareness
additional: The race promotes environmental awareness and the local community, welcoming runners of all levels. The event includes different routes and showcases the area’s natural beauty.

name: 9ο Lesvos Trail
description: The 9th Lesvos Trail is a mountain race held in Lepetymnos, Lesvos, offering 15 km, 6 km and 1 km routes. The routes cross the Lepetymnos mountain range and pass through agricultural and livestock-farming areas, combining natural beauty with local character. The event is supported by the Molyvos Tourism Board and has been moved to an autumn date because of restrictions in the area. The race is ideal for runners seeking a trail-running experience in a warm but beautiful setting.
course_highlights: 15 km, 6 km and 1 km routes in mountainous terrain
Passage through agricultural and livestock-farming areas
Routes shaped by the landscape and local restrictions
additional: The event was moved from its original spring date to September because of measures related to foot-and-mouth disease. September weather is warm, with an average temperature of 31°C and a low of 18°C, and average rainfall of 30 mm. The event was moved from spring because of restrictions related to the disease, with an emphasis on local nature and an authentic island experience.

name: 10ο Lailias Mountain Running
description: The 10th Lailias Mountain Running race will be held on September 20, 2026, at the Lailias Ski Center near Serres. This mountain running event features two courses, 6Km and 21Km, giving runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural pine forest and unexplored trails of Lailias. The race is intended for both beginners and more experienced runners, with 200m and 1350m of elevation gain respectively, offering a unique mountain running experience in a magnificent setting.
course_highlights: 6Km course with 200m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
21Km course with 1350m of elevation gain on unexplored trails
Natural pine forest and magnificent scenery in the Lailias mountain range
additional: Registration opens from 01/06/2026. A volunteer registration form is available. The 6Km course is intended for newcomers to mountain running. Water and isotonic drink aid stations are available along the 6Km course. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, and closes on September 13, 2026. The event also includes other categories, such as races for children and different difficulty levels.

description: Run Greece Trikala 2026 is a running event offering 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a power-walking event and races for children and families. The event prioritizes runner safety and support, with aid stations and medical coverage. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. Runners who complete the 10 km race receive a medal and a certificate of participation. The event is an opportunity for athletic activity and community participation in the city of Trikala.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes, plus power walking
Races for children and families (Family Run)
Support stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing
additional: Registration for the 10 km race includes a race number with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher medal, a certificate of participation with times, a race T-shirt, support services, and medical coverage. Registration closes no later than 3 days before the race, or earlier if the participant limits are reached. The entry fee can be paid by card only. Cancellations and refunds are not accepted. The children's races cover approximately 600 meters, are untimed, and are intended for students in grades 4, 5, and 6 (born 2015–2017). Participation is free and includes registration and collection of race materials.

name: 9ο Sitia Geopark Trail
distance_verbose: 24 km, 5 km, 3000 μέτρα, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km

name: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026
description: ELENA TRAIL RUN 2026 invites you to immerse yourself in the magic of the Elena Balkan with three challenging distances: 12 km for beginners and speed enthusiasts, with panoramic views; 21 km on a balanced course combining technical sections and impressive scenery; and 33 km, combining the dynamic nature of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, in the town of Elena and promises autumn colors, fresh air, and unforgettable experiences for all participants. Registration is mandatory for everyone over 18, while younger participants have special conditions for taking part.
course_highlights: 12 km – panoramic views, suitable for beginners
21 km – technical forest trails with impressive scenery
33 km – combines the dynamic nature of the 12 km route with the technical challenge of the 21 km route
additional: Participants aged 14 to 18 may take part only in the 12 km race, with written consent from a parent/guardian. Children under 14 may take part in the 12 km race only when accompanied and with a consent declaration from both parents/guardians. Online registration, different categories by age and distance, and a scenic route in the Elena Balkan.

name: XL kmrun - Кремиковци
description: XL kmrun - Kremikovtsi is an organized 5 km run held in Sofia. The event is part of the 5kmrun series, which takes place in several Bulgarian cities and is aimed at runners of all ages and ability levels. The start is at 9:00, and participation is free, making the event accessible and appealing to a wide range of runners. 5kmrun offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy regular outdoor exercise.
course_highlights: 5 km road run
Held in Kremikovtsi, Sofia
Start at 9:00
additional: Participation is free. The event takes place weekly in several cities across Bulgaria. Special initiatives include 5kmrun FEST and children’s runs. It offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Thessaloniki Stage Run
location: Seich Sou Forest, Thessaloniki, Central Macedonia, Greece
description: The Thessaloniki Stage Run is a multi-stage race in the Seich Sou suburban forest in Thessaloniki, designed for runners of all levels. It consists of three race stages: a 15 km night race, a challenging 40 km race, and a fast 25 km race, offering a complete trail-running experience. The organizers encourage participants to run all three stages to fully enjoy the journey through the forest. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and atmosphere against the backdrop of the city lights.
course_highlights: 15 km night race with 500 m of positive elevation gain
40 km race with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, challenging and technical
Fast 25 km race with 1,200 m of positive elevation gain on forest trails
additional: Athletes can cancel their entry by August 20 and receive a 50% refund. No refunds are available after this date. Post-finish snacks, aid at the stations, a commemorative gift, and a medal are provided. Participants are advised to carry a small backpack with solid food and a suitable container for liquids. The finish time limits are the same for all races, and athletes who finish after the cutoff are recorded as having abandoned (DNF). The event includes multiple routes, with registration information available on the website.

name: 2ο Folegandros Challenge Run
description: The Folegandros Challenge Run is a road race held on the island of Folegandros, offering distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. The main event is the half marathon, with a route from Livadi toward Chrysopigi and Pounta, featuring approximately 660 meters of elevation gain and the island’s characteristic climbs. The 10 km race starts from Pounta Square and follows a circular route with gentle climbs and beautiful views of the island. The event is organized by the Municipality of Folegandros in cooperation with the local running community, and the first edition received positive feedback for the quality of the course.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 660 meters of elevation gain
Route from Livadi toward Chrysopigi and Pounta, featuring characteristic climbs
Circular 10 km route with gentle climbs and open views of the island
additional: The 10 km race has no aid stations and has a 90-minute time limit. September weather is warm, with an average temperature of 31°C and a low of 18°C, and average rainfall of 30mm. It is recommended that details be confirmed with the organizer before registering. The routes include approximately 660 meters of elevation gain; participation includes refreshments, souvenirs, and medals. The event takes place on the last weekend of September, with good weather and beautiful local scenery.

name: 44ο Σπάρταθλον
description: The Spartathlon is a historic and extremely demanding ultramarathon race from Athens to Sparta, retracing the steps of the ancient runner Pheidippides. The course covers approximately 246 kilometers over varied terrain, from flat sections to steep climbs and descents, with elevation reaching up to 1,200 meters. The race starts at 07:00 on the morning of September 26, 2026, and lasts up to 36 hours, with strict time limits at checkpoints. It is intended for experienced, well-prepared runners who meet specific performance standards in previous ultradistance races.
course_highlights: A 246 km route from Athens to Sparta, with climbs reaching up to 1,200 meters
Traverses country roads, trails, vineyards, and olive groves
Aid stations every 3–5 km providing food, water, and medical support
additional: The race is held under strict medical and police supervision, with doctors, physiotherapists, and ambulances available throughout. There are time limits at every checkpoint, and runners who fail to meet them are disqualified. Participation requires official acceptance by the International Spartathlon Association and full acceptance of the race conditions. Applicants must have prior ultramarathon experience. Registration runs from January 25 to February 25, 2026. The race will take place on September 26, 2026.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon to cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place at the end of September, when nature is at its most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, and special support along the course. The event is a UTMB qualifier and earns points toward the ITRA ranking. All finishers receive a medal and a special race pack with a T-shirt and gifts.
course_highlights: Routes cover the border region of the Rhodope Mountains
Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Aid stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, and Rhodope specialties
additional: The entry pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts. A medical examination before participation is mandatory. Medical assistance and mountain insurance are provided. Aid stations offer water, hot and cold drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The course has minimal asphalt sections. Electronic timing of results. Information about accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photography and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, highlighting nature, history, and adventure, while supporting environmental causes.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different courses of varying distances and elevation gain; all qualify for the UTMB Index and earn points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, race bib, and gifts, and the courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, aid stations with food and drinks, and professional race photography, creating an unforgettable experience in the fairytale-like Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: Five courses ranging from 13 to 100 km through the Rhodope Mountains
Total positive elevation gain of up to 4,170 m on the 100 km course
UTMB Index-qualifying race with marked and secured routes
additional: The race pack includes a T-shirt, race bib, gifts, and a special surprise. Medical examinations are mandatory and are conducted on site at no extra cost. Aid stations offer water, hot and refreshing drinks, fruit, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The courses are marked and secured, with minimal paved sections. The event provides mountain insurance and medical assistance during the race. A medical certificate is not required; participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, transport to the start points is provided, the event supports green initiatives, and it is well organized.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive long-distance race of 10.25 km and a short 2023-meter distance for beginners. The course follows the beach along the Black Sea and returns on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake, combining seaside scenery with natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and newcomers, and children’s athletics activities for young talents take place before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional event that attracts national champions and members of Bulgaria’s national team.
course_highlights: Long-distance 10.25 km course along the Black Sea beach
Short 2023-meter distance for beginners
Return on a dirt road beside Pomorie Lake
additional: In the days before the race, “Children’s Athletics” activities are held to recruit new talents for the Atlet 2004 athletics club in Pomorie. The course includes running along the Black Sea beach and returning on the dirt road beside Pomorie Lake; distances are 10.25 km and 2023 m for beginners.

name: Ainos Mountain Marathon
description: The Ainos Mountain Marathon is a challenging mountain marathon held on Mount Ainos in Kefalonia. The 40.5-kilometer course crosses mountainous terrain on technical trails, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 meters, and offers panoramic views of the surrounding islands and the mountains of central Greece and the Peloponnese. There are also a 23.5 km half marathon and an 11.1 km trail race, starting from the village of Pyrgi. The event provides bus transfers for athletes, free post-race food, and special offers on ferry tickets and accommodation.
course_highlights: 40.5 km course with 2,500 m of elevation gain
Passes Megas Soros summit (1,628 m), with panoramic sea views for 8.5 km
Technical trails and challenging mountain terrain
additional: Athletes are transported by bus from Poros and Pyrgi to the start. Free food is provided after the race with a special card. The following day, free transport and a guided tour of the Melissani and Drogarati caves are offered. A pasta party is held on the evening before the race. Special offers are available on ferry tickets, and free accommodation is offered to the first 50 athletes. The race features technical trails and challenging terrain, and offers entry packages with discounts and benefits, as well as pre- and post-race events such as a pasta party and tours of the area.

description: Run Greece Alexandroupoli 2026 is a friendly road race offering 10 km and 5 km courses, children’s races, and a Family Run for the whole family. The event prioritizes safety and medical coverage, with volunteers and medical support along the course. The race is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. It is an opportunity for athletic activity and community participation in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km courses suitable for runners of all levels
Children’s races and a Family Run for the whole family
Medical coverage and volunteer support along the entire course
additional: Registration closes 5 days before the race or when participant limits are reached. Participants receive a confirmation email and instructions for collecting their race bib three days before the race. Full medical coverage and volunteer support are provided during the event. Registration cancellations are not accepted, and refunds are not issued. The race is part of a series of regional races in Greece and promotes the local community and the area’s athletic culture.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Στις γειτονιές των Μικρασιατών Προσφύγων»

description: The international road race “Run of the Free Spirit Ruse–Giurgiu” is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.
course_highlights: International route between Ruse and Giurgiu
Road course with scenic views
Race promoting friendship between Bulgaria and Romania

name: 2ο Makrakomi Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-distance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, Phthiotis. Participants run a 6.706-meter loop, with a start every hour for those who continue, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, fair play, and environmental protection, offering an experience that combines natural beauty and endurance. The start and finish are in Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: A 6.706-meter loop over mixed terrain (asphalt, paved sections, dirt roads, and trails)
Approximately 90 meters of elevation gain, with uphill and downhill sections
Passes the newly built chapel of Saint Paisios and follows a 3-kilometer forest road
additional: The race takes place in a sensitive environment, with strict adherence to nature-protection rules. Athletes run a loop, with a start every hour for those still in the race. The route is available for download in GPX format for use on GPS watches. The race includes rules, route information, and results, with participants from various runners and detailed data on the official website.

name: 27ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Νεάπολης Αγρινίου
description: The 27th Neapoli Agrinio Popular Road Race is a traditional road race held in the beautiful area of Neapoli, Aetolia-Acarnania. The race covers approximately 10 kilometers and offers an enjoyable route for runners of all levels. The welcoming event aims to promote sports and the local community. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event focused on safety and athlete support.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 9.7 kilometers in the Neapoli Agrinio area
An enjoyable urban and semi-urban setting
Suitable for runners of all levels
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, with a 9.7-kilometer road race, and is one of the area's most important local sporting events.

name: MakrakomiBackyardUltra
description: The Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a demanding ultradistance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, West Phthiotis. Participants are asked to run a 6,706-meter loop every hour, with a new start for the remaining athletes, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, culture, and environmental protection, offering a unique experience in a natural and environmentally sensitive setting. The start and finish are at Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: A 6,706-meter loop over mixed terrain (asphalt, paved sections, dirt roads, and trails)
Approximately 90 meters of elevation gain across uphill and downhill sections
A route with views of the newly built chapel of Saint Paisios and a natural environment sensitive to human impact
additional: The race takes place in an environmentally sensitive area, with strict adherence to nature-protection rules. Athletes run hourly laps, with a new start every hour. The route is available in GPX format for use on GPS watches. The start and finish are at Makrakomi’s central square. Registration is online from July 1 to September 30, 2025. The race consists of 6,706-meter laps, emphasizing environmental sensitivity and runners’ endurance.

description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain skyrunning race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the town of Karlovo. The race offers challenging courses with impressive natural views and varied terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. Following its successful hosting of the 2025 Masters Skyrunning World Championships, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose from several distances with varying lengths and elevation gain, offering a unique experience amid the wilderness.
course_highlights: Courses in Central Balkan National Park, with its extensive network of hiking trails
Distances with significant elevation gain: Vertical Kilometer (3.8 km / 830 m D+), 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Scenic views and challenging terrain, including mountain peaks and the Balkan Range ridge
additional: From 05.01.26 to 31.01.26 inclusive, there is a 10% discount on registration with promo code "BALKANIADA10". The event has several start times for the different distances on 4 October 2026 in the town of Karlovo. Registration is through the Tracksport.live system. Distances: 3.8 km / 830 m D+, 12 km / 595 D+, 27 km / 1600 D+, 44 km / 2570 D+; registration with promo code; mountain event; various initiatives

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional event held in Varna’s Sea Garden, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The race includes various distances suitable for men, women and young athletes, offering athletes from different age groups and clubs the opportunity to compete. The event is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Course in Varna’s Sea Garden
Various distances for men, women and young athletes
Participation by leading Bulgarian runners and clubs
additional: Held in the Sea Garden; various distances for men, women, junior men and junior women; results for different age groups

name: Γύρος Λιμνοθάλασσας Αιτωλικού

description: The Aitoliko Lagoon Circuit is an established road race held every September and organized by the Aitoliko Runners’ Athletic and Cultural Association. The race takes place in the beautiful town of Aitoliko, known as the Little Venice of Greece. Its route circles the lagoon, offering unique natural beauty and an enjoyable sporting experience. Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with many children in shorter races. The event combines sport and culture, with activities held at Aitoliko’s Eastern Beach, creating a celebration for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: A route around the Aitoliko Lagoon, surrounded by natural scenery and beautiful landscapes
Passes over two stone arch bridges, each approximately 300 meters long
The town of Aitoliko, known as the Little Venice of Greece, with waters and a small island in the center of the lagoon
additional: Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with a large number of children in a 1,000-meter race. The events are held at Aitoliko’s Eastern Beach, combining sport and culture on a nonprofit basis. Routes by the lake and beach, registration through the official site, high-standard events with medical coverage, around 500 participating athletes, and an awards ceremony.
